jobs.title: Public Engagement Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Founded in 1945 with the creation of the CARE Package®, CARE is a leading humanitarian organization fighting global poverty.
jobs.description:
Founded in 1945 with the creation of the CARE Package®, CARE is a leading humanitarian organization fighting global poverty. CARE places special focus on working alongside women and girls. Equipped with the proper resources women and girls have the power to lift whole families and entire communities out of poverty. In 2023, CARE worked in 109 countries, reaching 167 million people through more than 1,600 projects. To learn more, visit www.care.ca

CARE Canada is looking for a Public Engagement Specialist (12-month contract)

ABOUT THE ROLE

CARE Canada’s bold Strategic Plan, From Caring Comes Courage (2021 – 2027), sets out CARE Canada’s commitment to bring all our resources, talent, and expertise together to unlock women’s leadership for a gender-just future. It recognizes that to lead change and realize a better life for herself and her community, every woman needs to be safe, healthy and have a dignified livelihood. It also fundamentally realizes that ‘business as usual’ is no longer good enough: this Plan challenges us to reimagine how we achieve our mission, inspire Canadian investment in that mission, and transform our organization to be future-ready.

The Revenue & Marketing Unit is responsible for CARE Canada’s externally facing initiatives. The team is fundamental to achieving our goal of inspiring Canadians to join us in this journey with a brave and bold voice and through innovative partnerships and sustainable, balanced revenue sources.

The Public Engagement Specialist leads the Canadian Public Engagement pillar of the SHE SOARS project, including its strategic planning, delivery, monitoring and reporting.

Working from broad project objectives, commitments and key performance indicators, the Specialist develops the strategies, work plans, and processes required to increase Canadian youth’s awareness and understanding of, and engagement in, global SRHR issues. The Specialist oversees the development and delivery of all public engagement and communications activities, including multi-channel content, awareness and education campaigns, and in-person events.

The Specialist also leads the development and management of the Youth Public Engagement Champions (YPEC) model, through which a cohort of six social justice-minded Canadian youth help shape, develop and deliver SHE SOARS public engagement activities. The role oversees the full lifecycle of two-year cohorts and manages YPEC members, providing ongoing direction, guidance, feedback and professional development support. The Specialist also collaborates with Youth Advisory Board (YAB) members in Kenya, Uganda and Zambia to support knowledge exchange, elevate youth perspectives, and strengthen connections between Canadian youth and project participants.

As a key member of CARE Canada's Communications & Public Engagement team, the Public Engagement Specialist reports to the Manager, Communications and Outreach. The Specialist works closely with the SHE SOARS Project Manager, serves as a member of the SHE SOARS CARE Canada Matrix Team, and participates in Project Management Unit meetings to represent the project's Public Engagement pillar. The role collaborates with colleagues across CARE Canada and project partners in Kenya, Uganda and Zambia to align SHE SOARS public engagement with broader project, communications and advocacy priorities.

The Specialist also leads the research and development of a broader approach to youth engagement at CARE Canada, identifying evidence-informed opportunities to meaningfully engage Canadian youth and support long-term audience growth and engagement objectives.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • A minimum of 4 years’ experience in communications, public engagement or related field (journalism, public relations, international relations)
  • Degree in related field or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • Experience designing, leading and/or evolving youth engagement programs and providing leadership, guidance or mentorship to youth or volunteer teams.
  • Project management and donor reporting experience.
  • Experience managing relationships with diverse internal and external stakeholders, partners and vendors.
  • Knowledge of international development issues and familiarity with gender equality and/or sexual and reproductive health and rights programming.
  • Superior written and verbal communication and presentation skills in English.
  • Experience with digital communications, social media and web content.
  • Capacity to revise, and correct texts with a strong attention to detail
  • Capacity to work collaboratively and independently
  • Ability to travel in Canada and abroad

WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU EXTRAORDINARY

  • French language skills (written, oral)
  • Podcasting production/editing skills
  • Photography skills / ability to work with visuals to create compelling communications materials
  • Ability to create presentations
  • Previous experience working in an international NGO including work in development contexts

REQUIREMENTS

Promote and maintain an organizational culture that advances gender equality, reduces power abuse and inequalities, and fosters trust and safety.

Create an environment within CARE's workplaces, programming, and communities where CARE works that is free from sexual harassment, sexual abuse and sexual exploitation and child abuse (SHEA-CA).

Ensure high standards of prevention and response measures for SHEA-CA are in place consistent with the CARE International (CI) Safeguarding Policy and Safeguarding Code of Conduct.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Starting salary between $74,000 - $79,000
  • Comprehensive benefits package, providing family coverage for a wide range of services, including paramedical services, gender-affirming care, mental health support, and access to a confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Paid annual and wellness leave benefits
  • Extended list of paid holidays, beyond provincial requirements
  • December Office Closure (between December 24-January 1)
  • Inclusive holiday policy
  • Parental leave top-up
  • Employer contributions to group pension plan beginning in 2nd Year; Optional participation in group RRSP
  • International and domestic travel opportunities
  • Annual all-staff retreat
  • Learning and development opportunities and specialized training
  • Flexible work hours to support employee wellbeing and productivity
  • A focus on wellness and work-life balance
  • Amazing colleagues who are very committed to CARE’s mission

CARE Canada is committed to employment equity and building a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. Research shows that women and other marginalized folks tend to apply to roles only when they meet all the criteria outlined in the posting. If you're excited about this role but don't have experience with each and everyqualification, we encourage you to apply. Let us know in your application if you have a non-traditional background and how your experience maps to the role you're applying for. Recruitment-related accommodations for persons with disabilities are available on request.

As part of CARE Canada's commitment to preventing sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, we conduct reference checks on all final stage candidates in line with the Interagency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. By applying to this role with CARE Canada, you are giving us consent to contact your previous employers to seek information in line with this scheme.

Systemadministrator*in – IT Security & Endpoint Management

zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt mit 39 Wochenstunden im Homeoffice (deutschlandweit)

befristet auf 2 Jahre

Campact e.V ist eine Kampagnen-Organisation, mit der über 4,5 Millionen Menschen entschlossen für progressive Politik eintreten und unsere Demokratie verteidigen. Wenn wichtige politische Entscheidungen anstehen, starten wir Kampagnen – digital und auf der Straße. Wir schmieden breite Bündnisse und mobilisieren eine starke Bewegung für die gemeinsame Sache. Unsere Kampagnen treiben den ökosozialen Fortschritt voran und verteidigen unsere Demokratie. Damit eine gerechte Gesellschaft entsteht, in der alle Menschen sicher und selbstbestimmt in Frieden und Freiheit leben können.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir eine*n Systemadministrator*in – IT Security & Endpoint Management zur Verstärkung unseres aktuell dreiköpfigen Anwender*innen Support Teams.

Campact setzt als moderner Arbeitgeber auf Digitalisierung und Flexibilität – daher arbeiten unsere Mitarbeiter*innen fast ausschließlich im bezuschussten Homeoffice oder Co-Working-Space. Die Teamarbeit funktioniert über Mail, Chat, Video- und Telefonkonferenzen. Um unser gutes Teamgefühl zu fördern, ermöglichen wir regelmäßige persönliche Treffen und erwarten Reisebereitschaft für unsere Teamklausuren. Neben der Campact-Geschäftsstelle in Verden/Aller, die teilweise als Anlaufpunkt dient, erwarten wir auch Reisebereitschaft, wenn Unterstützung vor Ort notwendig ist.

Deine Aufgaben

Mit Campact bewegen Menschen gemeinsam Politik. Mit Deiner Arbeit hältst Du dem Team den Rücken frei und unterstützt die Kolleg*innen bei technischen Herausforderungen. Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team unterstützt Du im Bereich Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit. Hierfür arbeitest Du eng mit den zuständigen Personen für Digital Security und Datenschutz zusammen.

  • Du nimmst einen aktiven Part im Incident Response ein, unterstützt bei der Nachbetrachtung von Sicherheitsvorfällen und bei der Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Risikominimierung (z.B. Phising/Schadsoftware/0-Days).

  • Du unterstützt beim Risk Assessment und setzt Maßnahmen zur Risikoreduktion um und wirkst aktiv an der Erstellung und Pflege von Richtlinien, Prozessen und Dokumentationen im Bereich Informationssicherheit mit.

  • Du bewertest neue und bestehende Anwendungen auf IT-Sicherheits- und Compliance Anforderungen und unterstützt bei der Integration in unser Mobile-Device-Management-System und betreust diese gemeinsam mit Deinem Team.

  • Du begleitest die Einführung neuer interne Dienste, kommunizierst mit internen wie externen Ansprechpartner*innen und betreust unsere bestehenden internen Systeme (wie IAM, Mail-Postfächer, Mailinglisten).

  • Du kümmerst Dich um die Beschaffung und Einrichtung von Hardware (Notebooks, Tablets, Mobilfunkgeräte) und Software.

  • Du unterstützt die User*innen bei alltäglichen Problemen mit Hard- und Software.

Unser Angebot

  • Du leistest einen direkten Beitrag zur positiven Veränderung von Politik und Gesellschaft, zu sozialer Gerechtigkeit, ökologischer Nachhaltigkeit, Toleranz und Gleichberechtigung.

  • Du erhältst eine Vergütung in Anlehnung an die TVöD-Entgeltgruppe 10 und 31 Urlaubstage.

  • Wir bieten Dir eine Vielzahl von attraktiven Sozialleistungen, u.a. monatliche Kinderzuschläge (bei Vollzeit z.B. 493,20 Euro für das 1. Kind).

  • Durch eine Homeoffice-Pauschale bezuschussen wir die Ausstattung für eine gesunde und produktive Remote-Arbeit.

  • In Hochphasen kommt es vor, dass Du auch mal an Wochenenden oder Abenden tätig oder rufbereit bist. Wir legen Wert darauf, dass Du Überstunden ausgleichen kannst und bezuschussen Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit. Die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ist uns bei Campact e.V wichtig. Zusammen mit dem Betriebsrat haben wir eine Verteilungslogik erstellt, die es uns ermöglicht, individuelle Bedürfnisse zu berücksichtigen und gleichzeitig umgehend und flexibel auf politische Ereignisse reagieren zu können.

  • Im Team arbeiten wir gemeinsam daran, langfristig erfolgreich und selbstwirksam zu bleiben. Dabei spannt sich der Bogen von einer transparenten Kommunikation über eine wertschätzende und offene Feedback- und Führungskultur hin zum Feiern unserer gemeinsamen Erfolge.

  • Für Deine individuelle Gesundheit ermöglichen wir Dir Austauschmöglichkeiten mit Coaches und Psycholog*innen sowie eine vergünstigte Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft mit einer Vielzahl an Gesundheitsangeboten.

  • Wir sind ein innovativer Arbeitgeber mit rund 150 netten Kolleg*innen und einer tollen Arbeitsatmosphäre – ob remote oder auf den regelmäßigen Teamevents.

  • Wir setzen auf eine umfassende Einarbeitung, u.a. durch Pat*innen und ermöglichen Dir viele Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Campact e.V. ist eine NGO, die unabhängig von Politik und Wirtschaftsinteressen agiert, Transparenz wird bei uns großgeschrieben. (Hier geht es zum aktuellen Transparenzbericht).

Requirements

Unsere Profilbeschreibung enthält eine Vielzahl sehr unterschiedlicher Kompetenzen, die wir für diese Stelle relevant finden. Bitte bewirb Dich, auch wenn nicht alle Punkte auf Dich zutreffen – alles Weitere können wir im gemeinsamen Gespräch klären.

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum*r Fachinformatiker*in für Systemintegration mit 3-5 Jahre relevanter Berufserfahrung im genannten Aufgabengebiet oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Du hast (erste) Erfahrungen in einem Security Operations Center (SOC) sammeln können und der Umgang mit SIEM sowie IAM - Systemen sind Dir vertraut.

  • Du erkennst automatisierungsfähige Prozesse und kannst diese mühelos als Python, Shell Skript oder Low-Code umsetzen.

  • Du kennst macOS in- und auswendig und bringst idealerweise auch Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Windows- und Linux-Umgebungen mit.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Mobil Device Management Systemen wie JAMF.

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen zusammen und hast eine lösungsorientierte und empathische Arbeitsweise.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Aufgaben, dabei sind Datenschutz und -sicherheit sind für Dich essentiell.

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrungen in NGOs oder engagierst Dich in der Politik und kannst aus dem Umfeld eine Referenzperson für Dein politisches oder gesellschaftliches Engagement nennen.

  • Du identifizierst Dich mit den Werten und der Arbeit von Campact.

Hast Du Lust auf diese Herausforderung? Dann lade Deinen Lebenslauf (ohne Foto, mit der Angabe Deines Pronomens, mit dem Du angesprochen werden möchtest, sowie der Angabe Deiner Referenzperson) in unser Bewerbungsmanagementsystem hoch.

Statt eines Anschreibens beantworte folgende zwei Fragen kurz (maximal auf einer halben Seite):

  • Warum bewirbst Du Dich auf diese Stelle?

  • Wie kannst du zur Sicherheit unserer Organisation beitragen?

Campact e.V. ist davon überzeugt, dass gesellschaftlicher Wandel nötig und möglich ist. Dabei müssen auch wir als Organisation uns weiterentwickeln – um uns noch besser für eine Welt engagieren zu können, in der alle Menschen ihre Freiheit gleichermaßen verwirklichen. Dazu braucht es auch Wandel in unserer personellen Aufstellung. Wir laden insbesondere Menschen mit Diskriminierungserfahrungen ein, sich bei uns zu bewerben.

Der Prozess ist mehrstufig, beinhaltet eine Probeaufgabe, ein Gespräch mit Fach- und Personalkolleg*innen und ein Kennenlerngespräch mit der Teamleitung und der Geschäftsführung. Der gesamte Prozess soll bis Ende Oktober abgeschlossen sein.

Weitere Informationen zu Campact e.V. findest Du auf.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team. In this role, you'll introduce our services to marketing executives across the United States, identify potential opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings for our sales team.
Previous cold-calling or B2B sales experience is helpful but not essential. We welcome applications from recent graduates, career changers, and motivated individuals with excellent communication skills.

  • Handle objections. Respond professionally to common questions and objections while maintaining a positive customer experience.
  • Book meetings. Schedule qualified appointments for our sales team and ensure accurate calendar coordination.

  • Coachability. Welcomes feedback and applies it to improve performance.
  • Resilience. Maintains a positive attitude and persistence when facing rejection.

  • Organisation. Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately maintain CRM records and follow-up activities.
  • Fast learner. Quickly understands new products, services, and sales techniques.

Nice to Have
  • Experience. Previous experience in marketing, cold calling, telesales, appointment setting, customer service, or B2B sales is preferred but not required. We believe communication skills, coachability, and a willingness to learn are stronger predictors of success than experience alone.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive training. Learn our products, services, and proven outbound sales process.
  • Ongoing coaching. Receive regular feedback, call reviews, and mentoring to help you succeed.
  • Career development. Build highly transferable communication, negotiation, and business development skills.
  • Remote flexibility. Work remotely with a supportive team.
  • Competitive pay. Earn USD $4–$8 per hour, depending on relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated sales ability, and overall fit for the role. Bonuses are available for strong performance, including qualified meetings successfully booked.
  • Growth opportunities. This role has the potential to become an ongoing position for the right candidate, with opportunities for growth as you develop your skills and contribute to the team's success.

We are looking for a strong Mid to Mid-Senior Product Designer to join our team for a full-time engagement on a B2B contract basis towork on a crypto / digital assets app and web platform. This is a hands-on role for a designer who can take ownership of tasks from initial requirements through to polished, production-ready designs. You should be comfortable working independently, asking the right questions, identifying gaps, and making informed design decisions without needing step-by-step direction.

The role involves working across multiple product areas and initiatives, so you should be comfortable switching between different contexts and types of design work, while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own product design tasks end-to-end, from understanding requirements and exploring solutions to high-fidelity UI, prototyping, and developer handoff.

  • Proven experience working with, maintaining, and extending design systems in a real product environment.
  • Experience designing and prototyping complex digital products with multiple user flows, states, data-heavy interfaces, or transactional experiences.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple initiatives, switch between different contexts, and take responsibility for delivering high-quality work from start to finish.

Why Join Us:

  • Be a part of a cutting-edge fintech/digital assets company with a clear mission and vision.

  • Modern Workplace – Enjoy state-of-the-art offices designed for comfort and productivity
  • Fully remote, with the option to work from any of our modern offices
  • Strong Team Ethos – Be part of a motivated team that values cooperation and shared success

jobs.excerpt: Essnova Solutions, Inc.  is an SBA 8(a) and HUBZone-certified small business delivering technology and professional services to government clients, with a focus on healthcare, geospatial, and environmental solutions.
jobs.description:
Essnova Solutions, Inc. is an SBA 8(a) and HUBZone-certified small business delivering technology and professional services to government clients, with a focus on healthcare, geospatial, and environmental solutions. As a Data Engineer / Data Modeler, you will play a pivotal role in designing and maintaining robust data architectures that enable large-scale analytics and support mission-critical government programs. You will collaborate closely with technical teams, security experts, and stakeholders to ensure data solutions are secure, scalable, and compliant with federal standards.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing and maintaining scalable database architectures for analytical workloads, ensuring optimal performance through indexing, partitioning, caching, and query tuning.
  • Developing, automating, and maintaining data ingestion, transformation, validation, and loading pipelines to support high-quality data flows.
  • Building reusable data connection modules and backend infrastructure components to streamline data operations and support future scalability.
  • Supporting data preprocessing, normalization, and rigorous data quality validation processes.
  • Contributing to cloud migration planning, governance, and evaluation of cloud solutions for security, compliance, interoperability, and performance.
  • Producing comprehensive data models, architecture diagrams, flowcharts, and technical documentation for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Utilizing PowerShell scripting and automation to enhance data engineering workflows and system integration.
  • Collaborating with technical, security, and stakeholder teams throughout the project lifecycle to deliver high-impact data solutions.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, database administration, or data architecture
  • Proven experience designing and optimizing scalable database architectures for analytical workloads, including query performance tuning (indexing, partitioning, caching)
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated data ingestion, transformation, validation, and loading pipelines
  • Strong SQL skills with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or similar relational databases
  • Proficiency in Python or R for data transformation, automation, or pipeline development
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS) for cloud-hosted data solutions
  • Knowledge of FedRAMP requirements and cloud security best practices
  • Proficiency using Git with documented development practices
  • Experience designing data models for analytics (e.g., dimensional star/snowflake and/or normalized relational models)
  • Experience collaborating with government program stakeholders and security/privacy personnel, and presenting technical deliverables to diverse audiences
  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a Tier 4 (High-Risk) Public Trust and HSPD-12/PIV credentialing
  • Ability to travel approximately 10% as needed

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory and at least two of the following: Azure SQL, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Functions
  • Active Public Trust clearance

Benefits

  • Comprehensive health insurance coverage (medical, dental, vision)
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • Remote work flexibility
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Supportive and inclusive team culture

jobs.title: Quality and Release Manager
jobs.excerpt: We prioritize learning and teamwork and love giving people the opportunity to champion solutions to big challenges and grow into better versions of themselves.
jobs.description:
We prioritize learning and teamwork and love giving people the opportunity to champion solutions to big challenges and grow into better versions of themselves. A great candidate believes in Raya's vision, which is to enrich lives by fostering relationships through quality, in person interactions. You thrive at the intersection of quality and shipping, and you're excited to build the release systems, quality gates, and testing strategy that let Raya ship a consumer app our members trust every time.

Responsibilities

  • Quality Strategy: Own the QA strategy across automated and manual testing, deciding what we automate, what we test by hand, and what we accept as risk, with regression coverage on critical paths like onboarding, payments, subscriptions, messaging, and login, including where third-party testing services and AI-assisted QA tooling fit in.

  • Visibility and Communication: Maintain the release calendar and Quality scorecards including report crash rates, defect escape rates, and release health to leadership

  • Continuous Improvement: Run release retros, turn incidents and escaped defects into durable process fixes, and connect release decisions to the incident response process

  • Release Ownership: Run the release process end-to-end for the Raya iOS app from predictable release trains with clear cut, freeze, and submission dates through App Store submission, phased rollout, and rollback/fix forward

  • Go/No-Go Process: Define release readiness criteria, lead go/no-go decision making

Qualifications

  • 6+ years in software quality, release management, or engineering, with 3+ years managing people

  • Deep knowledge of the App Store release lifecycle: TestFlight, phased release, expedited review, and rejection handling

  • Experience with subscription and payment flows on iOS

  • Experience building test automation strategy for mobile, including real-device testing, feature flags, and progressive rollouts

  • Experience deciding the split between automated and manual testing, and managing third-party QA or crowdtesting vendors

  • Fluency with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, and strong knowledge of Git branching strategies for mobile release workflows

  • Clear, direct written communication

What Sets You Apart

  • Systems Builder: You build process and automation, so release quality depends on systems rather than memory

  • Impact-driven: You focus regression and automation coverage on the paths that matter most to members, rather than chasing full coverage everywhere

  • Ownership mentality: You take escaped defects from discovery to root cause to prevention

  • Bridge Builder: You partner with engineering managers, product, and leadership, embedding quality into everyday workflows while balancing team velocity

  • Bias toward shipping and iteration: You improve the release process incrementally in short cycles rather than waiting for a perfect system

jobs.title: Therapeutic Account Manager, Liver - Memphis
jobs.excerpt: MISSIONMirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases.
jobs.description:
MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
  • Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
  • Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
  • Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
  • Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
  • Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.

Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
  • Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
  • Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
  • Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.

Influence & Impact

  • Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
  • Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
  • Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries

Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact

  • Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
  • Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
  • Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
  • Identify recurring customer, access, and patient-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights

  • Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.
  • Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
  • Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
  • Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.

Entrepreneurial Drive, Resilience & Culture

  • Operate with a high degree of ownership, self-motivation, resourcefulness, and initiative in an unstructured, rapidly evolving rare disease environment.
  • Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
  • Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.
  • Model Mirum's values and the highest standards of ethical conduct, compliance, transparency, inclusion, and respect in every internal and external interaction.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive sales experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently delivering business results in a complex specialty, rare disease, orphan drug, or high-science market.
  • Rare disease experience is highly preferred; experience in hepatology, gastroenterology, pediatric specialty care, or another complex specialty market is highly desirable.
  • Strong clinical aptitude and demonstrated ability to learn, retain, and communicate complex disease-state, diagnostic, mechanism-of-action, clinical-data, and product information.
  • Experience with account-based selling across health systems, centers of excellence, multidisciplinary care teams, referral networks, and influential healthcare professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to use insight-led or challenger-style selling to constructively challenge the status quo, influence behavior, and advance customer decision-making.
  • Working knowledge of access and reimbursement dynamics, patient support pathways, and the role of patient services in rare disease markets.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to interpret performance data, identify insights, develop territory and account strategies, and translate plans into consistent field execution.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, communication, presentation, judgment, and ability to build trust with diverse and highly sophisticated customers.
  • Proven self-motivation, resourcefulness, resilience, organization, and ability to prioritize and perform independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
  • Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, and Analytics.
  • Commitment to ethical conduct, compliance, and approved promotional practices, with sound judgment in complex customer and patient-related situations.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 70%, including frequent overnight travel and occasional weekend commitments.

About the role

The senior economist provides expertise and leadership to support the pan-Canadian Pharmaceutical Alliance (pCPA) decision-making for the planning, coordination, and management of brand negotiations and generic drug assessments using health economic evaluations and other financial analyses to obtain the best possible value for federal, provincial and territorial public drug programs.

Reporting to the manager, Analytics, this role leads projects to support evidence-informed pCPA negotiations and participates in committees involving a range of stakeholders to plan, coordinate and implement negotiation strategies and processes. The senior economist has responsibilities for one or more of the following core analytic activities within the Analytics division:

  • Analytical support and leadership on pCPA Negotiations
  • Broad pharmaceutical market analyses, encompassing brand, generic, and evolving pharmaceutical markets (such as biosimilars and cell and gene therapies)
  • Economic and financial analyses to evaluate drug-related policies and/or organization performance

Senior economists are expected to operate independently to address high-complexity issues and to provide technical leadership for Economists and Analysts in the Analytics division.

Specific deliverables

  • Collaborating with the pCPA negotiation team and federal/provincial/territorial partners, develops negotiation strategies, sets mandates and reassess offers/counteroffers in order to achieve value-based negotiation outcomes between the public drug programs and pharmaceutical manufacturers.
  • Independently conducts comprehensive analyses (e.g., financial systems, utilization, environmental scans) in which relevant research findings are synthesized and reported to support evidence-informed decision-making on pCPA negotiations.
  • Identifies and analyzes internal and external issues such as regulatory issues and contract dependencies that may affect negotiations and, if needed, consider legal implications in order to provide bespoke advice pertaining to pCPA negotiations.
  • Conducts targeted re-analysis of cost utility, cost minimization and budget impact analyses, including incorporating confidential pharmaceutical prices and/or alternative assumptions made by manufacturers and/or health technology assessment agencies in order to evaluate its plausibility and impact.
  • Critically appraises complex confidential manufacturer price proposals, including contract elements linked to patient and/or utilization and, as required, consider indication-specific elements to quantify its financial impact on individual jurisdictions and nationally across Canada.
  • Evaluates the pCPA’s and manufacturer’s strategies for outcome-based offers, including consideration of appropriate valuation, complexity of administration, and pan-Canadian health system impacts.
  • Leads and/or supports quantitative research relating to the pharmaceutical ecosystem, including but not limited to, the evaluation of the savings resulting from the pCPA agreements, timeline analysis on drug’s life cycle (i.e., market access and market exclusivity), calculation of rebates when incorporating different contractual elements, and the financial impacts of pharmaceuticals reimbursement policy changes.
  • Leads or co-leads all aspects of a negotiations with drug manufacturers on behalf of the pCPA, including: developing mandates, setting objectives, and securing outcomes that align with the pCPA’s direction and overall strategy.
  • Develops and continues to refine processes and structures to ensure consistency across pCPA negotiations and supports the development of provincial/territorial negotiation standards to align with best practices.
  • Demonstrates effective project leadership including project scoping, identification of project parameters, including resource assessments; project implementation including ensuring project remains on track; brainstorms possible options to implement the most effective solutions to resolve problems proactively; and preparation of deliverables (e,g., report, implementation plans, communication materials).
  • Leads the preparation of training and resource materials.

General deliverables

  • Collects, organizes and interprets data for members of the Analytics team, the pCPA staff, or jurisdictional pCPA contacts.
  • Leads and/or participates in the development and evaluation of reports and analyses that are related to the pCPA or the pharmaceutical ecosystem.
  • Coordinates, prepares, and writes responses, policy papers, slide presentations, memos, correspondence, briefing notes, and reports for management/executives on a variety of drug-related matters. This may include presenting policy options and recommendations to senior drug program management, inter-jurisdictional working groups and committees to support evidence-informed decision making.
  • Completes critical consultations and liaisons with federal, provincial and territorial public drug programs and other jurisdictions and experts (e.g., medical, legal and financial specialists) regarding drug funding agreements.
  • Supports Analysts in preparing internal and public-facing metrics, including key performance and risk indicators and targeted metrics assessing the volume, timeliness, and effectiveness of brand negotiations and generic drug assessments.
  • Leads and/or participates in the development, revision and/or appraisal of negotiation policies, programs and initiatives.
  • Fosters and maintains relationships with the federal, provincial, and territorial jurisdictions and other external groups to develop and implement a coordinated response to a wide range of topics.
  • Represents the pCPA and participate in working groups and/or committee and acts as a liaison to external partners and relevant advisory agencies.
  • Supports the development of business plans.
  • Stays informed of industry trends.

Accountability

  • Accountable to the manager, Analytics.

Qualifications

Education and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in health economics, finance, business administration, or a clinical or scientific discipline (including, but not limited to, pharmacy, pharmacology, or medical sciences), or related field.
  • 3 to 5 years of work experience in health economic evaluation (cost-utility analysis, cost-effectiveness analysis) and budget impact analysis including leading the interpretation and appraisal of economic evaluations and budget impact analyses, and modifying such analyses to incorporate alternative parameters or assumptions.
  • At least 3 years of experience conducting comprehensive quantitative analyses (e.g., financial, utilization, environmental scans) to support decision-making.
  • At least 3 years of experience working with data to support analytical, research, or policy-related work.
  • Experience preparing reports, briefing notes, or presentations to communicate findings.
  • Experience in either pharmaceutical sciences, health services research, government, or regulatory environments is required.
  • Experience mentoring or coaching employees is an asset.
  • Experience overseeing working groups and project team is an asset.
  • Experience supporting negotiation strategies through economic and financial expertise is an asset.

Skills and abilities 

  • As English is the primary working language at the pCPA, exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English are required including demonstrated proficiency in delivering presentations to both technical and generalist audiences.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills in French (asset).
  • In-depth understanding of the Canadian pharmaceutical industry and government processes.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in delivering presentations to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Exceptional ability to engage, respond to needs and building working relationships with all partners, fostering an effective and dynamic organizational culture.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and independent decision-making based on thorough understanding of established procedures and considerations of relevant contextual factors.
  • Ability to lead and build consensus in the absence of authority.
  • Strong business and digital acumen.

Employment terms

  • The salary range for this full-time permanent position, classification level A7, is $97,747 – $137,711. This range reflects the salary for candidates with varying experience levels, job knowledge, and qualifications relevant to the position. Specific offers will be based on individual backgrounds and qualifications.
  • This position is part of the Association of Management, Administrative and Professional Crown Employees of Ontario (AMAPCEO) bargaining unit and is governed by the terms and conditions outlined in the collective agreement.
  • The work hours for this position is 36.25 hours per week.
  • The pCPA provides employees with a comprehensive group benefits package from the first day of employment. 
  • The ideal candidate must be legally eligible to work in Canada and can work from any location within Canada.
  • This position requires frequent travel in different provinces and territories, including periodic multi-day, overnight trips.

If you are interested in this position, please submit your application by the end of September 17, 2026.

We thank all those who apply; however, only those chosen for further consideration will be contacted.   

The pCPA is an equal-opportunity employer. In accordance with the Accessible Canada Act, 2019, and all applicable provincial accessibility standards, the pCPA will provide accommodation for applicants with disabilities upon request throughout the recruitment, selection, and/or assessment process.

jobs.description:
Ton rôle, en bref :

En tant qu’Analyste intermédiaire, tu auras pour principal focus les travaux entourant la modernisation de notre logiciel de gestion Hopem Immobilier vers une nouvelle plateforme technologique.

Le candidat recherché doit démontrer des compétences supérieures à la moyenne en analyse et documentation par sa capacité à constamment améliorer l’ensemble des processus de développement dans un environnement agile. Possédant un niveau d’engagement supérieur démontré par l’action, le candidat doit également avoir un niveau d’autonomie très développé.

Tu feras partie d’une équipe de développement solide et en pleine évolution technologique et tu seras accompagné d’autres analystes expérimentés.

Le travail se fait principalement par télétravail mais des rencontres occasionnelles à nos bureaux sont possibles.

Ton profil :

  • Tu as d’excellentes capacités d’analyse et un souci de documenter adéquatement les requis fonctionnels?

  • Tu es motivé par le besoin de donner du sens à ce que tu fais

  • Tu aimes améliorer constamment les processus de développement en mode Agile?

  • Tu aimes le télétravail pour ton équilibre travail-famille?

Tes responsabilités, plus en détails :

  • Produire des documents d’analyse fonctionnelle détaillés, clairs et structurés, servant de base aux équipes de développement (produits, logiciels ou projets)

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les développeurs, les architectes de solutions et les parties prenantes pour assurer la cohérence entre les besoins métiers et les livrables techniques

  • Participer à la définition des exigences, des cas d’usage et des scénarios fonctionnels

  • Valider et documenter les changements requis par nos clients

  • Collaborer activement à l’évolution et à la maintenance de la plateforme

  • Participer aux analyses de faisabilité et à la rédaction des spécifications nécessaires

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe de contrôle de la qualité et contribuer aux tests fonctionnels et intégrés

Ton expertise et tes compétences :

  • Diplôme de niveau collégial ou supérieur en informatique

  • 4 à 6 ans d’expérience pertinente dans le secteur

  • Posséder un fort esprit analytique

  • Posséder une excellente capacité de communication et de documentation

Atouts :

  • Expérience avec le domaine de l’immobilier

  • Notions de comptabilité ou de gestion

  • Expérience avec Azure DevOps

  • Connaissance de la méthodologie Agile

  • Capacité à lire du code existant (Delphi, C#)

  • Une bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais est requise car le titulaire du poste aura à communiquer fréquemment dans les deux langues, tant oralement que par écrit. Nous avons des collègues, des clients et des partenaires au Québec, ainsi que dans le reste du Canada et aux États-Unis.

Les avantages offerts :

  • D’excellents avantages sociaux (dentaire, optométrie, médical, programme vie active de 325$ annuellement, programme REER, programme d’aide aux employés, programme d’achat d’actions)

  • Du télétravail presque 100% de ton temps

  • Des collègues en or, de bonnes relations, de l’entraide et de l’esprit d’équipe.

  • De la reconnaissance sous toutes ses formes.

  • Des possibilités d’évolution et d’avancement.

  • Des options pour mieux concilier vie personnelle et travail (complément maternité pour les 6 premières semaines, congés personnels, journée de bénévolat).

  • Et surtout, des fous rires au quotidien!

Tes coéquipiers :

Ton gestionnaire sera Martin, c’est lui qui dirige l’équipe R&D. Il valorise la collaboration, il aime s’entourer d’experts, donne beaucoup de latitude à son équipe et est à l’écoute des idées nouvelles pour faire avancer les choses. 

Tu travailleras aussi en étroite collaboration avec Caroline, chef d’équipe, Danielle, analyste sénior, et Hugo, chef de produit en immobilier ainsi que toute l’équipe élargie, qui ont déjà hâte de t’accueillir. 

Notre entreprise :

L’ouverture, c’est ce qui nous représente chez HOPEM : l’ouverture à ton unicité, à tes intérêts, à ta réalité et sans oublier, aux fous rires!

Chez HOPEM, nous créons des logiciels qui facilitent la gestion des propriétés locatives québécoises afin que nos clients puissent se concentrer sur leur croissance. Notre mission : accompagner nos clients en développant des outils de gestion performants!

Le processus de sélection :

Pour appliquer, tu dois d’abord compléter ton profil dans notre système Workday. Ensuite, nous procéderons à l’entrevue en ligne ou en présentiel. Finalement il y aura une prise de références et une vérification des antécédents.

Si tu as un intérêt pour livrer des analyses détaillées et bien documentées, que tu recherches le monde idéal entre la grosse boîte et la PME et que faire évoluer des logiciels vers les nouvelles technos te parle, ce rôle au sein de notre équipe est le défi que tu attendais!

Nous sommes prêts à t’ouvrir notre porte! L’ouvriras-tu?

Martin Lavallée

Directeur Senior R&D

*Seul les candidats retenus seront contactés*

Harris souscrit à un programme d’accès à l’égalité en emploi et les candidatures des membres des groupes visés à savoir les femmes, les personnes handicapées, les personnes autochtones et les minorités visibles sont encouragées à soumettre leur candidature. Si vous êtes une personne handicapée, vous pouvez recevoir, sur demande, de l’assistance pour le processus de présélection et de sélection.

L'équipe de recrutement de talents de Harris n'a pas recours aux messages texte pour entrer en communication avec les candidats ou solliciter des informations confidentielles. Nous encourageons tous les candidats à postuler sur des postes publiés. Ils seront contactés soit par un gestionnaire de Harris, soit par un membre de l'équipe de recrutement de talents pour un entretien, dès lors que les critères requis sont satisfaits.

jobs.title: Senior Engagement Manager (Japanese Speaking)
jobs.excerpt: Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.
jobs.description:
Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.

Companies like Delta Air Lines, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, and Microsoft use the Chooose platform to build, operate, and scale their lower carbon fuel programs (typically referred to as Sustainable Aviation Fuel, or SAF), and to advance voluntary and compliance carbon management initiatives.

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

The role

As a Senior Engagement Manager based in Singapore or Japan, you will be a cornerstone of Chooose’s APAC Customer Operations organization. You will partner closely with enterprise customers in the aviation, energy, and logistics sectors — including major APAC carriers and fuel suppliers — enabling them to build and operate high-integrity SAF programs on the Chooose platform.

Working in close collaboration with the broader Customer organization, you will own day-to-day relationships with our largest APAC customers, guiding them from initial implementation through go-live and long-term program success. You will also serve as a key voice of the APAC region internally, shaping how Chooose adapts its products and processes to serve this market.

What you'll do

    Customer Ownership & Relationship Management

  • Own a portfolio of key enterprise customers in the APAC region, with a focus on the aviation, energy, and logistics sectors — including carriers operating across Japan and Southeast Asia.

  • Build high-trust, long-term relationships with senior stakeholders across customer organizations — from Sustainability and ESG teams to Fuel Procurement and Finance.

  • Serve as the customer’s primary point of contact and trusted advisor on all things SAF: program design, regulatory context, platform capability, and market trends.

    • Program Delivery & Operations

  • Oversee the end-to-end implementation of complex SAF and decarbonization programs, supported by the Technical Implementation team and cross-functional Chooose resources.

  • Track and manage operational metrics, including implementation timelines, SLA adherence, and program KPIs. Proactively flag and resolve delivery risks.

  • Ensure program quality across the full customer lifecycle — from onboarding and configuration to reporting, reconciliation, and renewal.

    • Regional & Regulatory Expertise

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of the APAC regulatory landscape as it pertains to SAF and carbon management — including CORSIA compliance, SAF mandates, Singapore’s aviation decarbonization strategy, and emerging requirements across the region.

  • Act as an internal subject-matter resource on APAC market dynamics, translating regional nuance into actionable guidance for the Customer, Product, and Lower Carbon Products teams.

  • Represent Chooose in regional working groups and industry organizations where SAF and decarbonization are the primary focus.

    • Commercial Growth & Feedback

  • Assess, clarify, and validate customer needs on an ongoing basis. Proactively identify expansion opportunities and champion them internally with structured product feedback.

  • Maintain a balanced perspective: support commercial growth while upholding Chooose’s commitment to long-term, high-integrity climate action.

  • Expand upon commercial growth: Actively work with Business Development to pursue new commercial opportunities in the region, including airlines, producers, freight forwarders, etc.

    • Process Improvement

  • Refine and contribute to the global Customer Operations playbook — improving how Chooose delivers implementation, manages ongoing operations, and scales customer success.

  • Collaborate across Product & Engineering, Technical Implementation, Finance, Legal, Business Development, and Lower Carbon Products to deliver program objectives on time and with high quality.

What you'll bring to the table

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution, ideally in the hard sciences.

  • Minimum 6 years of demonstrated success in management consulting, SaaS implementation, enterprise customer success, or enterprise project management.

  • Experience in enterprise software, carbon markets, fuel markets, or carbon accounting is a strong plus.

  • You’re comfortable navigating highly configurable SaaS platforms and discussing API integrations and data workflows with technical stakeholders.

  • You listen carefully and authentically care about solving customer problems — you don’t wait for others to act.

  • You’re equally comfortable presenting to a C-suite sustainability officer and debugging a data issue with an implementation engineer.

  • You’re willing to travel within APAC (and occasionally to the US or Europe) on short notice.

  • You’re comfortable working across APAC time zones, with occasional overlap with US Eastern and European hours for internal collaboration.

  • You possess excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, along with professional fluency in Japanese.

  • Must be based in Singapore or Japan.

The interview process

    At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process.

  • Phase 1 — Introductory conversations: discuss your experience and learn more about Chooose and the role.

  • Phase 2 — Practical exercise: you’ll receive a written brief in advance and present your work in a follow-up session.

  • Phase 3 — Executive conversation: a one-on-one with a member of our leadership team.

    • The process typically takes 4–6 weeks. We’re committed to keeping to this timeline while ensuring we have enough time to get to know each other properly.

Pay, perks, & more

We offer a competitive salary that reflects your experience and skill level. Along with a benefit package that includes contributions in line with all statutory requirements, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, mental health resources, life insurance, paid parental leave, generous annual leave entitlement, flexible working hours, and access to co-working spaces.

We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply.
Compensation will be based on experience and skill, commensurate with market rates, and will include both salary and equity in Chooose.
Chooose is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment to our employees and welcome input from candidates and employees on how we can enhance our inclusiveness.
Prerequisite for Employment: Chooose will request to conduct background checks on prospective applicants to verify the information provided in the CV, transcripts, and other documentation. This background check may be carried out by our partner and will not be conducted without the applicant's prior consent. Prospective applicants will receive more information about this.

Job Title: Technical Writer / Configuration ManagerJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: SecretEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Local* * *

The Opportunity:

Join a fast-paced Agile development program as a key contributor on our Platform team. We are looking for a versatile and detail‑oriented professional to serve as both a Technical Writer and Configuration/Change Manager. In this dual-impact role, you’ll shape how our teams communicate, document, and manage evolving cloud-based solutions in a secure AWS environment. You will play a vital part in ensuring our program’s accuracy, compliance, and technical excellence—while influencing processes that support mission delivery for a government customer.

Responsibilities:

Technical Writing

  • Develop and maintain clear, comprehensive technical documentation including admin installation guides, API references, system architecture diagrams, and other artifacts.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to gather technical inputs and validate content accuracy.

  • Keep documentation current and aligned to ongoing system updates and releases.

  • Create and maintain security and compliance documentation required for Authority to Operate (ATO) within a government program.

Configuration and Change Management

  • Establish and maintain CM policies, procedures, and Configuration Management Plans (CMPs) in alignment with government and industry standards (IEEE, ISO, MIL-STD-973, EIA‑649).

  • Define configuration identification schemes and naming conventions for Configuration Items (CIs).

  • Conduct CI audits, reviews, and verification activities to ensure traceability and accuracy.

  • Manage functional, allocated, and product baselines across the system development lifecycle.

  • Coordinate release planning, deployment activities, and support government oversight reviews.

  • Ensure CM processes integrate seamlessly with SAFe/Agile practices in scaled environments.

AWS Cloud Environment

  • Utilize AWS tools and services to document and manage cloud infrastructure.

  • Align documentation and configuration management practices with AWS best practices and compliance requirements.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Active Secret Clearance.

  • 3+ years of experience in configuration management for complex technical systems, including managing baselines and change control.

  • 3+ years of experience in technical writing, supported by a portfolio of published technical documents.

The Compliance Testing Data Analyst is an individual contributor who provides data analytics, automation, and reporting expertise in support of Aqua’s Compliance Testing and Monitoring program. This role analyzes data, develops scalable testing and monitoring solutions, identifies trends and risks, and produces reliable reporting to support effective compliance oversight.

Essential Functions

  • Support the execution of the Compliance Testing and Monitoring program through data analysis, population identification and validation, sampling support, testing workbook preparation, results aggregation, and exception analysis.

  • Collect, validate, reconcile, and analyze data from internal systems, business reports, GRC tools, SharePoint, Excel workbooks, and other approved data sources used in compliance testing and monitoring activities.

  • Develop, maintain, document, and enhance compliance testing methodologies and analytics routines, including data logic, testing rules, exception criteria, thresholds, sampling logic, repeatable queries, and testing outputs.

  • Develop and maintain testing data files, dashboards, metrics, reports, trackers, and recurring monitoring routines to support timely, accurate, and consistent testing execution and reporting.

  • Develop and enhance automated and semi-automated testing, monitoring, and reporting solutions using tools such as Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, SQL, and other approved analytics, reporting, or workflow tools.

  • Analyze large data populations to identify trends, outliers, anomalies, potential exceptions, repeat issues, control weaknesses, and emerging compliance risks.

  • Support risk-based testing by translating test objectives into data requirements, identifying relevant populations and testing attributes, supporting sample selection, and validating the completeness and reliability of data used for testing.

  • Prepare clear and accurate testing results summaries, exception reports, trend analyses, dashboards, metrics, and management reporting that communicate testing outcomes, risk themes, identified issues, and remediation status.

  • Support testing execution and workpaper quality by preparing and maintaining accurate, complete, organized, and independently reviewable data extracts, sampling files, calculations, evidence, supporting documentation, exception validation, and testing results.

  • Assist Compliance Testing team members with data preparation, exception validation, evidence gathering, issue documentation, root cause analysis support, remediation validation, and retesting activities.

  • Maintain testing-related schedules, trackers, reporting inventories, issue validation logs, action item logs, and documentation repositories to support effective program governance, transparency, and timely completion of testing activities.

  • Partner with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Audit, IT, Data, and Business Unit stakeholders to obtain data, clarify data definitions and requirements, resolve data quality issues, and support timely completion of testing and monitoring activities.

  • Support compliance testing reporting and data requests for the Chief Compliance Officer, senior management, management committees, bank partners, audits, examinations, regulators, and other oversight stakeholders.

  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve testing efficiency, reporting consistency, data quality, automation, monitoring routines, documentation, and repeatability of testing processes.

  • Support special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field, or commensurate work experience, required

  • 8 years of experience in data analytics, compliance testing, monitoring, audit support, risk management, financial services operations, or a related analytical role preferred.

  • 5 years of experience supporting compliance within financial services required.

  • Experience analyzing and reconciling large data populations, identifying trends and anomalies, and preparing accurate reporting required.

  • Advanced Excel skills required; experience with SQL, Power BI, Power Automate, SharePoint, GRC systems, or similar tools preferred.

  • Experience with testing methodologies, monitoring logic, exception rules, sampling methodologies, or repeatable analytics routines preferred.

  • General understanding of compliance testing, internal controls, issue validation, documentation standards, and consumer financial services compliance preferred.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to translate testing objectives into data requirements, analyze results, prepare clear reporting, and maintain accurate and independently reviewable documentation while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Compliance, Legal, IT, Data, and Business Unit stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated sound judgment, discretion, professionalism, and ability to handle confidential information in a fast-paced environment.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, stand, walk, visualize, talk, hear, and handle or touch objects or controls. The employee may occasionally lift, push, or pull up to 20 pounds.

This position is an office-based position where you must be able to sit for long periods of time. The employee will be working on a computer 90% of the time.

The Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) Education Lead collaborates with key stakeholders such as the CDI Leadership team, coding team members, providers, facility and service-line operational leadership, CDI & Coding auditors, and others to train providers on documentation best practices aimed at improving clinical documentation and coding accuracy. The CDI Education Lead is also responsible for training clinical documentation specialists to enhance their skills for CDI operations, with the goal of improving the accuracy of patient record documentation. This role involves working with the CDI Leadership team to develop and deliver education for providers on documentation best practices and for all CDI team members, covering areas like new employee orientations, skills training, team building, customer service, and change management. The aim is to ensure that clinical information in medical records is accurately recorded to reflect the appropriate clinical severity level for services provided to patients. We are seeking a skilled Senior AI/Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Python, AI orchestration, and cloud-native backend systems to join our growing team. You will play a key role in developing a scalable, production-ready AI Voice Dispatch Assistant operating entirely within a secure AWS environment. Your work will directly impact the reliability, intelligence, and scalability of a multi-agent voice AI platform.

  • Design, implement, and maintain a multi-agent AI system using Strands Agents SDK (BidiAgent) deployed on AWS ECS/Fargate, ensuring per-session isolation, auto-scaling, and lifecycle management of Nova 2 Sonic BidirectionalStream.

  • Configure security, compliance, and content protection controls, including Bedrock Guardrails, AWS Cognito authentication, FastAPI JWT middleware, and Lambda-based authorization mechanisms.
  • Develop and manage serverless infrastructure components including API Gateway, AWS Lambda handlers, DynamoDB session state management, and ElastiCache Redis integrations.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years of senior-level software engineering experience with a strong focus on Python development.

  • Strong hands-on expertise with AI/ML concepts, including LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Deep knowledge of AWS services including ECS/Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, and AWS Bedrock services such as Nova 2 Sonic and Nova Micro.
  • Experience with multi-agent AI architecture frameworks such as Strands Agents SDK or similar technologies.
  • Solid understanding of authentication, security, and compliance best practices, including PII handling, prompt-injection protection, and access control systems.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across distributed teams while maintaining consistent overlap with U.S. business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building production-grade voice AI or conversational AI systems.
  • Familiarity with OpenSearch Serverless, Titan embeddings, and AWS-native RAG implementations.
  • Experience designing secure, enterprise-grade AI solutions within controlled cloud environments.
  • Background working with healthcare, dispatch, or operational workflow automation platforms.

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

We have an exciting opportunity within US Medical Affairs for a Director, Medical Affairs Oncology, Strategic Evidence & Collaborations (SEC). This role will be remote but will require headquarters travel for specific meetings quarterly.

Reporting to the Senior Director and Head of Strategic Evidence & Collaborations, US Medical Affairs (USMA), the core efforts of this role is to be responsible for co-developing the US Medical Affairs strategy for US Medical Affairs congress plans in collaboration with the COE (Congress Center of Excellence) and the USMA Strategy and Field Based Medical Teams.

The key functions of this role will be to represent and consider the healthcare environment of the US with internal and external stakeholders involved in cancer therapies across approved and pipeline molecules and indications, including the Global Medical Affairs team, US Medical Access and Quality team, Scientific Communications/Publications, Medical Affairs Outcomes Research, Commercial Strategy, Marketing, Value and Market Access,  Clinical Research/Development, US Public Affairs, US Government Affairs ,Patient Engagement, Business Conduct (Legal), and the field-based US Medical Science Liaisons.

Travel Requirement: Must be able to travel more than 50% of the time, including a mix of domestic and international travel.

Job Responsibilities 

 As an integral part of the USMA Oncology team, and in close collaboration with Oncology medical directors, Field Medical., Global Medical Affairs, Medical Affairs Research, Medical Patient Access and Quality, and cross-functional partners, this role will establish and execute an overarching strategy for evidence generation across various tumor types in the US, including collaboration with cooperative groups, NCI/CTEP, and other key organizations. This role will also provide frequent internal and external input into the development of both the US and Global Medical Affairs Strategic Plans for our ADC portfolio, particularly the Integrated Strategic Plan (ISP). Additionally, the role will be a key contributor to the US and Global medical Plan of Action (POA) 

Specific responsibilities for this role will include, but are not limited to: 

  • Demonstrate deep subject matter expertise in our full ADC portfolio, the Gilead clinical trials and their clinical use, as well as competitive products

  • Collaborate as a thought partner and significant contributor to the successful work lead by the Community Cancer Collective Team (CCC)

  • Contribute to the development of the Global Integrated Strategic Plan (ISP) and Local Plan of Action (POAs) by providing US and Global based strategic perspectives 

  • Develop strategies and implementation plans to define and address education, research, and medical affairs insights and data generation needs within the US 

  • Prepare presentation materials and present scientific data at internal meetings and external advisory boards 

  • Support US medical efforts in global and regional Congress strategic planning and tactical execution in collab with SEC lead and Center of Excellence (COE) for Congresses. The Role may focus on Disease Specific Efforts and Oncology HCPs engagement in collaboration across the USMA Teams.

  • Support-Lead the USMA medical efforts and strategic planning for US Based Oncology Societies 

  • Provide medical and scientific leadership and support at key scientific meetings with US HCPs / patient presence 

  • Serve as an information resource to Gilead colleagues, including the US Medical Science Liaisons, including medical educational activities, grants, and investigator-sponsored/collaborative studies. 

  • Collaborate with Investigator Sponsored Research (which Gilead calls “Collaboration Research”) with the Medical Affairs Research Team (MAR) and Clinical R&D.

  • Upon limited occasion, Lead the delivery of timely, accurate, and succinct communication of fair-balanced clinical and scientific presentations to healthcare professionals, both proactively and in response to requests for information, consistent with promotional compliance and regulatory requirements 

  • Upon occasion, participate in the editorial review of all scientific content to ensure strategic alignment and accuracy 

  • Support the development of Disease-Specific Publication Strategy 

  • Support data generation activities through: 

  • Critical review of global collaboration Research, Ph 3b, and Ph4 study proposals generated in the US 

  • Review abstracts and/or manuscripts that result from US collaboration research 

  • Communicate Gilead’s commitment to scientific excellence through research and education 

  • Provide strategic input to Global Medical Affairs Plan 

  • Collaborate effectively and in a compliant manner with colleagues in other functional areas throughout Gilead. 

  • Other activities, as assigned, to support US Medical Affairs strategy development and tactical execution 

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Advanced medical/scientific degree (i.e., Ph.D., MD, Pharm D) and 8+years of experience in Medical Affairs or success in a similar role outside of the biotech/pharmaceutical industry OR

  • MA/MS and 10+years of experience in Medical Affairs or success in a similar role outside of the biotech/pharmaceutical industry OR

  • BA/BS and 12+years of experience in Medical Affairs or success in a similar role outside of the biotech/pharmaceutical industry

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in Medical Affairs or success in a similar role outside of the biotech/pharmaceutical industry. 

  • Experience specific to oncology

  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically and translate that strategy into an actionable work plan. 

  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal, relationship-building, negotiating, and communication skills. 

  • Excellent organizational skills to support project planning across multiple activities, and to anticipate and prioritize workload. 

  • Excellent teamwork skills. 

  • Attention to detail and ability to meet timelines in a fast-paced environment 

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; demonstrated ability to identify and understand complex issues and problems; ability to identify and query key findings from study data and publications. 

  • Experience in developing effective abstracts, manuscripts, posters, and slides and presenting at scientific meetings 

  • Must be fully cognizant of and adhere to regulatory and legal (Business Conduct) requirements for clinical trials and related Medical Affairs activities; thorough knowledge of FDA regulations, ICH guidelines, and GCPs governing the conduct of clinical trials is preferred 

  • Able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence. 

 

Display of Gilead Core Values: 

  • Integrity (Doing What’s Right) 

  • Teamwork (Working Together)

Now that you’ve found the job description, what’s next?

Vans is the original brand rooted in the authentic lifestyle of skateboarding. We are driven by our mission to inspire and empower everyone to live “Off The Wall” – embracing the youthful spirit of freedom, non-conformity, and relentless progression. Yesterday’s “Off The Wall” moment is today’s new normal, and at Vans, we believe in constantly outdoing ourselves. Together with our communities across the globe, our vision is to push culture forward because we believe that the pursuit of progression never ends. We are constantly inspired by the future generation of positive catalysts within our community.
