jobs.description:
Salary range: £30,000 to £35,000
Location:Remote, but within the UK
Please note: We are unable to sponsor international visas at this time.

About Nexus Mods
Established in 2001, Nexus Mods is the largest video game modding platform on the internet and a household name in the PC gaming ecosystem.
  • 77M+ registered members
  • 900K+ mods for 5,000+ games
  • 25B+ mod downloads
We’re currently focused on product modernisation, driving growth and building infrastructure for the next 10 years of community-powered modding.

Our Role:
We're looking for an experienced Customer Support Specialist to join our Trust and Safety team, delivering world-class support to our users, mod authors, and wider community.

This isn't a generic support role. You should already understand Nexus Mods and care about modding ideally as an active member of the community, or with equivalent hands-on modding experience.

Alongside everyday account, payment, and general support queries, you'll help look into things like flagged files, suspicious uploads, and content safety concerns, following clear processes and escalating anything complex.

The shift schedule will be Wednesday to Saturday.

Role Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with Nexus Mods, PC game modding, or modding communities. We are specifically looking for someone who understands what Nexus Mods does, why modding matters, and how our users and mod authors interact with the platform.
  • A genuine interest in modding, PC gaming, and user-generated content.
  • Good working knowledge of at least one customer support platform, such as Zendesk or Help Scout.
  • Comfortable picking up and navigating web-based tools. We use a custom admin system, Google Sheets, Slack, Discord, web forums, and other third-party web tools.
  • A methodical, curious approach, comfortable following a process to get to the bottom of an issue, rather than jumping to conclusions.
  • Solution-focused and tenacious problem solver. Customers do not always self-diagnose their issues correctly, and you'll need to dig deeper at times to find the right solution.
  • Proactive and confident working independently as well as collaboratively across teams.
  • Strong and clear communication skills, able to write with clarity and good form. Many of our users are non-native English speakers, and the ability to adapt your approach according to the user will be key.
  • Good judgement when dealing with sensitive issues, including user files, account access, moderation decisions, and potentially harmful content.

Bonus skills:
  • Basic awareness of cybersecurity and file safety concepts, including malware risk, suspicious uploads, phishing, account compromise, false positives, and safe handling of user-submitted files.
  • Experience investigating technical issues methodically, gathering evidence, and distinguishing between user error, platform issues, policy issues, and potentially malicious behaviour.
  • An understanding of how modding works, such that you can properly investigate and resolve mod authors' needs.
  • Previous experience making and releasing mods.
  • The ability to pick up and understand how modding works in new games, including Unity and Unreal games that do not have modding tools.

Role Responsibilities

  • You'll be the first point of contact for users through our support email and other contact points.
  • Responding to inquiries and troubleshooting customer accounts and services-related issues for our active users. Customer communication is mainly through email, but will involve some contact through web forums and Discord servers.
  • Looking into support cases involving user files, flagged content, suspicious uploads, and content safety concerns by reviewing available information, following defined processes, and escalating complex or high-risk cases where appropriate.
  • Owning, managing, and resolving customer support cases efficiently through our dedicated support system, ensuring optimum customer satisfaction.
  • Working with the Moderation team to resolve issues around user files, payments, and accounts.
  • Continually striving for service quality improvement, focusing on first-time resolutions, resolution time, and Customer Satisfaction Score. Reporting progress back to the team and wider organisation.
  • Dealing with a variety of processes such as content copywriting queries, payment and account queries, site support, and emerging issues around AI-generated voice and image content.
  • Identifying opportunities to go beyond the norm to leave customers feeling valued and well-served, and staying informed about trends in gaming, modding, and community behaviour to provide informed support.

Benefits of Working At Nexus Mods

  • We work a 4-day week of 32 hours, with no reduction in pay.
  • An allowance of £25 each month to spend on video games.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Private BUPA healthcare for you and your family.
  • A very flexible training budget.
  • Regular social events throughout the year. Participation is optional!
Diversity and Inclusion:
We celebrate diversity and want you to bring your whole self to work.
Supporting an incredible community of tens of millions of users, we thrive on engaging as many views as possible to improve our platform. We see no reason why our culture should be any different.

About VGS

VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

About the Role

VGS is looking for an experienced payments nerd who is passionate about understanding the inner workings of payment stacks and who, in a single day, can earn a prospect CTO's trust, map a complex payment flow with an existing customer payments leader, and work directly with VGS product and implementation engineers to design secure, scalable integrations.

We are seeking a Solutions Architect with a solid software engineering background who excels at aligning technical strategy with business goals. You will collaborate closely with prospective and existing clients to understand their needs and translate technology into tangible business value, partnering with payment companies and enterprise merchants on complex challenges in global payment infrastructure, processor connectivity, credential portability, tokenization, and sensitive payment data.

You will work closely with Sales and Account Management throughout the deal lifecycle, and with Product and Engineering to shape both our roadmap and go-to-market strategy based on what you learn in the field.

What You'll Do

Discovery & Solution Architecture

  • Conduct technical discovery with customers, Sales, and Account Management to clarify business goals, requirements, risks, and product gaps.

  • Map payment flows across merchants, PSPs, processors, acquirers, card networks, wallets, and third parties.

  • Architect solutions using VGS capabilities including vaulting, card management, network and Agentic Tokens, Account Updater, 3DS, wallet payments, account validation, and data security.

  • Guide customers on payment security best practices, PCI scope reduction, credential portability, multi-processor setups, resiliency, and scaling.

  • Identify technical and commercial risks early, including scope, dependencies, and ownership issues.

Deal Support & Delivery

  • Lead technical strategy for qualified opportunities, from discovery through architecture approval and implementation handoff.

  • Create and deliver architecture diagrams, proposals, demos, and proofs of concept.

  • Lead responses for RFIs, RFPs, security reviews, and architecture assessments.

  • Collaborate with customer engineers on APIs, webhooks, auth, data models, error handling, and integrations.

  • Produce detailed handoffs covering solution architecture, assumptions, responsibilities, testing, success metrics, and out-of-scope items.

  • Provide technical oversight through launch to ensure implementations match approved architectures.

Product Influence & Enablement

  • Translate customer and market feedback into actionable input for the VGS product roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

  • Develop reusable reference architectures, demos, integration patterns, and enablement assets.

  • Serve as a payments and technology subject matter expert in workshops, executive briefings, and industry events.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience across solutions architecture, sales engineering, technical consulting, payment implementation, software engineering, or a similar technical customer-facing role.

  • Experience with large-scale card or credential migrations.

  • Experience with multi-PSP, payment orchestration, processor-routing, or payment portability strategies.

  • Background at a merchant, PSP, processor, acquirer, issuer, card network, or payment infrastructure company.

  • Knowledge of PCI DSS, data security, privacy, and compliance architecture.

  • Proficiency with web services and APIs, and full-stack development, with the ability to understand how a wide variety of technologies and systems interact.

  • Strong communication skills — comfortable explaining complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, creating clear technical solution diagrams, and structuring/presenting sales and executive-level decks.

  • Comfortable writing production-grade code examples and reference implementations in one or more of VGS's primary deployment languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Ruby.

  • Strong collaboration, interpersonal, negotiation, and prioritization skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, or security products

  • BA/BS degree

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Industry certifications such as PCI QSA, CPP (Certified Payments Professional), CISSP, or AWS Solutions Architect.

  • Conhecimento sólido de Python, com experiência prática no desenvolvimento de APIs (preferencialmente FastAPI), bibliotecas de dados (Pandas) e boas práticas de estruturação de código;

  • Proficiência na escrita de consultas SQL para busca, união e processamento de informações em bancos relacionais e analíticos;​
  • Experiência na construção de interfaces de dados e protótipos visuais utilizando Streamlit;​
  • Experiência na utilização, segurança e consumo de APIs REST e serviços web em geral;​
  • Vivência com painéis de monitoramento e observabilidade em tempo real, como Grafana;​
  • Experiência com versionamento de código utilizando Git e boas práticas de documentação técnica;
  • Buscamos alguém com forte espírito de equipe e abertura para aprender novas tecnologias sob o direcionamento dos seniores;​
  • Proatividade para identificar gargalos em processos manuais e propor soluções de automação;​

jobs.excerpt: The Practice Operations Manager serves as the operational execution owner for practice implementation, performance reporting infrastructure, and cross-functional coordination across Guidehealth's clinical pillars.
jobs.description:
The Practice Operations Manager serves as the operational execution owner for practice implementation, performance reporting infrastructure, and cross-functional coordination across Guidehealth's clinical pillars. This role is the internal operational counterpart to the provider-facing Practice Success function, responsible for building the implementation plans, data integrity, and pillar coordination that make practice-facing engagement possible, without direct ownership of the practice relationship itself.

The Practice Operations Manager owns implementation project management end to end, from kickoff through go-live, and is accountable for the accuracy and readiness of performance data and reporting before it reaches the provider-facing team or practices. This individual coordinates across Guidehealth's three pillars: Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI), Care Management (CM), and Quality, to resolve operational barriers, maintains the CRM, SOPs, and process documentation that the department relies on, and escalates risk, data issues, and implementation barriers to leadership with clear supporting context.

While this role does not travel or meet with practices directly, its effectiveness depends on staying connected to what practices are experiencing, and adjusting internal processes as feedback comes in.

What you'll be doing:

Implementation Project Management

  • Leading end-to-end implementation execution for new practices, from kickoff through go-live, following established timelines and guidelines
  • Building and maintaining implementation project plans, ensuring milestones, dependencies, and deliverables stay aligned with strategic objectives and operational needs
  • Coordinating AWV workflow implementation, CM embedded rollout, and PAC workgroup activities at the practice operational level
  • Monitoring and evaluating the effectiveness of implemented changes, collecting data to measure outcomes and identify gaps
  • Maintaining documentation of implementation processes, outcomes, and lessons learned for continuous improvement

Reporting & Data Operations

  • Pulling and compiling reports from HubSpot CRM to support portfolio-level review, escalation decisions, and leadership reporting
  • Reviewing CRM and report data for accuracy and completeness ahead of practice delivery; partnering with Data Analytics to identify and resolve discrepancies, gaps, or data integrity issues before the provider-facing team reviews reports with practices
  • Identifying practices showing risk indicators based on data trends and escalating with supporting context to the provider-facing team and leadership
  • Managing and tracking Practice Success department tasks, follow-up items, and escalations tied to implementation and ongoing operations
  • Maintaining and QAing the underlying report templates, data sources, and CRM fields the provider-facing team relies on for scorecard delivery
  • Providing regular status updates and operational insights to leadership

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Facilitating recurring internal pillar huddles (Clinical Documentation Improvement, Care Management, and Quality) to review implementation status, surface barriers, and coordinate cross-functional responses
  • Collaborating with Clinical Operations, Technology, Quality, and Product teams to ensure coordinated, on-time service delivery
  • Routing practice-level operational barriers and needs to the appropriate pillar leads and tracking resolution through to completion
  • Serving as project coordinator between internal operational teams throughout implementation
  • Incorporating field feedback and practice-level insight from the Practice Success team into implementation plans, reporting design, and process improvements

Operational Infrastructure & Documentation

  • Maintaining accurate, current data in HubSpot CRM (records, meeting logs, action items, engagement status)
  • Updating and maintaining network tracking items for the assigned portfolio on a consistent cadence
  • Documenting meeting notes and distributing action item summaries with clear ownership and timelines
  • Developing and maintaining SOPs, workflow documentation, and process improvements
  • Identifying opportunities to standardize and scale implementation and operational processes across the portfolio
  • Scheduling and coordinating logistics for internal and cross-functional performance-related meetings

What you'll need for success

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in healthcare operations, implementation management, project/program management, or healthcare consulting
  • Strong understanding of healthcare operations and regulatory requirements
  • Analytical mindset with proficiency in data analysis, reporting, and problem-solving
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (HubSpot preferred) and data/reporting tools
  • Fluency in the Microsoft suite, especially Excel
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and implementations simultaneously, prioritizing effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Strong written communication skills for internal reporting; meeting notes, action item summaries, and internal operational documentation must be clear, accurate, and professional
  • Ability to work independently with strong ownership and accountability for operational and implementation outcomes
  • Ability to coordinate and influence effectively across internal cross-functional stakeholders (pillar leads, leadership, technical teams)
  • Experience working with health systems or healthcare provider organizations
  • Demonstrated ability to take structured and informal feedback well, including from practice-facing colleagues, and translate it into improved internal process design; comfort operating in a function that is still maturing and adjusting its approach

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

QA Team Lead / Manager

Full-Time | Houston, TX / Remote

About ProScore.ai

ProScore.ai is building technology that makes workforce compliance easier, smarter, and more reliable for highly regulated industries. Our platform supports some of the largest construction organizations in the world, helping them manage complex compliance requirements, reduce risk, and stay prepared for audits.

When compliance, regulatory exposure, and customer trust are on the line, software quality matters.

Our engineering team is collaborative, practical, and focused on building products that perform in the real world. We're looking for an experienced QA Team Lead / Manager who can bring that same mindset to our quality organization, someone who enjoys leading people while still staying close to the technology.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on leadership role with real ownership.

You'll lead a team of 3–5 QA Engineers and take responsibility for quality across ProScore's features and releases. You'll guide testing strategy, improve processes, strengthen automation, manage team priorities, and partner directly with Product and Engineering throughout the development lifecycle.

Most importantly, QA isn't viewed as the final checkpoint at ProScore. You'll have a seat at the table, helping identify risks, challenge assumptions, improve requirements, and influence how we build software before it reaches production.

We're looking for someone who knows how to balance speed with precision, develop strong QA talent, and confidently answer one important question:

Are we ready to release?

What You'll Do

Lead Quality Strategy

Own and continuously improve our overall testing approach across functional, regression, integration, API, automation, and edge-case testing.

Lead & Develop the QA Team

Manage and mentor a team of 3–5 QA Engineers. Set priorities, balance workloads, provide technical guidance, and create an environment where engineers can grow and do their best work.

Own Release Readiness

Take ownership of QA sign-off and deployment readiness. Evaluate test results, outstanding defects, acceptance criteria, and overall risk to make clear, data-driven go/no-go recommendations.

Partner with Product & Engineering

Bring QA into the conversation early. Participate in sprint planning, review requirements for testability, identify potential gaps, and raise quality concerns before development is complete.

Strengthen Bug & Defect Management

Establish a high standard for actionable defect reporting, including clear reproduction steps, logs, network payloads, environmental details, and supporting evidence that helps Engineering move quickly.

Build Smarter Regression Coverage

Continuously evaluate the regression suite to ensure it reflects the current product. Add coverage where it creates value and retire outdated tests so the suite remains efficient, relevant, and trustworthy.

Drive Automation

Help shape and scale our automation strategy, with a focus on Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript. Ensure automation provides meaningful, maintainable coverage rather than simply increasing test counts.

Communicate Quality & Risk

Serve as a trusted voice on product quality. Translate technical testing results, defects, and release risks into clear information that Product, Engineering, and business leadership can act on.

Build for Auditability

Compliance software requires a different level of precision. You'll help create testing processes, documentation, logging, and traceability that can stand up to both internal scrutiny and external audit requirements.

What We're Looking For

QA Leadership & Experience

  • 5–10 years of hands-on Quality Assurance experience

  • At least 2 years of experience leading or managing QA/engineering teams

  • Proven experience owning test planning, strategy, execution, and release readiness

  • Experience building, developing, or scaling QA teams and processes

  • Strong understanding of functional, regression, integration, API, and risk-based testing

  • Experience working closely with Product and Engineering in Agile/Scrum environments

  • Ability to lead while remaining technically involved when needed

Technical Experience

We're looking for someone comfortable working within a modern QA environment, including:

  • Playwright strongly preferred

  • Cypress and/or Selenium

  • TypeScript / JavaScript

  • API testing and Postman

  • Network payloads, logs, and API traces

  • Jira and test management platforms such as TestRail

  • CI/CD environments including Jenkins and/or GitHub Actions

  • SQL or database validation experience is a plus

  • New Relic or similar application performance monitoring tools

You don't need to have worked with every tool in our stack. Strong fundamentals, technical curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly matter just as much.

Experience That Will Help You Stand Out

Experience within a regulated, compliance-driven, or high-risk software environment is especially valuable.

That may include:

  • FinTech

  • HealthTech

  • InsurTech

  • LegalTech

  • Construction technology

  • Workforce or payroll compliance

  • Other regulated SaaS environments

Familiarity with SOC 2, audit requirements, data integrity, traceability matrices, security/privacy considerations, or auditable test documentation is a strong plus.

Our Tech Stack

Playwright | Cypress | Selenium | TypeScript/JavaScript | Java | Postman | Jira | TestRail | Jenkins | GitHub Actions | New Relic

Why Join ProScore?

Your Work Has Real Impact

We're solving complex compliance challenges where accuracy matters. The software your team validates helps organizations manage regulatory requirements, protect their businesses, and make better decisions.

You'll Have Real Ownership

This isn't a QA function sitting at the end of the development process. You'll help define what quality looks like at ProScore and have the authority to influence how and when we release software.

You'll Build, Not Just Maintain

We already have experienced people and processes in place, but we're still growing. You'll have the opportunity to improve our QA organization, strengthen automation, develop the team, and help establish practices that can scale with the company.

You'll Work With a Team That Values Quality

Our Engineering and Product teams understand that QA isn't simply about finding bugs — it's about building better software. You'll work alongside people who value thoughtful testing, strong communication, accountability, and continuous improvement.

The Timing Is Right

We're established enough that you won't be walking into chaos, but we're still early enough that your ideas can have a lasting impact.

If you're a QA leader who enjoys building teams, improving processes, staying technically engaged, and taking real ownership of software quality, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
The Federal Proposal Manager will be responsible for leading BayNova’s end-to-end Federal proposal development lifecycle while serving as a key leader within the company’s growth organization. This role will ensure BayNova consistently submits high-quality, compliant, and compelling proposals while helping mature the people, processes, tools, and content that support sustainable business growth across Federal Civilian, Health, and DoW markets.

Proposal leadership is the primary responsibility of this role and represents the company’s highest growth priority. The Proposal Manager is expected to balance broader growth initiatives with the timely delivery of winning proposals, ensuring proposal excellence remains the primary focus of the role.

The Proposal Manager works closely with executive leadership, BD/Capture/Sales, technical subject matter experts, delivery teams, partners, and subcontractors to translate customer requirements into winning proposals. Beyond proposal leadership, the role contributes to capture planning, market research, marketing initiatives, customer engagement planning, corporate capabilities development, and continuous improvement of the company’s growth processes.

This position reports directly to executive leadership and plays a critical role in achieving the company’s strategic growth objectives.

This is a remote position.

Role Priorities

While this position contributes across multiple aspects of the company’s growth organization, responsibilities are prioritized as follows:

  1. Lead the successful development and submission of winning proposals.
  2. Develop and mature the proposal infrastructure, tools, reusable content, and processes that improve long-term growth effectiveness.
  3. Support business development, capture, marketing, and delivery activities where those efforts directly strengthen active pursuits or position the company for future opportunities.

As the company grows, the scope of this role may expand to include broader ownership of growth operations and/or leadership of additional growth personnel.

Key Responsibilities

Proposal Leadership (Primary Responsibility)

  • Lead the complete proposal lifecycle (RFIs, Sources Soughts, RFP, RFQs, etc.) from opportunity qualification through submission and post-submission lessons learned
  • Write Technical, Management, Past Performance and other sections as needed to respond to customer requirements
  • Develop proposal schedules, compliance matrices, outlines, storyboards, and production plans.
  • Manage proposal teams consisting of technical/delivery staff, pricing, contracts, recruiting, and executive leadership.
  • Drive proposal strategy, win themes, discriminators, messaging, and customer-focused content.
  • Ensure proposal compliance with solicitation requirements, evaluation criteria, and submission instructions.
  • Coordinate color team reviews (Pink, Red, Gold, White Glove) and ensure timely incorporation of reviewer feedback.
  • Oversee proposal production, quality assurance, formatting, graphics coordination, and final submission.
  • Maintain proposal repositories, templates, boilerplate content, resumes, past performance libraries, and proposal knowledge management assets.
  • Analyze proposal metrics and implement continuous process improvements to increase proposal quality and win rates.

Business Development & Capture Support

  • Partner with business development personnel to qualify opportunities aligned with company strategy.
  • Assess opportunities posted to eBuy, SAM.gov, etc. and provide pursuit recommendations.
  • Participate in bid/no-bid decisions.
  • Support capture planning activities including competitive analysis, customer research, teaming strategies, and win strategy development.
  • Assist in developing executive summaries, capability statements, and customer presentation materials.
  • Coordinate with teaming partners throughout capture and proposal efforts.
  • Help maintain visibility into the opportunity pipeline to support proposal planning and resource forecasting.

Marketing & Corporate Communications

  • Collaborate on the development of corporate capabilities materials, solution briefs, white papers, case studies, and other customer-facing content.
  • Support marketing initiatives that directly enable business development and proposal efforts. Ownership of broader corporate marketing activities may reside elsewhere within the organization as the company grows.
  • Help maintain corporate messaging, differentiators, and solution positioning.
  • Coordinate announcements related to contract awards, certifications, partnerships, and company achievements, as appropriate.

Delivery & Operations Collaboration

  • Coordinate with delivery leadership to identify reusable technical content, past performance, and staffing resources.
  • Capture lessons learned from project execution to strengthen future proposals.
  • Support transition activities between proposal and program startup when required.
  • Assist with customer presentations, oral proposals, and technical demonstrations.

Growth Process Management

  • Continuously improve the company’s proposal and growth processes, templates, tools, and knowledge repositories, prioritizing initiatives that directly improve proposal quality, efficiency, and win probability.
  • Track key growth metrics including proposal throughput, submission quality, win rate, and proposal resource utilization.
  • Develop and maintain reusable proposal assets, including templates, graphics, standard language, proposal checklists, and knowledge repositories.
  • Own the company’s past performance repository, resume library, and proposal content management strategy.
  • Evaluate and implement AI-assisted proposal development tools and workflows that improve proposal quality and team productivity.
  • Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of proposal operations.
  • Support strategic planning and annual growth initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 8+ years of experience supporting Federal Government proposal management, capture, business development, or growth operations.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex Federal proposals under FAR-based procurements.
  • Strong understanding of Federal proposal best practices, compliance management, and proposal review methodologies.
  • Experience supporting opportunities across Federal Civilian agencies and/or the Department of Defense.
  • Excellent written, editing, and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and proposal collaboration tools.

Preferred

  • APMP Foundation, Practitioner, or Professional Certification.
  • Experience supporting digital modernization, low-code platforms, AI, cloud, cybersecurity, or enterprise IT services.
  • Experience with GSA MAS, GWACs, BPAs, IDIQs, and task order competitions.
  • Familiarity with Shipley proposal methodologies.
  • Experience supporting oral presentations and demonstrations.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted proposal development or knowledge management solutions.

Desired Characteristics

The successful candidate is both a strategic thinker and a hands-on executor who enjoys building repeatable processes while delivering exceptional proposals under demanding deadlines. They thrive in an entrepreneurial environment, are comfortable wearing multiple hats, and understand how to balance immediate revenue-generating priorities with longer-term investments in growth capabilities.

They are collaborative, highly organized, customer-focused, and continuously seek opportunities to improve the effectiveness of the company’s growth organization through better processes, tools, content, and teamwork.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Consistent delivery of high-quality, compliant, and compelling proposals submitted on time.
  • Increased proposal win rates and overall proposal effectiveness.
  • Continuous improvement of proposal operations, reusable assets, and growth infrastructure.
  • Effective collaboration across business development, capture, delivery, marketing, and executive leadership.
  • Development of scalable proposal processes and AI-enabled capabilities that improve efficiency over time.
  • Meaningful contributions to the company’s long-term growth strategy while maintaining proposal excellence as the highest operational priority.

  • Help build the operational controls and evidence practices needed as Domino supports increasingly complex and regulated customer environments.
  • Leave the service easier to operate than you found it: recurring problems should increasingly become standardized, automated, delegated, or eliminated rather than simply handled faster.

What we look for in this role

  • Experience working with production cloud or SaaS environments in roles such as Cloud Operations, Production Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Operations, DevOps, Application Operations, or a similar technical operations function.

  • Ability to collaborate across engineering and customer-facing teams, make unclear ownership visible, and help turn operational problems into actionable improvements.

  • You do not need to be a dedicated software or platform engineer. Some scripting or infrastructure-as-code experience is helpful, but this role is primarily about technical operations, sound judgment, service ownership, and continuous improvement.

What we value

Who are we?

Today is a particularly exciting time to join our team, we closed our Series A financing round in late 2022 and will be starting the Series B rounds in the coming year. jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a defining opportunity for a Senior Product Manager to own how every Samsara device comes to life.

Samsara ships hundreds of thousands of devices a year to fleets, construction sites, and depots worldwide. A single customer rollout can exceed 50,000 devices, where every minute saved per install compounds into weeks of deployment time. Each device has a five-minute window where it goes from a box in someone's hands to a live sensor feeding a customer's operation. You will own those five minutes and the multi-year vision for what they become.

The install experience is critical to the compounding value of every Samsara product. A camera aimed correctly on day one trains better safety models. A gateway reporting cleanly makes every downstream workflow trustworthy.

You will own the software install experience end to end, with a dedicated engineering and design team, and you will own one number: install correctness, the share of installs completed right on the first attempt. Correctness today swings by several points depending on whether the installer uses the Samsara Fleet App, and closing that gap for every install is the first prize. Your target is an install under five minutes of active app time that confirms its own health before the installer walks away.

You are building for two people who each get the same five minutes. A contracted technician on their twentieth install of the day wants speed. A customer's shop mechanic on their first wants guidance that assumes nothing. Both are standing in a truck bay, holding a phone, sometimes without signal.

To understand the scale of this problem, review the Samsara Vehicle Gateway here, our full hardware lineup here, and our installer partner network here.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the three-year vision for device installation and provisioning, defining how Samsara hardware comes online as the platform expands across new products, device types, and geographies.
  • Own install correctness. Set the target, instrument the funnel so every outcome is attributable, and move the number quarter over quarter.
  • Own the guided install and verification flow in the Samsara Fleet app, for professional installers and for customers who install hardware themselves.
  • Build the intelligence that verifies an install is correct, checking camera aim, wiring, and signal quality while the installer is still standing at the vehicle.
  • Give operations leaders a live view of fleet readiness: what is installed, what is verified, and what is producing data.
  • Ride along on installs and run sessions in customer yards, then turn what you observe into roadmap that shapes hardware, firmware, and software decisions.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles as we scale globally.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 7+ years of product management experience shipping products used by external customers.
  • A record of owning a business or product metric and changing its trajectory, with a before and after you can walk us through.
  • Experience building something from zero to one without a spec, a defined customer, or a playbook.
  • Technical depth sufficient for engineers to treat you as a peer: a degree in Computer Science or Engineering, prior experience as an engineer, or demonstrated fluency in system architecture trade-offs.
  • Proven ability to operate at both altitudes, setting multi-year direction and reviewing the details of a screen flow in the same week.
  • Executive-level communication and presence, comfortable presenting and defending strategy to the CEO, CPO, and customers.
  • Based in a North American time zone. We will consider strong candidates in Europe.

We do not require prior experience with hardware, vehicles, telematics, or field installation. We hire for technical depth, evidence of building from zero to one, and a record of owning a number and moving it.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building mobile products for people who work with their hands, in loud, time-pressured, or offline conditions.
  • A habit of primary research, with specific examples of what watching a customer taught you that a dashboard could not.
  • Prior work on products where software and hardware depend on each other.
  • Experience instrumenting a funnel and running experiments against it.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$130,602—$219,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.description:
About Scale

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

About the Role

We are looking for a mid-level Data Analyst who is far more than a report builder. You are a "Data Detective" who understands the heartbeat of the customer journey.

You will not just analyze data; you will own the truth behind our Customer Retention and Lifecycle. We need a Lifecycle Data Master who understands the nuances of CRM and loyalty platforms (Klaviyo, Loyalty Lion) and is an expert in churn analysis, cohort tracking, and LTV maximization.

Additionally, you will act as a critical partner to our Brand and Retention teams, bridging the gap between raw behavioral data, email/SMS performance, and long-term brand loyalty.

What You’ll Do

1. Retention & Lifecycle Mastery

  • Deep-Dive Analytics: Ingest, clean, and analyze complex datasets from our CRM and loyalty platforms (Klaviyo, Loyalty Lion) to provide granular insights on LTV, repeat purchase rates, and cohort degradation.
  • Churn & Retention Expert: Build robust churn prediction models and identify drop-off points in the customer journey to help the retention team intervene effectively.
  • Lifecycle Support: Empower the marketing team with actionable data on email/SMS campaign performance, segment health, loyalty program engagement, and channel efficiency.

2. Brand & Customer Experience Analytics

  • Customer Journey Mapping: Analyze the post-purchase funnel to understand how product usage, subscription models, and brand interactions drive repeat behavior.
  • Loyalty Program Optimization: Act as the lead investigator for our loyalty data. Track earn/burn rates of reward points, VIP tier migrations, and the incremental value of our rewards program.
  • Reporting: Generate reports that align brand initiatives and CRM metrics with overall revenue growth and overall customer health.

3. Data Transformation & Visualization

  • Data Preparation: While we have a Data Engineer managing the infrastructure, you will handle the "last mile" of data prep. You will use KNIME or dbt (or similar tools like Alteryx, Tableau Prep, or Python/Pandas) to clean, merge, and format data for specific analyses.
  • Business Logic Application: Write efficient SQL to transform raw log-level data in Snowflake into usable datasets that reflect our specific business rules (e.g., defining "active vs. lapsed vs. churned" customer logic).
  • Dashboarding: Design, build, and maintain high-impact dashboards in Tableau. You will translate complex SQL queries into visual stories for stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For

The Essentials (Experience & Tech Stack)

  • Experience Level: 3 years of specific Data Analysis experience. (We are not looking for Junior Analysts or Senior Data Architects; we need a hands-on mid-level executor).
  • Industry: Proven experience in DTC E-commerce is required. You must be fluent in Shopify and Amazon Seller Central data schemas.
  • Warehousing & BI: Strong proficiency with Snowflake (SQL) and Tableau (LOD expressions, complex visualizations).
  • Transformation Tools: Competency in KNIME or dbt is preferred, but we are open to candidates experienced with Alteryx, Prep, or Python who can adapt quickly.
  • ELT Familiarity: Awareness of how ELT tools (like Hevo, Fivetran, Airbyte, Azure, etc.) function, so you can communicate effectively with our Data Engineer when pipeline adjustments are needed.

The "Lifecycle & Retention Master" Skill Set

  • You are deeply versed in the data schemas of Klaviyo and Loyalty Lion, understanding how to extract and model complex email, SMS, and rewards program data.
  • You have hands-on experience conducting complex churn analysis, cohort retention modeling, and LTV forecasting.
  • You intimately understand the nuances of lifecycle metrics and can easily analyze the true impact of deliverability, Apple's Mail Privacy Protection (MPP) on open rates, click-to-purchase rates, and SMS unsubscribe behaviors.

The Brand & Customer Mindset

  • You are comfortable working with subscription metrics (MRR, churn rate, retention curves, payback periods).
  • You have the patience and precision to trace a single customer's journey through multiple touchpoints (a purchase, an email open, an SMS click, a loyalty redemption) to understand their true lifetime value.

What We Offer

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Fully remote, full-time position
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend
  • Generous paid time off program
  • Discounted products
  • An amazing team to work alongside

Candidates should be able and willing to travel as needed to fulfill the responsibilities of the role.

About the team and what we’ll build together

The Marketing Operations team is Kobie’s campaign execution engine — delivering outbound loyalty communications for some of the world’s most recognized brands. Organized into three pillars (Campaign Management, Development, and Quality Assurance), the team builds and deploys high-volume, personalized email campaigns that reach millions of loyalty members. As a Marketing Ops Developer, you’ll sit at the heart of that delivery — owning the HTML and journey development that brings each campaign to life. You’ll work closely with Campaign Managers, QA Analysts, and client teams to ensure every send is accurate, on-brand, and on time.

How you will make an impact

As a Marketing Ops Developer, you own the technical execution of campaigns from build through deployment. You’ll work across two core areas:

HTML Email Development

  • Develop and maintain HTML/CSS email templates — ensuring accurate rendering across devices, email clients, and platforms
  • Build reusable modular components and adapt client-specific templates to campaign requirements
  • Test email rendering across clients and devices using tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid

Journey & Campaign Development

  • Build and deploy outbound campaigns (primarily email) in Kobie-hosted platforms and client campaign management systems including Salesforce Marketing Cloud
  • Configure journey logic, audience segmentation, targeting rules, and suppression lists per campaign specifications
  • Implement dynamic content, personalization tokens, and promotional offer logic according to strategy requirements
  • Own the final deployment step for all assigned campaigns — ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery

Execution & Collaboration

  • Execute A/B and multivariate (MVT) test configurations according to defined test plans
  • Coordinate asset handoffs with Campaign Managers and content partners; flag dependency gaps proactively
  • Document execution best practices and maintain build standards within the Development pillar
  • Follow platform tooling standards and governance guidelines established by Campaign Management

At the end of the first year, success means: campaigns build accurately and on schedule, builds consistently pass QA with minimal rework, and platform standards and SOPs are followed without prompting

What you need to be successful

Required

  • 1–3 years of experience in email development, marketing operations, or digital campaign execution
  • Hands-on experience with HTML and CSS for email, including cross-client rendering
  • Experience with at least one enterprise campaign platform — Salesforce Marketing Cloud preferred
  • Foundational understanding of journey orchestration — able to build single and multi-step automated flows, triggered sends, and entry/exit criteria within a campaign platform
  • Familiarity with campaign automation concepts: event-based triggers, lifecycle programs, re-engagement flows, and scheduled vs. triggered deployment
  • Understanding of A/B and MVT testing mechanics — able to configure test variants, split audiences, and execute test sends according to a defined test plan
  • Understanding of audience segmentation, targeting logic, and data-driven personalization
  • Strong attention to detail; proactive about catching discrepancies before campaigns go to QA
  • Clear communicator — able to flag issues and ask the right questions before builds begin
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Preferred

  • Experience with Litmus, Email on Acid, or equivalent rendering test tools
  • Familiarity with AMPScript, SQL, or other scripting/query languages used in campaign platforms
  • Experience with additional ESPs such as Adobe Campaign, Braze, Iterable, or Marketo
  • Knowledge of dynamic content and conditional content logic within campaign platforms
  • Exposure to multi-channel or cross-channel campaign orchestration (email + SMS, push, or direct mail)
  • Experience using project/workflow management tools such as Workfront or Jira

About TTM

TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

Material Qualification Lead & Special Projects

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Project Management leader with experience in the Printed Circuit Board (PCB) industry to join our team. This individual will play a critical role in supporting material qualification initiatives, managing end-of-life transitions, driving process improvements, and ensuring the highest standards of quality across our supply chain and manufacturing operations. The ideal candidate thrives in a cross-functional environment and is passionate about continuous improvement and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Material Qualification

Lead and coordinate material qualification projects for PCB raw materials in accordance with established qualification plans.

  • Review, analyze, and interpret test reports and qualification data to determine material acceptability.
  • Maintain comprehensive qualification records and ensure compliance with internal and customer specifications.
  • Work through UL planning and UL database management

End of Life (EOL) Tracking

  • Monitor and manage End-of-Life (EOL) notifications for components, materials, and processes used in PCB manufacturing.
  • Work with TTM Purchasing and sites to develop and execute mitigation strategies including last-time buys, alternative sourcing, and design or material substitutions.
  • Maintain an up-to-date EOL tracking database and communicate status to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.

Supply Chain & Supplier Interface

  • Serve as the primary quality liaison between internal supply chain personnel and external suppliers.
  • Conduct supplier quality reviews, audits, and performance evaluations to ensure adherence to quality standards.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to resolve quality issues, implement corrective actions, and drive continuous improvement.

Process Change Notice (PCN) Management

  • Drive process changes within the Product/Process Change Notice (PCN) workflow, ensuring all changes are properly documented, evaluated, and approved.
  • Assess the impact of supplier- or internally-initiated process changes on product quality and customer requirements.
  • Maintain PCN project logs and coordinate cross-functional reviews to ensure timely disposition and closure.

Customer Notification & Follow-Up

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry.
jobs.description:
Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

We Are Looking for a Customer Success Manager Who Thinks Strategically, Communicates Exceptionally, and Puts Customers First

We are seeking a sharp, driven, and deeply customer-focused professional with experience in CPG trade management to join our Customer Success team. This is not a support role. It is a strategic partnership role. You will own the outcomes of the accounts you manage, proactively guiding customers toward measurable business value and deeper adoption of the Vividly platform.

If you are a self-starter who leads with curiosity, communicates with clarity and confidence, and knows how to turn data into insights and insights into action, you will thrive here. We need someone who has lived on the front lines of Small to Midsize Business (SMB) Trade, someone who understands the complexity of trade spend and can translate that expertise into transformational customer partnerships.

Key Responsibilities and Impact

  • Lead with strategy, not just service. Build deep, trusted relationships with customers by acting as a proactive strategic advisor, not a reactive problem-solver. Guide customers toward their goals before they know they need guidance.
  • Apply critical thinking to every account. Analyze customer usage patterns, platform data, and business context to identify adoption gaps, risks, and growth opportunities. Translate what you see into clear recommendations and action plans that drive measurable outcomes.
  • Communicate with precision and purpose. Own every customer interaction, written, verbal, and in-meeting, with the clarity and confidence of someone who respects the customer's time and leads conversations with intention. This means clear agendas, concise follow-ups, and proactive outreach that adds value before customers ask for it.
  • Champion the customer's success internally. Serve as the voice of your customers across product, sales, and marketing. Surface feedback, patterns, and risks with the evidence to back them up. Advocate for improvements that create better outcomes across the entire customer base.
  • Drive platform adoption and user expansion. Don't just onboard; embed. Identify underutilized features, low-adoption users, and untapped teams within your accounts. Design enablement strategies that scale beyond one-on-one training and create organizational dependency on the Vividly platform.
  • Multi-thread your accounts. Build relationships across each organization, not just with your primary contact. Identify champions, executive sponsors, power users, and operational stakeholders. Proactively protect against single points of failure.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with structure. Partner with specialists, product, and sales teams to build repeatable, well-documented customer success playbooks. Every customer should have a clear success plan, defined milestones, and documented outcomes.
  • Represent Vividly as a TPM thought leader. Help shape the industry conversation. We want CSMs who can contribute to best practices, case studies, and community conversations that position Vividly as the definitive platform for SMB CPG trade management.
  • Set boundaries that protect your strategic value. Redirect technical support and break-fix issues to the appropriate Support channels. Your role is to own strategy, adoption, and outcomes, not to be a one-person help desk.

You Will Be Successful With

  • 5+ years of experience in Trade Promotion Management - you understand the complexity of trade spend and can speak the customer's language from day one
  • CPG industry experience is strongly recommended - deductions, accruals, and general trade finance experience strongly preferred; POS data and TPM software experience are a significant plus
  • Strong critical thinking skills - you can analyze ambiguous situations, connect disparate signals, and develop clear, evidence-based recommendations without being told what to look for
  • An authentically customer-first mindset - you measure your success by your customers' outcomes, not your task completion rate; you anticipate needs, not just respond to them
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills - you write follow-up emails that customers actually read, you run meetings that end with clarity, and you can tailor your message to an operations manager and a C-suite executive in the same week
  • Proactive account leadership - you don't wait for customers to come to you; you show up with insights, recommendations, and a point of view
  • Technical aptitude with SaaS platforms - you are comfortable navigating and explaining complex software and can help customers get the most out of the tools they have
  • Comfort with ambiguity and change - you thrive in a fast-moving startup environment and know how to build process where there isn't one yet
  • A GSD (Get Stuff Done) attitude - paired with the judgment to know which things are worth doing, which should be delegated, and which should be handed off entirely

Why This Role Matters

Customer Success at Vividly is not account management. It is the difference between a customer who renews and one who becomes a reference. Between a platform that gets used and one that becomes indispensable. Between a company that grows because of its customers and one that grows despite losing them.

If you want to own that difference, and have the skills, experience, and mindset to drive it, we want to hear from you.

This role is a critical part of Vividly's growth. We hire for outcomes, not activity. Show us how you think, how you communicate, and how you put customers first, and we'll show you what it looks like to build something that matters.

Why Choose Vividly?

A modern, remote-first workplace

We are committed to succeeding as a fully remote team, empowering you with the flexibility to thrive, no commute required. Every Vividly team member receives a stipend upon hire to help create a comfortable, productive home office.

Vividly days off & flexible PTO

For most USA holidays that fall on a Monday or Friday, we turn it into a 4 day weekend! Vividly also offers Flexible Time Off (and we really mean it) to help prevent burn out and fuel creativity.

Competitive Benefits

  • Healthcare, Dental and Vision - We cover 100% of your monthly premiums and 50% of all dependents
  • 401(k) - With a 3% employer contribution
  • Weekly $20 Sharebite Meal Stipend - For every meal you purchase, they donate a meal through Feeding America!
  • Monthly $50 Wellness Reimbursement
  • Monthly $200 Remote Work Stipend

Commitment to our values - The Vividly Code

  • Kind Ambition -We push boundaries with empathy and integrity
  • Keep It Real - We are transparent, honest, and authentic
  • Customer Love - We act as trusted advisors to our customers
  • Own It - We take responsibility and drive outcomes
  • Urgency Wins - We move quickly and focus on impact
  • Pull Together - We collaborate to win as a team

Please note: Vividly will never request sensitive information such as your social security number, bank account information, or other non-publicly available information during the application and interview process. If an applicant is extended an offer of employment, such sensitive information will be requested at that time during the onboarding process. Vividly will never ask you to receive and ship packages or goods as part of the interview. Other practices to be on alert for:

  • Contact initiated via unsolicited text message or cold call. Vividly does not follow up with candidates through instant messaging applications.
  • Our Talent Acquisition team only corresponds from email addresses with the domain ‘@govividly.com’. If a generic email ID ending with Gmail/Yahoo or other domain is used while receiving a job offer or interview call, there is a likelihood of a scammer.
  • While some of our jobs can be found on third party job sites, all of our current job opportunities and descriptions are posted on Vividly’s Careers page, or our official LinkedIn Company Page

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Medicare Advantage Portfolio Strategy & Analytics
jobs.excerpt: Job Description A bit about this role: The analysis behind Devoted's Medicare Advantage portfolio — which markets to grow in, which products to invest in, which benefit designs and cost structures actually work, creating those benefits — is driven today by a very small number of people.
jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

The analysis behind Devoted's Medicare Advantage portfolio — which markets to grow in, which products to invest in, which benefit designs and cost structures actually work, creating those benefits — is driven today by a very small number of people. This team sits between claims analytics, product strategy, engineering, and actuarial, and is rebuilding how the portfolio and bid cycle work using agentic workflows and AI-assisted pipelines.

This is not a reporting role. You'll own the strategic thinking and the pipework underneath it, often on the same day — there's no analyst between you and the data — and you'll see the whole picture — we'll expect you to have an opinion about it.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • The analysis behind portfolio decisions. Product and service area mix — where we push growth and where we protect margin. You won't always be handed a question list; you'll help decide which questions matter.

  • Cost and utilization work that answers the actual question. Decompose PMPM trend into utilization versus unit cost, build comparison groups you can defend when someone attacks them, and honestly size what a benefit change or network change will really do to claims.

  • Independent financial judgment on benefit designs. Our own estimate of what a design does to revenue and cost, plus a clear sense of how much weight that estimate can bear. You'd own that work and be direct about its limits.

  • Recommendations leadership can act on. Present data-backed recommendations to senior leaders regularly, including the CEO, and defend them live.

  • Building the infrastructure, not just using it. We're rebuilding how the portfolio and bid cycle work with agentic workflows, AI-assisted code generation, and automated pipelines that turn what used to be weeks of manual work into something that runs overnight. This team is at the center of that build, and you'll push these tools into territory nobody here has tried yet.

  • Go-to-market support. Once plans are filed, build the analyses go-to-market runs on, supporting marketing, sales, and brokers with a clear read on where our plans compete well and who they're built for.

  • AEP monitoring. Track enrollment as it comes in against what the bid assumed: volume by plan and county, product mix, and the profile of who's choosing us. When something is moving the wrong way, you're the one who catches it early enough for us to do something about it.

  • Being the person people come to. When someone needs to know whether a metric is built the right way or whether the data is being read correctly, you're the answer, not a ticket to another department.

Required skills and experience:

  • Six or more years in Medicare Advantage with your hands in the data. You know how claims are structured, what place-of-service and revenue codes tell you, the difference between allowed and paid, how completion factors work, and how risk adjustment feeds into all of it. You've been burned by a bad pull before, and you know what you check now because of it.

  • Cost and utilization analytics. PMPM trend broken into utilization versus unit cost, clean comparison groups, sizing the impact of a benefit or network change. You know the difference between a number that moved and a number that means something.

  • Strong SQL and real comfort in a large claims warehouse (Snowflake, Databricks, or similar).

  • Analysis you've turned into strategy and defended. You've dug into claims data, formed your own point of view about what a company should do differently, and taken it to senior leadership — then handled the questions that came back, including the ones aimed at your method. You can hold your own with actuaries without being one.

  • End-to-end ownership without scaffolding. Finding the data, sanity-checking it, modeling it, presenting it.

  • The one-slide skill. You can put a complicated result on a single slide or Slack message without losing what's true about it.

  • A collaborator, not a lone operator. This team is small enough that how you work with people matters as much as how good your analysis is. You share work before it's finished, you're direct without being sharp about it, and you're generous with what you know. We're remote and in constant communication. Nobody here is above any task, including the tedious ones.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Bid math. Every June, MA plans file a bid with CMS that sets the following year's revenue, benefits, and premiums — it's the annual event the entire portfolio is built around. If you know benchmarks, rebates, and benefit valuation, and you understand how bid assumptions constrain where the portfolio can go, that matters a great deal here. Having lived through a real bid cycle in some capacity counts for a lot.

  • Optimization, Python, or actuarial training pointed at strategy. Benefit design, network configuration, or allocation problems framed and solved as constrained optimization. Python for analysis and modeling — pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn, and comfort with clustering, regression, PCA, and trees. An ASA or FSA is not required, but if you have actuarial training and you've concluded you want strategy and product work over pure pricing, that's a profile we especially welcome.

  • Fluent, practical use of AI tools. You already use AI in your analytical work as part of how you get things done and you're interested in pushing it further. Everyone on this team is expected to work this way.

Salary range: $110,500 - $,173,000 / year
