jobs.excerpt: About PrePassPrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform.
jobs.description:
About PrePass

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We're transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It's what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That's why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

Position Description

We are seeking a Total Rewards Manager to join our Human Resources team. Reporting to the Vice President of Human Resources, this role is pivotal in enhancing the employee experience through strategic initiatives. This is an Individual Contributor role, working with a great group of HR professionals! You can be based in Phoenix and work a hybrid schedule, or you can work remotely. Location is not a priority—hiring the candidate who likes to think strategically and execute is what matters!

Compensation

  • Conduct market analyses and benchmarking that result in informed compensation decisions. Leverage compensation data (i.e., Culpepper and Radford).
  • Measure compensation program effectiveness and equity.
  • Design and manage grade structures. Oversee job evaluation, and utilize and maintain compensation-related tools to ensure the accuracy of job pricing data.
  • Collaborate with management on requests for compensation-related data (e.g., internal equity analysis, retention, market, and bonus recommendations).
  • Develop various pay policies and programs.
  • Design, implement, communicate, and measure effectiveness of incentive pay and bonus plans, including commission plans.
  • Review compensation practices for compliance (e.g., FLSA).
  • Participate in the headcount budget planning process by partnering with leaders on compensation requests.
  • Own the salary budget planning process, including promotion requests, merit increase, equity.

Benefits

  • Design, implement, and administer all Health and Wellness programs, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, retirement, and other ancillary programs, to ensure plans are competitive, fair, and affordable.
  • Research plans and providers to develop benefits programs that optimize costs and meet organizational goals (i.e., position as employer of choice, competitive).
  • Facilitate benefit plan design, selection, renewal, and communications, along with policy and procedure development, implementation, and interpretation.
  • Maintain knowledge of benefit trends and regulations to ensure new trends/regulations are incorporated into current and future benefit programs, and to differentiate the company as an employer of choice.
  • Lead annual open enrollment processes, including communication strategies and vendor management.
  • Manage the regulated aspects of benefits, including 5500 processing and non-discrimination testing, 401(k), HSA, and FSA management, and workers' compensation (e.g., ERISA, COBRA, HIPAA, FMLA, ACA, 5500s, non-discrimination testing, interaction with plan auditors), minimum wage, EEO categorization, required notices, and FLSA audits.
  • Ensure the accuracy of benefits data, including employee, payroll, and provider premium reconciliation and billing.
  • Drive employee-focused education initiatives, material distribution, and tools, while ensuring the accuracy of benefit program data.
  • Stay informed on industry regulations, trends, and standards, and guide necessary organizational changes.

Total Rewards Strategy, Recognition & Wellness

  • Own, evolve and elevate the company's holistic Total Rewards philosophy, ensuring compensation, benefits, recognition, and wellness programs work together to attract, retain, and engage top talent.
  • Design and administer employee recognition programs (peer-to-peer, service milestones, performance-based) that reinforce company values and culture.
  • Develop and manage wellness initiatives spanning physical, mental, and financial well-being, including the lifestyle account, EAP utilization, and partnerships with wellness vendors.
  • Measure the impact and ROI of recognition and wellness programs through participation data, engagement surveys, and retention metrics; adjust programs based on findings.
  • Benchmark recognition and wellness offerings against industry standards and competitors to keep the company's offerings differentiated and cost-effective.
  • Partner with Business leaders, Culture Team and internal communications to promote awareness and utilization of Total Rewards, recognition, and wellness programs across the organization.
  • Create scalable frameworks and toolkits that empower managers to recognize and reward employees in real time.
  • Develop, implement, and measure the effectiveness of the overall Total Rewards Strategy, including analyzing existing programs and presenting alternative best-practice options (e.g., performance management, internship program, other ancillary benefits).
  • Present Total Rewards, recognition, and wellness strategy and outcomes to HR leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Oversee the new hire and rewards SWAG program.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resource Management, Business, or a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 7+ years of benefits and compensation program management.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute compensation and benefits strategies that enhance the employee experience.
  • Experience designing or managing employee recognition and/or wellness programs, with a track record of measuring program effectiveness.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization.

Preferred

  • Professional certifications such as Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) or Certified Employee Benefits Specialist (CEBS).
  • Experience with recognition platforms or wellness program vendors.
  • Experience with sales/commission plans

Benefits

How We Will Take Care of You

  • Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.
  • Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.
  • 401(k) plan with employer match.
  • Company-funded “lifestyle account” upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships).
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program.
  • Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts.
  • Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you).
  • Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.
  • Community Give-Back initiatives.
  • Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

Join Us

At PrePass, our mission drives us.

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.

Role Title: Exocentric Video Recorder

micro1 is engaging Exocentric Video Recorders to support a customer’s project focused on capturing high-quality, naturalistic video data. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

We are looking for individuals to collect video of themselves performing natural, everyday activities across a variety of indoor, outdoor, and vehicle environments. Collection may include third-person recordings of everyday activities as well as vehicle navigation tasks.

Requirements

You must already own or have access to a compatible camera with:

  1. A minimum 170° field of view (FOV)
  2. A minimum recording resolution of 720p
  3. Examples of the recording style we are after: [Link 1][Link 2]

Compatible camera examples include:

  1. Insta360 X3, X4, X5, X6
  2. DJI Osmo 360
  3. GoPro MAX, MAX2
  4. Other action or 360° cameras that meet the minimum 170° FOV and 720p requirements

Examples of compatible third-person mounting rigs include:

  1. Insta360 Third-Person Backpack Mount and other harness-mounted extension systems.
  2. Owning a compatible backpack or vehicle mount is a plus and may let you start collecting sooner.

Third-Person Camera Setup

  1. Mounted above and behind you
  2. Angled slightly downward
  3. Positioned far enough back to keep your entire body consistently visible
  4. Stable enough to maintain the required third-person perspective during normal movement

If using a camera with less than 360° FOV, the mounting setup must position the camera far enough away to keep your entire body in frame while also capturing the surrounding environment. Your full body should remain visible throughout normal movement without frequently leaving the frame.

Handheld selfie sticks, chest mounts, shoulder clips, and stationary tripods do not meet the required third-person perspective.

Expected Recording Tasks may include:

  1. Natural everyday activities
  2. Indoor and outdoor activities
  3. Walking and moving through different environments
  4. Vehicle navigation and driving-related recordings
  5. Other similar real-world activities provided in the collection instructions

For vehicle navigation tasks, the camera must be securely mounted to the vehicle.

Recording Requirements

  1. Capture a variety of activities and environments
  2. Each continuous clip must be at least 60 seconds long

jobs.description:

Our specialties include cybersecurity, cloud modernization, software development, data analytics, enterprise architecture, enterprise IT, analytics, process automation, and artificial intelligence. Learn more about 9th Way Insignia at

Application password: Niner

Team (Project) Introduction
The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Cybersecurity Operations Systems Engineering (COSE) project serves as an overarching technical engine that unifies Architecture and Engineering Services throughout the VA Enterprise. This program implements cohesive organizational security architecture and underlying engineering components that utilize national security standards, guidelines, and frameworks. COSE bridges the gap between high-level business requirements and technical structures, enabling the consistent deployment of secure technologies through implementation guidance and the establishment of an analytic library. Systems security engineering within COSE contributes a holistic perspective to the systems engineering effort, ensuring that stakeholder protection needs are addressed throughout the entire system life cycle from concept and development to production, support, and decommissioning. By drawing upon well-established systems engineering and security principles, COSE adapts and supplements practices to protect intellectual property, data, and the methods used to create VA systems. These activities improve the security posture of VA applications to prevent, deter, or detract from cyberattacks by nefarious adversaries or insider threats.

9th Way Insignia is looking for a Hybrid Manager/Technical Lead (Technical Skills), Technical Lead Chief Security Architect / Engineer to join this team.

Professional Level Information:
A Hybrid Manager at 9th Way Insignia accomplishes department objectives by managing staff and processes and evaluating department activities. Focuses on leading a team and working hands-on with projects involving technology. Hybrid Managers require skills and qualifications such as exceptional leadership, communication and interpersonal skills.

Functional Job (LCAT) Information:
The Technical Lead Chief Security Architect / Engineer will serve as the senior technical authority for cybersecurity architecture and engineering activities supporting the VA COSE program. The individual will lead the development, assessment, modernization, and governance of enterprise security architectures and guide multidisciplinary engineering teams in translating mission, cybersecurity, and business requirements into secure, scalable, standards-aligned technical solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide senior-level technical leadership and architectural direction for enterprise cybersecurity architecture and engineering activities across the VA environment.
  • Serve as a principal security architecture and engineering subject matter expert, advising Government leadership, program managers, architects, engineers, and technical teams on complex cybersecurity and technology decisions.
  • Translate customer, mission, business, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements into enterprise security architectures, engineering requirements, technical strategies, and implementation guidance.
  • Lead and coordinate architecture and engineering teams to ensure technical requirements are clearly understood, assigned, implemented, and validated.
  • Conduct and oversee enterprise and system-level security architecture reviews for new, existing, and modernized systems.
  • Assess whether proposed architectures adequately address threats, vulnerabilities, regulatory requirements, security controls, and enterprise risk tolerance.
  • Perform and oversee architecture risk and gap analyses to evaluate compliance with VA and Federal policies, standards, frameworks, and strategic objectives.
  • Develop technically sound and actionable risk-mitigation strategies and architectural recommendations for identified security weaknesses.
  • Apply Zero Trust, defense-in-depth, least privilege, and secure-by-design principles to enterprise and solution architectures.
  • Lead or provide oversight for security threat modeling, including identification of attack vectors, threat actors, misuse cases, attack paths, control gaps, architectural weaknesses, residual risks, and mitigations.
  • Guide the development and maintenance of Security Reference Architectures, Solution Architectures, Security Patterns, and supporting enterprise architecture artifacts.
  • Ensure architectures include appropriate logical, physical, conceptual, network, and data-flow views and accurately represent system components, interfaces, dependencies, and security controls.
  • Ensure security architectures remain aligned with enterprise goals, cybersecurity strategies, modernization initiatives, and technology roadmaps.
  • Provide technical leadership for modernization of both legacy and emerging health IT architectures.
  • Evaluate and guide adoption or integration of emerging technologies identified in the PWS, including cloud computing, mobile technologies, Internet of Things (IoT), APIs, VR/XR, 5G, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), cryptography, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), quantum computing, and Artificial Intelligence (AI).
  • Analyze emerging technologies to determine potential security, architectural, operational, integration, compliance, and enterprise-risk implications.
  • Lead or support specialized security-posture reviews for evolving technology areas and develop associated risk findings and recommendations.
  • Perform research and analysis of complex cybersecurity, architecture, engineering, and technology problems and develop defensible technical recommendations.
  • Conduct detailed trade-off analyses of technical requirements against cost, schedule, performance, security, implementation complexity, and enterprise risk.
  • Develop strategies for resolving complex technical requirements, architectural conflicts, risks, dependencies, and implementation issues.
  • Coordinate with program and project leaders to analyze architectures during conceptual design, technical design reviews, implementation planning, and modernization activities.
  • Provide architectural oversight throughout the technology lifecycle to ensure security requirements remain incorporated from concept through implementation, operations, authorization, modernization, and retirement.
  • Lead or support development of security requirements baselines and traceability from foundational controls and architectural requirements through implementation and final Authority to Operate (ATO).
  • Review system, application, cloud, network, data, identity, and platform designs for security risks and control gaps before implementation.

  • Provide technical input supporting Federal A&A, accreditation, ATO, continuous monitoring, and risk-management activities.
  • Participate in and provide technical leadership to VA governance boards, technical review committees, engineering working groups, architecture forums, and modernization initiatives.
  • Establish and communicate architectural positions, engineering decisions, technical standards, and security requirements across multiple program and technical teams.
  • Assist in the development of VA security policies, guidelines, standards, technical positions, and white papers.
  • Develop executive and technical briefings communicating architecture findings, security posture, risks, threat analyses, technical recommendations, performance considerations, and strategic guidance.
  • Present complex cybersecurity and architectural issues in a manner appropriate for executive leadership, Government stakeholders, technical teams, engineers, and non-technical decision-makers.
  • Provide technical oversight and quality assurance for architecture and engineering deliverables to ensure recommendations are consistent, technically sound, actionable, and aligned with Government requirements.
  • Review architectural artifacts and technical documentation for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance with established VA architecture and engineering standards.
  • Mentor and provide technical direction to security architects, cloud engineers, DevSecOps engineers, AI engineers, cryptography specialists, risk analysts, and other technical personnel supporting the program.
  • Facilitate collaboration across security, engineering, operations, governance, development, cloud, data, identity, and program-management functions.
  • Identify areas where technical teams or initiatives are not architecturally aligned and recommend actions to restore consistency with enterprise strategy and security requirements.
  • Support technical planning for pilots, prototypes, use cases, proof-of-concept activities, and enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Ensure architecture and engineering decisions support secure modernization while maintaining confidentiality, integrity, availability, compliance, and mission effectiveness.
  • May require up to two onsite travel visits

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 15 years of Enterprise Security Architecture Information Security experience at a large company or Government agency similar in size/scope to GSA, IRS, DoD or VA.

  • Expertise in project management, security architecture and security engineering with ability to translate customer requirements and relay them to the team.
  • Expertise and ability to advance the development of legacy and new health IT digital architectures including cloud, mobile, IoT, APIs, VR/XR, 5G, PQC, DLP, Cryptography, Quantum Computing and Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies.
  • Expertise in risk management. 
  • Expertise in using Enterprise Architecture (EA) tools.
  • Expertise in guiding architecture tool processes and products (e.g. SABSA)
  • Expertise in performing analysis and research of complex problems and processes relating to the subject matter.
  • Expertise in coordinating with program and project leaders to analyze system architectures during design reviews and throughout the conceptual design lifecycle.
  • Expertise in identifying strategies for addressing requirements, risks, and issues, conducting detailed trade-off analysis of requirements against fiscal, schedule, and performance issues.
  • Expertise in creating diagrams and documentation with all components that comprise IT systems including network topology.
  • Expertise in security frameworks and Federal policies, processes, and standards. (e.g., NIST, FISMA, FedRAMP, CIS Controls, HIPAA).

Preferred/Desired:

  • Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Math, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems Architecture, Telecommunications Systems Design, Architecture Implementation, Information Systems Integration, Software Development Methodologies, Security Engineering, and Network Systems Communications Management.
  • CASP+ (SecurityX), CCISO, CISA, CISM, CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP, CISSP-ISSEP, GCED, GCIH, GSLC, CCNP Security

$103,060.84—$172,201.90 USD

jobs.description:
People Analytics Senior Consultant, Sr. Advisor

The Role

We are seeking an experienced People Analytics Senior Consultant to play a critical role in shaping and delivering our employee listening strategy. This role serves as a trusted advisor to HR and business leaders, partnering closely with stakeholders to design effective listening approaches, develop high-quality surveys and research methodologies, analyze employee feedback, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. The ideal candidate brings expertise in survey methodology, employee research, stakeholder consulting, and analytics while demonstrating the ability to connect employee experience insights to business priorities and outcomes. This individual will work collaboratively across key matrix partners to ensure listening programs are designed with rigor, aligned to organizational needs, and positioned to drive meaningful action.

Key Responsibilities

Employee Listening Strategy & Consulting

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to leaders, HR partners, and Centers of Excellence on employee listening best practices, measurement strategies, and employee experience research.
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify business challenges, define listening objectives, and recommend listening approaches that generate meaningful and actionable feedback.
  • Consult on the design and implementation of enterprise, pulse, lifecycle, and targeted listening programs aligned to workforce and business priorities.
  • Guide stakeholders on survey methodology, question design, benchmarking, reporting approaches, and action planning strategies.
  • Promote best practices that enhance listening effectiveness, reduce survey fatigue, and improve the overall employee experience.

Survey Design & Research

  • Lead the development of employee surveys and listening instruments, ensuring measures are reliable, actionable, and aligned with business objectives.
  • Design survey content, scales, open-ended questions, and research frameworks that effectively capture employee perceptions and experiences.
  • Partner with stakeholders to evaluate emerging organizational needs and translate them into meaningful listening strategies and measurement approaches.
  • Support qualitative listening efforts including focus groups, interviews, crowdsourcing, and other research activities that complement survey findings.
  • Continuously assess and enhance listening methodologies to ensure relevance, validity, and impact.

Analytics & Insight Generation

  • Analyze quantitative and qualitative employee feedback data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and key drivers of employee outcomes.
  • Integrate survey data with other workforce and business data sources to provide a more holistic view of the employee experience.
  • Develop meaningful narratives and recommendations that help leaders understand employee sentiment and prioritize actions.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI-enabled analytics tools, prompt engineering techniques, and large language models (LLMs) to accelerate data exploration, insight generation, research synthesis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Advanced proficiency in one or more statistical programming languages and analytics platforms (e.g., SAS, R, Python, SQL), with experience applying these tools to data preparation, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and data visualization.
  • Partner with data science teams to enhance analytical capabilities and measurement approaches.

Executive Partnership & Storytelling

  • Present findings, recommendations, and strategic insights to senior leaders, HR leadership teams, and executive stakeholders.
  • Translate complex research and analytical findings into clear, compelling, and actionable business narratives.
  • Facilitate discussions with leaders to interpret results, identify priorities, and develop action plans.
  • Support executive communications and leadership presentations related to employee feedback and organizational health.
  • Partner with our Activation team to provide recommendations on taking action based on feedback and data-insights.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization and establish credibility as a trusted advisor on employee listening and workforce insights.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Stay current on leading practices in employee listening, organizational research, people analytics, and employee experience measurement.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance listening methodologies, reporting approaches, and insight delivery.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the organization's listening strategy, helping advance listening maturity and analytical capabilities.
  • Support the development of new approaches that strengthen the connection between employee feedback, business outcomes, and organizational decision-making.

What You Bring (Qualifications)

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in employee listening, industrial-organizational psychology, people analytics, organizational research, employee experience, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience designing employee surveys, developing measurement strategies, and conducting organizational research.
  • Strong understanding of survey methodology, research design, psychometrics, and employee listening best practices.
  • Experience analyzing quantitative and qualitative data and translating findings into actionable business insights.
  • Strong consulting, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence leaders at all levels of the organization.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling abilities, including experience presenting to senior leaders and executive audiences.
  • Experience developing executive-ready reports, presentations, and insight summaries.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to connect employee feedback to business priorities and workforce outcomes.
  • Comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and initiatives in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree, such as a Ph.D., in industrial-organizational psychology, organizational development, behavioral science, or a related field.
  • Experience leading enterprise employee engagement, pulse, lifecycle, or organizational health surveys.
  • Experience with driver analysis, predictive analytics, text analytics, and advanced research methods.
  • Familiarity with employee experience, organizational effectiveness, talent strategy, workforce planning, and change management.
  • Experience working in a large, highly matrixed organization and consulting with senior leadership teams.
  • Knowledge of people analytics, organizational research, and employee listening technology platforms.

About Amperity—Why This, Why Now

Most customer data is a lie by omission.

Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap—between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true—is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.

With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being—in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands—like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running—trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.

Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company—not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being the ones who can make it trustworthy.

So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like—alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus—this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.

We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. If that’s how you want to be measured, we would love to speak with you.

The Role

At Amperity, we empower businesses to unlock the full potential of their customer data. Our clients are industry leaders making bold investments in cutting-edge customer data infrastructure. As a Software Development Engineer, you’ll join a highly motivated and collaborative engineering team to develop advanced data pipelines, create flexible marketing solutions, and integrate powerful AI capabilities enabling our clients to gain deeper insights and activate their data strategically. You’ll work on a world-class, mission-critical platform that sits at the heart of our customers’ data ecosystems, directly influencing how they understand and engage with their audiences.

As one of the first teammates building our footprint in Argentina, you’ll play a meaningful role in our growth and be part of shaping this new chapter from the beginning. If you're excited about working on complex challenges, driving innovation, and helping industry-leading brands thrive through data-driven strategies, we’d love to hear from you.

Interesting Problems

  • Process and understand large amounts of structured and unstructured customer, product, and event data
  • Building delightful, full-stack experiences and toolsets to help users visualize their data, understand their customers and surface the most impactful insight
  • Use the latest data science and AI advancements to build experiences that accelerate the time to value for data developers and marketers
  • Integrate our system into the operating core of the businesses we serve
  • Improve how marketers use their customer data

About You

  • 5+ experience including 3+ years developing enterprise software
  • 3+ years of experience building applications on database technologies experience with big data technologies
  • 3+ years working in a production environment. In this duration, you have shown an ability to get products and features released to customers
  • Excited about using or learning functional languages (like Clojure!) in a production environment
  • Passionate about building elegant user experiences on top of complex technology
  • Collaborative, inclusive, and inspired by your customers’ success

Technologies We Use

We don’t expect you to have experience with everything we use—but if you’re excited about learning, you’ll do great here. Our tech stack includes:

  • Large-scale data engines like Apache Spark, Presto, and Kafka.
  • Functional programming languages including Clojure, ClojureScript, and the React ecosystem.
  • Cloud-native infrastructure built with Kubernetes and Terraform, deployed across multiple cloud providers.
  • Machine learning models and systems including random forests, logistic regression, and probabilistic databases.

Location

Argentina - Remote

This role is remote, with a small number of meaningful in-person gatherings designed to support alignment and collaboration.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a competitive compensation package, along with benefits designed to support your well-being and long-term growth. Our total rewards program includes base compensation, benefits, and the opportunity to participate in our company’s equity plan.

jobs.excerpt: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life.
jobs.description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at .

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time, fully remote physician consultants who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across multiple U.S. states. Depending on your licensure, certification, and area of expertise, you will provide consultations in menopause and perimenopause care aligned to The Menopause Society and ACOG guidelines, early fertility support aligned to ACOG and ASRM guidelines, or both.

Metabolic health is a core, cross-cutting component of this program. Weight, insulin resistance, and cardiometabolic risk are central to outcomes across every journey we support, from ovulatory function and preconception readiness to menopausal symptom burden and long-term cardiovascular and bone health. You should expect metabolic assessment and management to be a routine part of your visits, and clinicians comfortable prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists, within clinical protocols are especially encouraged to apply.

This is a flexible, part-time contractor engagement of approximately 5-40 hours per week, with a target commitment of 10-15 hours per week.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

  • Provide virtual consultations (video and/or phone) within your area(s) of expertise, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, and ongoing management of menopausal, fertility, and related hormonal and metabolic concerns.
  • Apply current ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines with individualized, shared decision-making.
  • Assess and manage metabolic health as a routine part of visits, including prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications such as GLP-1 receptor agonists within clinical protocols where appropriate.
  • Document visits accurately and on time, order and interpret relevant labs, and coordinate referrals to primary care, OB/GYN, endocrinology, behavioral health, or subspecialists as needed.
  • Maintain active, unrestricted multi-state clinical licensure, complete credentialing and payer enrollment, and maintain eligibility for additional state licenses to expand coverage.
  • Contribute to member experience and quality through strong virtual visit presence, effective use of telehealth and EHR systems, participation in chart audits and case reviews, and staying current with emerging research and regulatory changes.

What Success Looks Like 📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a consistent panel of high-quality virtual visits within your clinical area(s), with strong member experience and visit quality results.
  • Maintained timely, accurate documentation and lab follow-up, with no outstanding credentialing or compliance gaps.
  • Expanded your state licensure coverage in line with program needs, supporting broader member access.
  • Integrated metabolic assessment and management, including GLP-1 protocols where clinically appropriate, as a routine part of your visits.
  • Contributed to chart audits, case reviews, and clinical protocol refinement as the telemedicine program scales.

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • An MD or DO in Obstetrics/Gynecology, Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility (REI), Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Endocrinology; or you are a Physician Assistant (PA) or Advanced Practice Registered Nurse/Nurse Practitioner (e.g., WHNP, adult/gerontology NP, FNP) with demonstrated expertise in the applicable clinical area.
  • A minimum of 3-5+ years of active clinical experience in early fertility support, menopause care, or both, including evaluation, treatment, and longitudinal management.
  • An active, unrestricted U.S. medical license; multi-state licensure is preferred and IMLC participation is strongly preferred.
  • For clinicians practicing in the menopause specialty: MSCP certification from The Menopause Society, or certification actively in progress with a clear completion plan.
  • Familiarity with ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines.
  • Prior telemedicine experience (preferred), with comfort managing visits entirely in a virtual environment and a strong virtual presence that supports shared decision-making over video and phone.
  • Proficiency with telehealth technologies, including video platforms, secure messaging, electronic prescribing, and EHR/clinical documentation tools.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and applicable telemedicine privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, along with a HIPAA-compliant home workspace and reliable internet.

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Clinical experience spanning both early fertility and menopause, enabling flexible coverage across member journeys.
  • Experience working in a dedicated menopause clinic, fertility center, or comparable specialty program.
  • Familiarity with early fertility workup, including AMH testing, ovulation induction, and preconception optimization, with appropriate escalation to in-person ART evaluation.
  • Experience prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists (titration, side-effect management, monitoring, and discontinuation planning); obesity medicine training or ABOM certification is a significant advantage.
  • Prior experience in digital health, health benefits, or multi-state telemedicine environments.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocol development, quality improvement, or member-facing clinical content.
  • Experience supporting diverse and historically underserved populations, including LGBTQ+ and gender-diverse individuals.
  • Fluency in an additional language.

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Carrot's telemedicine clinic is one of the most direct ways members experience our care. Every virtual visit shapes how members navigate some of the most personal moments of their lives, from trying to conceive to managing menopause. The clinicians in this network are the face of that experience, and the quality of their judgment, communication, and documentation determines whether members receive care they trust.

This role also anchors Carrot's clinical point of view that metabolic health is inseparable from reproductive and hormonal health. As the telemedicine program scales across states and journeys, the clinicians who join this network will directly expand access to guideline-aligned, whole-person care for members who often cannot find it locally.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $120-$160. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to:

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our own engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence (AI) agents. Agents generate code and tests in seconds, so speed is no longer the constraint. Confidence is. Agents can produce a passing test suite for software that doesn't work as intended, and a reviewer may not be able to tell the difference without redoing the work by hand.

As Engineering Manager, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll build and lead the team that closes this gap. You'll help define what validation means when the author is an agent and make the feedback loop fast, automatic, and trustworthy. You'll point the team at the right version of an open problem and earn adoption across GitLab by building the best path, not by mandating a process.

  • Validation that confirms agent-generated code does what was intended, so a passing suite means a working feature and not just a satisfied proxy.
  • Mid-loop feedback that helps an agent self-correct toward working software instead of green assertions.
  • Language-aware approaches under one shared model of what "trusted" means, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, while allowing the right technique to differ by language.
  • Real measurement of whether engineers trust and adopt the path, with findings fed directly back into the platform.

What you'll do

  • Build and grow the team by hiring and developing engineers who practice agentic development, and create a culture that treats this as an open problem to solve rather than a process to enforce.
  • Set direction in an undefined space by partnering with your team to shape the technical approach for validating agent-built software.
  • Keep the team focused on the highest-impact version of the problem rather than the easiest one.
  • Earn adoption by building relationships with engineering teams across GitLab, learning how they work with agents today, and creating a platform they choose because it makes them faster and more confident.
  • Measure engineer adoption and trust through real usage, treat adopters as design partners, and use findings to prioritize where confidence is breaking down.
  • Stay close to the technical work by engaging in architecture and design discussions, reviewing proposals, and keeping your judgment current as agentic development changes.
  • Run the team with clear goals, direct feedback, honest performance management, and ownership of complex work from planning through completion without relying on a dedicated program manager.

What you'll bring

  • Direct experience using AI agents to build software, including lessons from successes and missteps and a clear point of view on why a passing test suite isn't the same as working software.
  • Experience leading engineering teams through ambiguous, early-stage problems where the right approach wasn't yet known.
  • The ability to drive adoption through influence and a useful product rather than through mandate, including partnering across teams you don't manage.
  • Technical depth to engage credibly in architecture and validation strategy discussions and earn the trust of senior engineers.
  • A history of building accountable, high-performing teams, including hiring well, developing team members, and addressing underperformance directly.
  • Strong written communication skills in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.
  • Alignment with GitLab's values, especially collaboration, iteration, and transparency.

This isn't a quality assurance (QA) or test automation management role. We care far more about your experience leading teams that build with agents than about depth in any particular testing discipline.

About the team

The Trusted Agentic Development team is part of GitLab's Developer Experience group. We build platforms and practices that help GitLab engineers validate agent-generated software with confidence. We work across engineering teams and programming languages to understand how people use agents, test new approaches in real workflows, and create a shared model of trusted agentic development that teams choose to adopt.

Account Executive – Influencer Marketing

Location: Remote — Colombia

Experience: 2+ years
Languages: Native Spanish + Professional English
Travel: Occasional travel for key brand meetings
Start Date: As Soon As Possible

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing influencer marketing and creator technology company helping consumer brands across Latin America manage creator partnerships and campaigns more efficiently.

Its technology brings the influencer marketing workflow into a single platform, supporting areas such as creator discovery, campaign management, content review, contracts, payments, CRM, and performance analytics. The company combines technology, AI-powered capabilities, and a curated creator network to help brands execute UGC and influencer campaigns from initial brief through final delivery.

Operating in the rapidly evolving creator economy, the company is building a more scalable and technology-driven way for brands to work with creators across Latin America.

About the Role

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Brand Partnerships Lead to become the company's first dedicated sales hire and help build its commercial engine across Spanish-speaking Latin America.

This is a true full-cycle sales role. You will prospect, qualify, run discovery, develop proposals with operations, negotiate, close, and manage your accounts through their first renewals and early expansion.

You'll also work directly with the founder to build the commercial playbook from the ground up. This is not a role for someone waiting for inbound leads or a finished sales process. You'll be expected to create pipeline, close business, experiment, document what works, and use AI to automate repetitive parts of your workflow.

What You'll Do

Build & Own Your Pipeline

  • Build your own pipeline of consumer brands, particularly across beauty, personal care, and CPG.

  • Prospect brand managers, marketing directors, and other relevant decision-makers across Spanish-speaking Latin American markets.

  • Own outbound prospecting and consistently generate your own meetings.

  • Use email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and other relevant channels to move opportunities forward.

Run Full-Cycle Sales

  • Conduct consultative discovery to understand each brand's objectives and marketing needs.

  • Work with operations to design the right creator seeding or influencer marketing program.

  • Prepare proposals, present solutions, negotiate contracts, and close new business.

  • Own accounts through their initial renewals and early expansion before transitioning consolidated relationships.

Build an AI-Native Sales Process

  • Use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar AI platforms as part of your daily sales workflow.

  • Build your own automations for account research, call preparation, follow-ups, reporting, and other repeatable processes.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to automate administrative work so you can focus on high-value sales conversations.

Build the Commercial Playbook

  • Work directly with the founder to develop the company's sales methodology.

  • Document objections, outbound sequences, follow-up strategies, call learnings, and best practices.

  • Help create the commercial foundation that future sales hires will use.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience selling media, agency services, influencer marketing, martech solutions, or similar services to brand teams in Latin America.

  • Proven sales performance against quota, with the ability to discuss previous results using specific numbers.

  • Strong experience self-sourcing pipeline and personally prospecting for new business.

  • Experience managing a full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and closing.

  • Experience selling directly to brand managers, marketing leaders, or similar decision-makers.

  • Native Spanish.

  • Professional English for working with tools and documentation in both languages.

  • Strong understanding of WhatsApp as a professional sales channel, including follow-up and deal progression.

  • Genuine daily use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar platforms.

  • Ability to demonstrate real examples of how you have automated or improved parts of your sales process using AI.

  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling to beauty, personal care, CPG, or other consumer brands.

  • Background in influencer marketing, creator economy, UGC, digital media, or marketing technology.

  • Existing relationships with marketing decision-makers in Latin America.

  • Experience working in an early-stage startup or entrepreneurial environment.

This Role Is NOT for You If...

  • You depend on someone else to fill your calendar with meetings.

  • You haven't personally prospected for new business within the last year.

  • You're looking to manage a sales team before proving you can personally sell.

  • You expect to receive a finished sales playbook instead of helping build one.

  • You're uncomfortable experimenting with AI and automation as part of your daily workflow.

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

During the selection process, we will pay particular attention to:

  • Verifiable quota attainment and sales results.

  • Ability to consistently generate self-sourced pipeline.

  • Full-cycle closing experience.

  • Experience selling marketing-related solutions to LATAM brands.

  • Consultative selling and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to sell naturally through WhatsApp.

  • Practical, demonstrable use of AI and automation in sales.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, and independence.

What Success Looks Like

  • You consistently generate qualified opportunities without relying on inbound leads.

  • You build relationships with relevant consumer brands across target markets.

  • Opportunities progress effectively from discovery through proposal and close.

  • New accounts successfully reach their first renewals and expansion opportunities.

  • Repetitive sales activities are increasingly automated.

  • Your documented processes become the foundation of a scalable commercial playbook.

Why Join Us?

  • Become the first dedicated sales hire and have a direct impact on how the commercial organization is built.

  • Work closely with the founder throughout the sales process.

  • Join a technology-driven company operating at the intersection of AI, influencer marketing, and the creator economy.

  • Build processes rather than simply inherit them.

  • Fully remote work across Latin America.

  • Base salary plus uncapped variable compensation, with OTE structured approximately 50/50.

  • Occasional travel for important brand meetings.

Important Notes

  • This is a highly hands-on individual contributor sales role.

  • Candidates must have personally prospected for new business within the last year.

  • Candidates should be prepared to discuss previous quota performance and sales results with specific numbers.

  • Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate how they currently use AI and automation in their sales workflow.

  • This position requires significant ownership of pipeline generation, closing, and early account development.

This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

About This Role

Caylent’s Anthropic Business Unit is a dedicated AI services practice built in partnership with Anthropic.

The Agentic Architect is the strategic and architectural lead on AI engagements. Paired with a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who handles hands-on implementation, you own the engagement arc: shaping AI strategy, designing operating models, mapping AI outcomes to business value, and guiding executive stakeholders through adoption. You lead the room — the FDE builds what you architect.

This is a cross-functional role. You engage across lines of business, not just engineering, connecting AI initiatives to the outcomes that matter to each part of the organization. Every engagement is anchored to Anthropic’s platform and focused on real AI adoption outcomes.

Your clients span PE portfolio companies, growth-stage software businesses, and enterprise organizations. You are the strategic face of Caylent from kickoff through handoff.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and Architecture

  • Run structured discovery across engineering, product, and business stakeholders to map organizational context, AI readiness, and strategic goals across lines of business
  • Design AI operating models that define how the organization adopts, governs, and scales AI. Not just within engineering, but across the business

  • Build executive relationships that position Caylent as a long-term AI strategy partner, not a one-time vendor
  • Attend on-site for the final Catalyst block: readout, workshop, and executive presentation

Internal Contribution

  • Contribute reusable strategy frameworks, delivery artifacts, and methodology improvements back into the practice at engagement close
  • Lead AI strategy engagements spanning multiple teams, platforms, and business functions
  • Collaborate with FDEs to refine the architect-engineer delivery model and improve handoff patterns

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 8+ years of software development or technical architecture experience across varied stacks, including hyperscaler environments
  • 3+ years in engineering leadership, technical consulting, solutions architecture, or a combination
  • Demonstrated ability to engage across lines of business. You can talk to a VP of Engineering about CI/CD and a COO about operational efficiency in the same week
  • Experience designing or advising on AI operating models, technology adoption strategies, or digital transformation programs
  • Hands-on familiarity with Claude Code or equivalent AI-assisted development tools — you don’t need to configure them daily, but you need to speak the language credibly and direct an FDE’s work
  • Certified Claude Architect
  • Experience running structured stakeholder interviews, discovery sessions, and facilitated workshops with both technical and business audiences
  • Strong executive communication: writing and presenting to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and line-of-business leaders
  • Experience delivering professional services engagements, including scope management, deliverable ownership, and client advisory
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and modern software development workflows

Preferred

  • Experience mapping AI initiatives to business outcomes (revenue, efficiency, risk, time-to-value) with executive-level ROI framing
  • Familiarity with PE portfolio company environments and board-level communication
  • Background in solutions architecture, platform engineering, or enterprise technology strategy
  • Experience with LLM prompt engineering, agentic AI workflow design, or AI product development
  • Direct experience with Claude Code’s extensibility model
  • Familiarity with SDLC maturity frameworks or workforce analytics (DORA, DevEx)
  • Experience designing and facilitating workshops for mixed audiences — engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders

Who Thrives Here

The Agentic Architects who do well here are a specific profile:

  • Sat in the seat. You’ve led engineering teams or technology strategy inside a product company and understand the pressures executives navigate when adopting AI. Clients can tell.
  • Thinks across the business. You don’t stop at engineering. You see how AI impacts operations, product, and go-to-market — and you can have those conversations with the people who own them.

Why This Team

Headquartered in Tempe, Arizona and Dallas, Texas, we create opportunities and improve the lives of our customers and our employees by placing a focus on putting the right customer, in the right vehicle, on the right terms and on their path to ownership.

The DriveTime Family of Brands spans across DriveTime, Bridgecrest and SilverRock. You can find us at the intersection of technology and innovation as we use our proprietary tools and over two decades of industry knowledge to redefine the process of purchasing, financing, and protecting your vehicle.

That’s Nice, But What’s the Job?

In short, this is a rare opportunity to build an ITSM practice from the ground up inside Freshservice. As the platform expert for IT Operations Management (ITOM), Asset Management, CMDB, Change Management, and Release Management, you'll partner with teams across Infrastructure, DevOps, Security, Service Desk, and IT Operations to design the processes, workflows, governance, and automation that power how technology services are delivered. If you enjoy creating order from chaos, influencing stakeholders, and building scalable solutions that become the foundation for an organization’s IT operations, this role offers the chance to make a lasting impact.
In Long, as the IT Systems Operations Engineer, you will be responsible for:
  • Designing and configuring ITOM alerting, incident prioritization rules, escalation workflows, and response processes within Freshservice.
  • Building integrations between monitoring and observability tools and Freshservice to automate incident creation and prioritization.
  • Partnering with Infrastructure, DevOps, Security, and Service Desk teams to align operational priorities with asset criticality and business impact.
  • Defining and maintaining SLA tiers, priority matrices, playbooks, and operational governance standards.
  • Leading the development and ongoing maturity of Asset Management and CMDB capabilities within Freshservice.
  • Defining CI classes, asset types, attribute structures, and relationship maps that accurately reflect the technology environment.
  • Configuring and maintaining asset discovery solutions and automated asset lifecycle tracking.
  • Establishing governance processes to ensure data accuracy, ownership, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Designing and implementing Change Management workflows, including approvals, CAB processes, risk assessments, templates, and notifications.
  • Integrating Change Management with CMDB data to provide visibility into impacted assets and configuration items.
  • Creating metrics, dashboards, and reporting solutions to measure process adoption, compliance, and operational effectiveness.
  • Building Release Management processes that support planning, scheduling, communication, tracking, and post-release review activities.
  • Integrating release pipelines with change records and CMDB data to provide end-to-end deployment traceability.
  • Developing release calendars, stakeholder communications, approval checkpoints, and deployment governance standards.
  • Configuring workflow schemes, fields, permissions, notifications, and platform administration settings across Freshservice modules.
  • Building and maintaining integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, SSO, LDAP, and related technologies.
  • Coordinating platform upgrades, maintenance activities, and ongoing platform optimization efforts.
  • Creating and maintaining runbooks, documentation, process maps, and configuration records.
  • Participating in on-call support for critical ITSM platform issues and escalations.

So What Kind of Folks Are We Looking For?

  • Strong relationship builders who can work effectively across multiple IT teams and stakeholder groups.
  • Excellent communicators who can translate technical requirements into practical platform solutions.
  • Process-minded problem solvers who enjoy designing scalable systems and improving operational efficiency.
  • Self-starters who thrive in greenfield environments where processes and standards are being built from scratch.
  • Detail-oriented professionals who value governance, documentation, and data quality.
  • Collaborative partners who can influence without authority and drive adoption across diverse teams.
  • Analytical thinkers who use data, metrics, and KPIs to guide decisions and measure success.
  • Individuals who are equally comfortable discussing technical architecture with engineers and process improvements with business stakeholders.

The Specifics.

  • 3-5 years of hands-on ITSM platform administration experience, with significant experience in at least two platforms such as Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Vivantio, or similar solutions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent work experience
  • Proven experience building or significantly expanding Asset Management and CMDB practices, including CI schema design, discovery configuration, and data governance.
  • Experience implementing Change Management and/or Release Management processes aligned to ITIL v3 or ITIL v4 frameworks.
  • Experience gathering requirements from cross-functional IT stakeholders and translating them into platform configurations and business solutions.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and integration methodologies.
  • Strong reporting, dashboard development, KPI creation, and analytical capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience documenting processes and presenting to stakeholders.

Nice To Have

  • Freshservice platform experience, including Freshservice ITSM, ITOM, or ITAM certifications.
  • ITIL Foundation certification (v3 or v4).
  • Experience with infrastructure and network discovery tools, including Freshservice Discovery Agent, Nmap, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Vivantio, Splunk, Jira, or Statuspage.
  • Basic SQL and/or JQL experience for reporting and analysis.
  • Understanding of SSO, SAML, LDAP, SSL, and authentication best practices.
  • Experience supporting platform migrations, greenfield implementations, or large-scale ITSM transformations.

So What About the Perks? Perks matter

  • Work From Home. Feel free to rock the casual wear while still being camera ready. You will be working from your home office (in an approved city & state) and make sure you have a conducive and quiet workspace with no distractions and reliable and secure internet.
  • Medical, dental, and vision, oh my! DriveTime Family of Brands covers a sizable amount of insurance premiums to ensure our employees receive top-tier healthcare coverage.
  • But Wait, There’s More. 401(K), Company paid life insurance policy, short and long-term disability coverage to name a few.
  • Growth Opportunities. You grow, I grow, we all grow! But seriously, DriveTime Family of Brands is committed to providing its employees with every opportunity to grow professionally with roughly over 1,000 employees promoted year over year.
  • Tuition Reimbursement. We’re as passionate about your professional development as you are. With that, we’ll put our money where our mouth is.
  • Wellness Program. Health is wealth! This program includes self-guided coaching and journeys, cash incentives and discounts on your medical premiums through engaging in fun activities!
  • Gratitude is Green. We offer competitive pay across the organization, because, well… money matters!
  • Paid Time Off.Not just lip service: we work hard, to play hard! Paid time off includes (for all full-time roles) wellness days, holidays, and good ole' fashioned YOU time! For our Part-timers, don't fear you get some time too...vacation time is available - the more you work, the more you earn!

Anything Else? Absolutely.

DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. We could spend a lot of time having you read about ALL our awards, but we’ll save time (and practice some humility) just naming a few others; Comparably Awards: Best Company for Diversity, Best Company Culture and Best Company Leadership, oh and don’t forget Phoenix Business Journal Healthiest Employers (okay, we’ll stop there)!

Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of our background and drug screening process. DriveTime is a drug-free, tobacco-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer.

And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high-energy environment!

The Virtual Office Manager / Healthcare Administrative Assistant will support the daily administrative and operational needs of the practice while serving as a professional and welcoming point of contact for patients.

The successful candidate will be comfortable communicating with American patients by phone, managing appointments and calendars, maintaining accurate records, and handling administrative responsibilities with minimal supervision.

Over time, this individual should develop into a trusted remote office manager who can keep the practice organized and running smoothly without requiring constant direction.

Patient & Phone Support

Scheduling & Calendar Management

Experience working remotely for an American medical or mental health practice is a strong advantage.

Healthcare experience and SimplePractice knowledge are highly preferred and should be used as additional ranking factors.

Selection process developed by matteria

Location and Work Mode

Who we are

Momentous is an AI engineering company that designs, builds, and operates production AI systems for organizations across industries — from global technology companies and healthcare providers to government bodies and experiential agencies. Their work spans custom AI products, agentic systems, computer vision, knowledge platforms, and the infrastructure behind them, all grounded in a consistent methodology: discover the real friction, design the right solution, deliver with precision, and transfer full ownership to the client's team. Momentous doesn't create dependency — they transfer capability.

Our impact

At Momentous, impact isn't a side project — it's a founding commitment. Twenty percent of our engineering capacity is permanently allocated to sustainability and social impact work, written into our structure before we had a single paying client. That's what produced WasteLens, a computer vision platform helping restaurants and hotel chains across Latin America reduce food waste in line with UN SDG 12. These projects aren't charity — they're some of our sharpest engineering work. Building for communities with tight budgets and diverse users forces a precision that makes everything else we build better. When you join Momentous, one-fifth of your time goes toward work that matters beyond the bottom line. Non-negotiable, and it always has been.

Momentous is hiring a Software Engineer to own end-to-end delivery on the production AI systems we build for our clients. Engagements span custom AI products, knowledge platforms, agentic systems, computer vision, and the infrastructure that runs them. You will own the work shipped under your name, pair with senior engineers on the more complex builds, and contribute to architectural decisions on the systems you build, alongside senior engineers.

  • Write design notes that the team uses; contribute to architectural conversations

Our team profile

At Momentous, the team is intentionally diverse — in background, discipline, and perspective — united by a shared belief that AI is a tool to amplify human capability, not replace it.
