jobs.description:
Scheduling & Workforce Coordinator

Remote | Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Scheduling & Workforce Coordinator to support the day-to-day scheduling and workforce coordination of allied health professionals across Residential Aged Care services.

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating clinician rosters, managing availability and leave, arranging backfill, and responding to short-notice workforce changes. You will also serve as a key point of contact for allied health professionals, ensuring clear communication and reliable service coverage.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone with strong scheduling, rostering, workforce coordination, or healthcare operations experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and solving workforce challenges proactively.

Key Responsibilities

Scheduling & Rostering

  • Coordinate day-to-day scheduling and rostering of allied health professionals across Residential Aged Care services.
  • Develop and maintain accurate rosters based on service requirements, clinician availability, contracted hours, and operational priorities.
  • Ensure contracted service hours are accurately scheduled and covered.
  • Monitor upcoming rosters to identify gaps, conflicts, over-allocations, and potential service delivery risks.
  • Proactively resolve scheduling conflicts before they impact service delivery.
  • Coordinate roster changes and short-notice workforce requirements.

Leave & Workforce Coverage

  • Manage planned and unplanned leave and assess the operational impact.
  • Coordinate suitable backfill for clinician leave to maintain service continuity.
  • Respond promptly to sick leave and ad hoc workforce changes.
  • Maintain visibility of clinician availability and upcoming leave.
  • Work with clinicians to identify suitable availability and alternative coverage options.
  • Help keep the casual workforce pool engaged and available for potential coverage.
  • Identify recurring workforce gaps and escalate risks appropriately.

Clinician & Stakeholder Communication

  • Act as a key point of contact for allied health professionals regarding rosters, leave, availability, and scheduling changes.
  • Maintain clear, timely, and professional communication with clinicians and stakeholders.
  • Respond promptly to scheduling queries and requests.
  • Communicate service changes, coverage issues, and operational requirements.
  • Work closely with Operations and Clinical teams to minimize service disruption.
  • Build positive and professional relationships across the healthcare workforce.

Workforce Management & Reporting

  • Monitor clinician capacity, contracted hours, workforce utilization, and service coverage.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workforce allocation and reduce unfilled or underutilized hours.
  • Review scheduling patterns and workforce data to identify trends and potential risks.
  • Prepare scheduling, workforce coverage, and utilization reports.
  • Maintain accurate workforce information and scheduling records.

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Maintain accurate scheduling and workforce information across Deputy, Monday.com, and Outlook.
  • Ensure information remains consistent and up to date across operational systems.
  • Identify and resolve system discrepancies.
  • Support the improvement of scheduling workflows and workforce processes.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual administration and improve scheduling efficiency.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across workforce operations.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Demonstrated experience in scheduling, rostering, workforce coordination, or a similar operational role.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and respond effectively to changing workforce requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong English communication proficiency.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Experience using scheduling, rostering, workforce management, or similar systems.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Outlook and Excel.

Highly Desirable

  • Experience in healthcare, allied health, aged care, disability, or community services.
  • Experience working directly with healthcare or allied health professionals.
  • Experience with aged care rostering, particularly high-volume rostering.
  • Experience with home care rostering.
  • Experience using Deputy, Monday.com, Salesforce, or similar systems.
  • Experience working across a multi-site service environment.
  • Certificate IV, Diploma, or tertiary qualification in Business Administration, Health Administration, Operations, or a related discipline.

Key Attributes

The ideal candidate will be:

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Proactive and solutions-focused
  • Analytical with strong problem-solving skills
  • Responsive and comfortable managing urgent or last-minute changes
  • Confident communicating with healthcare professionals
  • Professional and collaborative
  • Accountable and able to work independently
  • Customer-service focused
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Committed to continuous improvement and operational excellence

Perks & Benefits

  • Work From Home – Fully remote work setup
  • HMO Coverage – Health insurance benefits
  • Work-Life Balance – Remote environment designed to support flexibility and productivity
  • Career Growth – Opportunity to develop your career within a growing healthcare organization

How to Apply

If you have strong scheduling or workforce coordination experience and enjoy working with people in a fast-paced healthcare environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and join a team where your coordination skills directly contribute to reliable healthcare service delivery.

jobs.title: 2025-2026 AI/ML Research Fellow
jobs.excerpt: 10 places are open for the 2026 term, with a duration of 6 or 12 months at the applicant's option.
jobs.description:
10 places are open for the 2026 term, with a duration of 6 or 12 months at the applicant's option.

The intent of the fellowship is to focus on high risk research: ambitious projects that may not produce results, but will have lasting impact if they work.

We believe that publication in AI/ML has become overly biased towards short-term and iterative results, despite major gaps in our understanding of how to build optimal models.

Our focus is on frontier research: order-of-magnitude improvements, rather than disposable papers barely better than baseline.

The goal of these fellowships is to give awardees uninterrupted time to focus on harder open problems, with adequate compute, talented peers, and weekly 1:1 mentorship from senior researchers but without chasing specific metrics.

You will be expected to spend about 80% of your time on your own research, and up to 20% of your time either assisting other fellows or participating in wider research programs at IMI. We focus largely on applied research and its applications to online security problems, but often publish and support frontier research aligned with our broader interests. Serving hundreds of millions of people gives us a unique perspective as to what works at scale.

Eligibility: previous fellows and research staff have come from disparate backgrounds, including early career researchers previously at MSR, FAIR, Mila, MPI, etc. and self taught senior engineers transitioning into research.

We do not discriminate on the basis of pedigree or age. If you have done interesting work, that is enough. Conversely, if you don't already have publications that show you can do good self-directed research then this is not the right opportunity.

Location: you may reside anywhere in the world, excluding sanctioned jurisdictions. This will be a remote fellowship. We do not sponsor visas.

Deliverables: we do not have hard targets, and focus on quality. Fellows generally get 1-2 papers with code done in a year, targeting NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc. At the end of your fellowship, if the threshold for refereed publication is unmet we will expect a final report, which may be published as a blog post.

Full details are available at:

(imachines dot com slash imi-ai-ml-fellowships-2025-2026-high-risk-research)

Applying: send a brief bio / CV link via this page. Include 1) the topic you are interested in working on, 2) a few lines on any relevant prior work you've done, 3) your github / scholar / x links, 4) your desired start date, duration, and other obligations (if any) during that period, and 5) a brief analysis of one of the projects outlined on the page linked above.

Each project we have listed intentionally includes some gaps or glosses. List the ones you see, and how you'd solve them. Alternatively, if you dislike the projects outlined under a particular topic, briefly write up your own idea and why it is more promising, along with your estimate of time and compute required.

Deadline: Admitting fellows in two cohorts. Deadlines for consideration: April 1 and September 1 2026. 3 week decision period. Rolling thereafter.

Compensation: competitive location-adjusted stipend, conference and travel support for conferences with accepted papers.

After the fellowship: past fellows have stayed on in full-time roles at IMI or co-founded AI unicorns. This is a selective process, so we claim little credit for their success. However, we will support your next steps.

Selection criteria: novelty and importance, clarity of approach, feasibility given time/compute, alignment with topics. Panel review and one interview.

Using AI: Coding agents are indisputably useful tools. We provide access to the top 3 models, and were early adopters of evals-first development flows. Familiarity with coding using agents is part of all interviews. However, reliability and correctness are critical for us. You will need to read and understand every line of code with your name on it, and it will be reviewed by both people and machines.

Selection is based on merit. We promote equality of opportunity, and welcome applications from anyone with talent, skills and potential. IMI is an equal opportunity employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, orientation, race, religion or belief.

Please note that all positions require pre-employment screening, including third-party verification of work history, education, and identity, as well as a final in-person interview and identity verification step, which will be conducted in your country of residence.

jobs.description:
Job Title: TikTok Shop Manager
Role: Full-Time
Location: Remote
Core Hours: 8am – 2pm PST
Salary Range: $700 - $900

ABOUT THE ROLE

As TikTok Shop Manager, you will be responsible for building our client's TikTok Shop from the ground up and managing it on an ongoing basis. You will handle everything from initial account registration and product catalog setup through to daily order operations, ad campaign management, affiliate program oversight, and monthly performance reporting. The ideal candidate has operated a high-volume TikTok Shop end-to-end and is comfortable navigating the full Seller Center toolkit.

PHASE 1 RESPONSIBILITIES — SHOP SETUP & CONFIGURATION

Shop Profile & Branding

  • Configure shop name, logo, banner imagery, categories, and storefront layout in Seller Center
  • Write a compelling, keyword-rich shop bio and description
  • Link the TikTok Business/Marketing Account(s) to the shop to enable shoppable video and product tagging

Product Catalog Setup

  • Audit the product range against TikTok's prohibited and restricted product policies and advise the client
  • List products individually or via bulk upload / Shopify catalog sync
  • Optimize product titles with niche search keywords, write detailed descriptions, and upload multi-angle imagery and demo videos
  • Understand and discuss with the client (and then implement) the optimal configuration for SKUs, variants, and pricing; set opening inventory levels
  • Submit all listings for TikTok product approval review and resolve any rejections
  • Conduct a test purchase to validate the full checkout and fulfillment flow

FBM and FBT Configuration

  • Configure FBM: Set warehouse / pickup and return addresses; create shipping templates covering rates, zones, and carrier selection
  • Configure FBT: enroll products, prepare inbound shipments to TikTok warehouses, and configure the free-shipping opt-in settings
  • If using Shopify: install and configure the TikTok channel app to enable real-time inventory and order sync
  • Author and publish the shop's return policy in compliance with applicable consumer protection laws
  • Draft 3PL to FBT ongoing inventory management plan and workflow.

Customer Service

  • Configure customer service notifications
  • Set up FAQs, saved responses, and response workflows
  • Establish return, refund, and cancellation handling procedures
  • Set escalation path for customer support issues

Advertising & Promotions Setup

  • Link TikTok Ads Manager to the shop and configure the primary ad account
  • Launch initial GMV Max campaign(s) — set target ROI, daily budget, and product selection
  • Set up TikTok Search Ads with relevant keyword targeting to capture intent-driven discovery
  • Configure TikTok Pixel if driving traffic to an external website or landing page
  • Build out and maintain welcome promotions, platform coupons, and launch discount strategies in Seller Center

Affiliate / Creator Program Setup

  • Enable and configure the Affiliate Center, including open and targeted collaboration plans
  • Work with our Affiliate/Creator team to set baseline and tiered commission structures across product categories
  • Work with our Affiliate/Creator team to establish a product seeding / free sample program and write a creator brief with content guidelines

PHASE 2 RESPONSIBILITIES — ONGOING MANAGEMENT & OPERATIONS

Daily Operations

  • Monitor and respond to all buyer messages within 12 hours
  • Verify the processing and fulfillment of new orders
  • Review and action open return and refund requests in line with shop policy
  • Monitor product and video comments for customer questions, complaints, or escalations
  • Check the Shop Health dashboard daily for violations, warnings, or Late Dispatch Rate (LDR) increases

Weekly Operations

  • Review GMV Max campaign performance (cost, orders, CPA, ROI) and adjust target ROI as needed
  • Audit GMV Max creative assets and exclude under-performing videos
  • Review inventory levels and initiate restock for SKUs approaching low thresholds
  • Sync inventory counts across all sales channels to prevent overselling
  • Review Search Ads keyword performance and refine bids and match types
  • Monitor and respond to product reviews; flag patterns requiring action
  • Update product listings as needed: pricing, imagery, descriptions, or promotional badges

Monthly Operations

  • Produce a full performance report covering GMV, orders, ad spend, ROAS, and affiliate ROI
  • Export raw order data and build a net revenue / P&L analysis — accounting for referral fees, transaction fees, affiliate commissions, and fulfillment costs
  • Reconcile payouts against Seller Center invoices
  • Review TikTok's ACE Powered Insights for platform-generated growth recommendations
  • Analyze SKU-level performance and identify top and bottom performers
  • Plan and schedule upcoming promotions, flash sales, and seasonal campaigns
  • Work with our Affiliate/Creator Team to review and adjust affiliate commission rates; roll out performance bonuses for top creators
  • Review FBT warehouse inventory and plan replenishment inbound shipments
  • Conduct a shop health audit covering seller score, policy compliance, and LDR trends
  • Monitor TikTok platform policy updates, fee changes, and new ad format rollouts

Quarterly / Strategic Operations

  • Set and document measurable growth goals for the upcoming quarter in collaboration with stakeholders
  • Evaluate catalog expansion opportunities: new SKUs, product bundles, or virtual bundles
  • Review and optimize the fulfillment strategy mix (FBT vs. seller-ship vs. 3PL)
  • Audit the full technology and integration stack: inventory sync tools, shipping apps, analytics platforms
  • Evaluate eligibility for premium seller tiers including Star Shop and Mall status

Crisis & Issue Management

  • Triage and respond to Shop Health violations — pause campaigns and slow order intake if LDR spikes
  • Conduct root cause analysis for fulfillment failures or policy incidents and implement corrective action
  • File TikTok support tickets with supporting documentation when external factors are responsible
  • Manage chargebacks, fraud disputes, and escalated return or refund claims

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

Platform & Technical

  • Proven hands-on experience managing a TikTok Shop end-to-end via Seller Center — from initial registration through to active daily management
  • Deep familiarity with TikTok Shop Ads — specifically GMV Max campaign setup, optimization, and creative management
  • Working knowledge of Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT): inbound shipping, warehouse management, and fee structures
  • Experience with TikTok Shop's affiliate and creator program: collaboration setup, commission structures, and creator relationship management
  • Proficiency with TikTok Seller Center tools: Shop Health dashboard, ACE Powered Insights, order management, and promotions
  • Experience integrating TikTok Shop with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms for catalog and inventory sync
  • Familiarity with TikTok Search Ads and keyword-based campaign strategy

Operations & Analytics

  • Strong understanding of TikTok Shop's fee structure — referral fees, transaction fees, FBT costs, affiliate commissions, and refund admin fees
  • Ability to build and interpret P&L analyses and net revenue reports from raw Seller Center order data
  • Experience managing customer service operations within a 12-hour response SLA
  • Comfortable managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels and preventing overselling

Soft Skills & Working Style

  • Highly organized and process-driven — able to manage multiple daily, weekly, and monthly operational rhythms simultaneously
  • Proactive communicator — surfaces issues, opportunities, and insights to stakeholders without prompting
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving platform environment where policies and features change frequently
  • Detail-oriented with a strong compliance mindset around TikTok's evolving seller policies

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • In the first 30 days: The shop is fully configured, the product catalog is live and approved, fulfillment is operational, the GMV Max campaign is running, and the affiliate program is open for creator applications.
  • By 90 days: The shop has an active roster of affiliate creators generating content, ad campaigns have been optimized based on real performance data, and a regular reporting cadence is in place.
  • Ongoing: The shop maintains a healthy seller score, a sub-12-hour message response rate, and a consistent upward GMV trend quarter-over-quarter.

jobs.description:
About the role

Our Cyber Threat Intelligence & Response (CTIR) engineers are the people we count on when something goes wrong, and the people who make sure it goes wrong far less often. This is a hands-on incident response role. You'll lead the response to security events across our platforms and applications: triage, investigate, contain, eradicate and recover, then make sure we come out of it stronger.

We're looking for someone who genuinely loves incident response. Someone who gets calmer and sharper when an incident kicks off, who is confident making decisions when the picture isn't complete, and who doesn't wait to be told what to look at. If you're a self-starter who takes ownership from the first alert to the final report, you'll fit right in.

Location: Remote

Reports to: VP of Cybersecurity | Cyber Threat Intelligence, Engineering & Response

What you'll do

  • Own incidents as part of the CTIR team: detect, triage, investigate, contain and eradicate, driving each one until the threat is under control.
  • Work live incidents alongside the team and be ready to step up and take the lead yourself when the situation calls for it.
  • Lead investigations across our systems, digging into logs, endpoints, email and network data to work out what happened, how far it reached, and how to resolve.
  • Perform host and network forensics, malware triage, and email analysis (including PDF and document analysis) to understand attacker activity and build a reliable timeline.
  • Coordinate with engineering, IT and the wider security team during a response, and communicate clearly to both technical teams and leadership.
  • Hunt proactively for threats across system logs, user behaviour and threat intelligence, turning what you find into new detections and indicators of compromise.
  • Build and automate incident response workflows and playbooks so routine response is fast and repeatable.
  • Strengthen our detection coverage using the MITRE ATT&CK framework, closing monitoring gaps, and tuning to reduce noise.
  • Feed what you learn from each incident back into how the team detects and responds, so an attack pattern we've seen once is caught faster next time.
  • Analyse threat intelligence, research emerging threats, and recommend practical mitigation.
  • Be ready to work incidents as they arise, including on-call and out-of-hours cover when needed.

What we're looking for

People who want to make a real difference in security, and who care about incident response in particular.

  • 3 to 6 years experience in security operations or incident response, with genuine passion for running incidents, not just watching a queue.
  • Confidence managing incidents through the full incident-handling lifecycle, and the judgement to make sound calls under pressure.
  • Strong triage and root cause analysis, with a solid understanding of different log sources and how to correlate events across them.
  • Comfortable reading logs (HTTP, SMTP, network), Windows and Active Directory, and common operating systems and servers.
  • Hands-on experience with a SIEM to investigate, hunt and build detections. Microsoft Sentinel and KQL preferred.
  • Practical experience across EDR, advanced threat protection, identity management and API security.
  • Threat-hunting experience across network flow, user behaviour and threat intelligence, plus the ability to design new ways to detect and contain attacks using scripting, analytics and automation.
  • Familiar with a broad range of attacker tools and techniques (TTPs), with the ability to map adversary activity across the Cyber Kill Chain to identify, assess, and communicate potential attack progression.
  • A self-starter who works independently, delivering projects without being chased, and keeps learning as the industry develops.
  • A critical thinker with strong problem-solving instincts and exceptional communication skills, capable of translating complex technical risks into clear, actionable insights for both the immediate team and cross-functional partners, including engineers, administrators, and leadership, through both verbal and written communication.
  • Good understanding of ITIL processes and standards such as ISO 27001 and PCI DSS, including change, incident and problem management.

Nice to have

  • Malware analysis experience.
  • Preferred certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, AZ-500 or SC-100.
  • Experience with Jupyter Notebooks for threat-hunting.
  • Python and PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience building and tuning SOAR automation for response.

Since 1953, Ferguson has been a source of quality supplies for a variety of industries. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes and better businesses. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in.

Lighting & Fan Designer, Own Brand Lighting Team at Ferguson

About the Team

Own Brand Lighting designs and manufactures decorative lighting and ceiling fans across a portfolio of brands, serving showroom, designer, builder, light commercial, e commerce channels. Product development sits at the center of the business — working from market insight through to finished product, and partnering directly with our engineering, sourcing, and factory teams around the world. It is a collaborative group where designers own their work end to end and see it reach the market quickly.

Position Summary

We are looking for a designer with a genuine point of view who can create cohesive collections across both mid-range and premium price points.

Someone who can see an opportunity in the market and answer it with a complete, considered collection.

In this role you will create across our full portfolio of decorative and architectural lighting, outdoor lighting, and ceiling fans, carrying products from original concept through approved production sample. You will translate trends, customer insight, historical reference, and market opportunity into products that are both beautiful and commercially successful — and you will be equally at home presenting design direction to leadership and reviewing a sample on the factory floor.

Taste matters here, and so does range. The ability to shift design language and cost structure between our collections while protecting design integrity is central to the work. You will partner closely with the Director of Product Development to build cohesive assortments that advance our brand vision, with real ownership of what you create and room to grow it.

Location: This is approved to be Remote in the US or will be hybrid if you are located in one of our preferred locations: Southern California, Atlanta, Dallas, Cincinnati or Newport News.

Regular travel expected to various domestic offices (GA, CA, TX, OH, VA) and international manufacturing partners.

Specific Responsibilities

Collection Creation & Design Direction

  • Conceive and develop original lighting and fan collections that respond to identified market opportunities and lead, rather than follow, category trends.
  • Bring a clear design point of view to every program — grounded in research, historical reference, and a considered read on where interiors are heading.
  • Balance design vision with commercial viability, manufacturing feasibility, and cost targets, so collections are as buildable as they are beautiful.
  • Identify assortment gaps, pricing opportunities, and finish expansions in partnership with the Product Development team.
  • Explore new materials, finishes, manufacturing techniques, and construction methods that elevate the assortment while meeting quality and pricing goals.

Design Execution & Technical Development

  • Produce presentation-quality renderings, CAD models, technical drawings, and specification packages using SolidWorks, Rhino and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Translate concepts into full-scale, accurate CAD that requires minimal interpretation at the factory, resolving construction, assembly, finish, and pricing questions within the model.
  • Apply a keen sense of scale across a range that runs from small fixtures to very large statement pieces.
  • Read, review, and improve engineering drawings — recommending revisions that achieve high-quality construction and target price points while preserving design integrity.
  • Draw on working knowledge of fixture and mechanical construction, with particular depth in metal and glass manufacturing.

Vendor & Sample Partnership

  • Own communication with domestic and international vendors to convey design intent, resolve technical challenges, and hold development timelines.
  • Manage sample development end to end, evaluating prototypes and providing detailed engineering and quality comments through each round.
  • Participate in virtual and in-person vendor meetings covering concepts, materials, prototypes, engineering solutions, and production readiness.
  • Partner with engineering and sourcing to ensure products meet performance, quality, sustainability, and cost objectives.

Communication & Project Leadership

  • Create compelling presentations that carry design inspiration, historical reference, competitive context, and technical development through to final direction.
  • Maintain development trackers, timelines, and sample organization so programs land on schedule.
  • Manage several projects at once with accountability and consistently high-quality output.
  • Contribute to the creative culture of the team by sharing research, references, and emerging trends.
  • Travel domestically and internationally to visit vendors, factories, trade shows, and design markets.

Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of product design experience, preferably in lighting or ceiling fans.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates an original point of view and real taste — ideally including complete collections taken from concept to market.
  • Proven track record of bringing products from concept through production on seasonal development calendars.
  • Strong understanding of lighting construction, materials, finishes, manufacturing methods, electrical components, and production processes.
  • Advanced proficiency in SolidWorks or comparable parametric CAD software such as Rhino.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop and InDesign, along with comparable rendering tools.
  • Fluency in manufacturing documentation, technical drawings, specification development, and production communication.
  • Direct experience collaborating with manufacturing partners.
  • Ability to translate trends, historical reference, and market insight into commercially successful product.
  • Excellent presentation, storytelling, and communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and project management abilities, with the range to prioritize several development calendars without losing attention to detail.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach to problem solving.
  • High standards for design excellence, craftsmanship, quality, and innovation.
  • Must enjoy working in a fast-paced environment.
  • A growth mindset, resilience, and genuine enthusiasm for the work and for travel.

jobs.title: E-Commerce Copywriter
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for an E-Commerce Copywriter who understands that great product copy is about more than describing what a product does.
jobs.description:
We're looking for an E-Commerce Copywriter who understands that great product copy is about more than describing what a product does. You understand the relationship between products, customers, messaging, SEO, and conversion—and you know how to turn product features into compelling reasons to buy.

The Role

As our E-Commerce Copywriter, you'll help shape how Zulay Kitchen's products are presented across our e-commerce channels. You'll write and optimize product listings, develop messaging for new products, research customers and competitors, and continuously look for ways to make our copy more compelling and conversion-focused.

We're looking for someone who is a strong writer, customer-focused, creative, curious, and obsessed with figuring out what makes people click—and buy.

What You'll Do

E-Commerce Copywriting

  • Write and optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, and other e-commerce content.
  • Create compelling product copy that clearly communicates what the product does, why it matters, and why customers should choose it.
  • Turn product features into customer-focused benefits and persuasive messaging.
  • Develop copy for Amazon listings, Shopify product pages, A+ Content, social media, email campaigns, product packaging, and other customer-facing marketing materials.
  • Write messaging for new product launches, promotions, and other marketing initiatives.
  • Maintain a consistent and recognizable Zulay Kitchen brand voice across product content.

Conversion & Product Messaging

  • Review existing product listings and identify opportunities to improve clarity, engagement, and conversion.
  • Analyze customer reviews, questions, feedback, and competitor listings to understand what customers care about.
  • Identify customer pain points, objections, motivations, and purchasing triggers.
  • Develop messaging that addresses customer concerns and makes the value of our products immediately clear.
  • Help identify the strongest selling points and differentiators for each product.
  • Continuously test and refine messaging based on performance and customer response.

SEO & Marketplace Optimization

  • Conduct keyword research and incorporate relevant search terms naturally into product copy.
  • Optimize listings for search visibility without sacrificing readability or persuasive messaging.
  • Stay current on Amazon and e-commerce SEO best practices.
  • Research competitors and identify opportunities to differentiate Zulay Kitchen products.
  • Keep up with changes in marketplace algorithms, customer behavior, and e-commerce trends.

Research & Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to develop and execute product messaging and content strategies.
  • Collaborate with Category Managers, Amazon Sales Specialists, Designers, and other team members to understand products and their target customers.
  • Conduct product and market research before developing copy.
  • Partner with the creative team to make sure copy and visuals work together to tell a strong product story.
  • Take feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve your work.

You'd Be a Great Fit If...

You don't just look at a product and ask "What does it do?"

You ask:

"Why would someone want this?"

"What problem is this solving?"

"What would make a customer choose this over the competition?"
"What might stop someone from buying?"
"How can we communicate the value in a way that makes people want to click 'Add to Cart'?"

You're able to take a product with a list of features and turn it into copy that makes the customer understand why they need it.

You're equally comfortable researching competitors and customer reviews, analyzing an existing product listing, and sitting down to write a strong headline or product description.

You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be improved. You're constantly looking for opportunities to make our listings clearer, more compelling, and more likely to convert.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional copywriting experience, preferably in e-commerce, DTC, retail, or consumer products.
  • Proven experience writing product listings or conversion-focused copy.
  • Excellent written English, grammar, and editing skills.
  • Strong understanding of customer psychology and persuasive writing.
  • Experience with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces is highly preferred.
  • Understanding of e-commerce SEO and keyword optimization.
  • Strong research skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple products and deadlines independently.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating on copy.
  • A strong instinct for what makes copy clear, engaging, and convincing.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Amazon A+ Content / Enhanced Brand Content.
  • Familiarity with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar tools.
  • Shopify experience.
  • Experience working with physical consumer products, particularly kitchen, home, or lifestyle brands.
  • Experience collaborating with designers, photographers, or creative teams.
  • Experience using AI tools to support research and content workflows while maintaining originality and brand voice.

This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Join a team that’s changing financial services

Zocks is the #1 AI assistant for financial advisors. We help advisors automate their operational work and grow their business. 5,000+ firms use Zocks to turn client conversations into completed work.

We're a venture-backed team, building something that changes how financial advisors serve their clients every day. Every role here is an opportunity to shape the product, the company, and the way an entire industry works. We hire sharp, curious, and kind people who want to do meaningful work and build something from the ground up, together.


WHO YOU ARE

The SHARC in the room

At Zocks, we hire for SHARC - five qualities that define how our best people work and win together.

S - Sharp

You move fast without cutting corners. Quick decisions, thoughtful execution - you know when to act independently and when to loop in leadership.

H - Hungry

You're a self-starter who celebrates teammates as loudly as your own wins. Humble hustle is your default mode.

A - Adaptable

Startup life means things shift fast. You lean into change, pivot gracefully, and genuinely enjoy figuring out what's next.

R - Resilient

Building something new isn't always smooth. You bounce back stronger, see obstacles as puzzles, and never lose sight of the bigger picture.

C - Curious

You ask the questions others miss. You explore for fun, not just for work - and it shows in the quality of your thinking.

About the Role

Zocks sells into compliance-sensitive financial services buyers - RIAs, IBDs, and wealth management firms - who put every vendor through security and compliance diligence before signing. Today, that diligence work falls on individual AEs, who complete VDDQs, RFPs, and RFIs themselves on top of their deal work, with no single owner, no shared knowledge base, and no visibility into how much it's costing the business in cycle time.

The Trust & Compliance Operations Manager owns this function end to end - the data room, the trust center, the VDDQ/RFP response process - turning diligence from a deal-blocking bottleneck reps absorb into a well-run, self-service function that shortens sales cycles and reinforces trust with our buyers, pre- and post-sale.

What You’ll Do

1. VDDQ, RFP, and RFI Ownership

  • Serve as the single point of accountability for every vendor due diligence questionnaire, RFP, and RFI that touches a deal - new business, renewal, or expansion.
  • Take response ownership off individual AEs entirely, running intake, drafting, internal review, and submission as a repeatable process.
  • Track every open request to a defined SLA and flag at-risk deals to Sales leadership before they slip.

2. Knowledge Base and Trust Center

  • Build and maintain a living knowledge base of pre-approved, audit-ready answers to recurring security, privacy, and compliance questions.
  • Keep that knowledge base current with each SOC 2 cycle, policy update, or material product/infrastructure change.
  • Partner with Engineering to scope and launch a self-service trust center when the knowledge base and process are mature enough to support it.

3. Data Room Management

  • Own the structure and upkeep of the due diligence data room - taxonomy, document versioning, access controls, and what's customer-facing versus internal.
  • Ensure every document in the room reflects the current state of Zocks' security and compliance posture, not a stale snapshot from the last deal.

4. Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Act as the connective tissue between Security, Legal, and Product on one side and Sales/CS on the other, so sales teams get accurate, current information without chasing multiple internal owners.
  • Build direct relationships with subject-matter owners in each function to keep source information flowing without manual chasing on every request.

5. Reporting and Commercial Impact

  • Define and publish an SLA for DDQ/RFP turnaround, and hold the function to it.
  • Report quarterly on deals unblocked or accelerated by the function, quantified in $ ARR, so leadership can see the direct commercial value of the work.

What We’re Looking For

Requirements

  • 4+ years experience owning VDDQs/RFPs/RFIs end to end, ideally in a regulated B2B SaaS environment
  • Working knowledge of security, privacy, and compliance frameworks relevant to financial-services vendors - SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, GLBA/Reg S-P, and SEC/FINRA vendor oversight expectations
  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical and legal detail into plain-English, customer-ready language under deadline pressure
  • Experience building repeatable process and structure (data room taxonomy, knowledge base, SLAs) rather than handling diligence as one-off firefighting
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Security, Legal, Engineering, and Product to source accurate answers without deep technical expertise in each domain
  • Experience operating directly with prospects' and customers' security, compliance, and vendor-management teams, including on live diligence calls
  • Experience in or selling to financial services, wealthtech, or another regulated industry strongly preferred, given Zocks' focus on financial advisors and wealth management firms
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

LOGISTICS

  • This is a remote position, but we are currently only able to hire candidates who reside in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IA, KS, MA, MI, NE, NJ, NV, NY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, WA, WI
  • Background and reference checks required as part of onboarding

Interview process:

  • 30-min recruiter screen
  • Up to three 30-45-min video or onsite interviews
  • Offer pending references.

Total estimated time: ~3 hours

COMPENSATION

  • $150,000-$175,000 base salary
  • Equity - we're all building this together

BENEFITS

The full picture

Health

  • Medical: 100% of employee premium covered (UnitedHealthcare Select Plus network, 2 plan options)
  • Dental: 99% covered - Guardian, $1,500 annual benefit
  • Vision: 99% covered - Guardian/VSP, $150 frames & contacts allowance
  • FSA: Zocks matches dollar-for-dollar up to $500/year

Time off

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid sick time
  • 11 paid holidays

Family

  • Birthing parent: 12 weeks fully paid parental leave
  • Non-birthing parent: 6 weeks fully paid parental leave

Financial

  • 401(k) via Guideline - Pre-tax and Roth options; low-cost Vanguard funds

Everything else

  • MacBook laptop + Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom provided
  • Equity grant - details included as part of your offer
  • Growth opportunities for high performers after 6 months
  • Collaborative, low-ego culture with smart, kind teammates

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. We believe diversity drives creativity, innovation, and success - and we encourage all qualified people to apply.

Irás colaborar com equipas técnicas e de negócio para definir políticas, standards e processos que garantam qualidade, segurança e utilização responsável dos dados.

Terás também um papel ativo na evolução de estratégias de governance relacionadas com plataformas modernas de dados e iniciativas de AI/ML.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar iniciativas de Data Governance em equipas de negócio e tecnologia;
  • Definir, documentar e manter políticas, standards e frameworks de governação de dados;
  • Colaborar com stakeholders para alinhar processos de governance com objetivos de negócio e requisitos regulatórios;
  • Gerir e otimizar workflows de governance utilizando plataformas ITSM e colaboração;
  • Apoiar implementação e manutenção de catálogos de dados, metadata e data registries;
  • Garantir conformidade com regulamentações e frameworks de governance;
  • Promover qualidade, consistência e accountability dos dados;
  • Contribuir para estratégias de governance aplicadas a soluções AI/ML e uso responsável de dados.

O que Procuramos

  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em Data Governance, Data Management ou Compliance;
  • Experiência comprovada na colaboração com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio;
  • Experiência na documentação de políticas, schemas e processos utilizando ferramentas como Confluence, Notion ou Miro;
  • Conhecimentos de plataformas ITSM e workflow management (ServiceNow ou Jira);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de data registry e data management (Airtable ou similares);
  • Familiaridade com frameworks regulatórios e de governance (GDPR, NIST, ISO 42001);
  • Conhecimentos de plataformas de data catalog e metadata management;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e inglês fluente (oral e escrito).

Será valorizado:

  • Experiência com frameworks de governance aplicados a AI/ML e Responsible AI;
  • Familiaridade com plataformas modernas de dados e ecossistemas cloud;
  • Experiência em iniciativas de transformação enterprise relacionadas com governance;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e orientação para melhoria contínua.

O que Oferecemos

  • Regime totalmente remoto a partir de Portugal;
  • Participação em projetos estratégicos de Data Governance e transformação digital;
  • Integração numa equipa colaborativa e orientada à excelência;
  • Ambiente focado em inovação, compliance e boas práticas de gestão de dados;
  • Oportunidades de crescimento técnico e evolução profissional;
  • Contacto com ecossistemas modernos de dados e AI governance;
  • Pacote salarial competitivo, ajustado à experiência.

Queres liderar iniciativas de governação de dados e contribuir para uma cultura orientada à qualidade e confiança da informação?

Junta-te a nós e ajuda a construir práticas de Data Governance modernas, escaláveis e preparadas para o futuro.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The Cybersecurity Engineer is responsible for independently executing defined security engineering and operational work across Accela’s endpoints, identities, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems. This role applies established security standards and practices to troubleshoot issues, maintain technical controls, analyze findings, implement solutions, and identify opportunities to improve how the team operates.

The Cybersecurity Engineer partners with IT, Engineering, DevOps, IAM, Compliance, and other teams to maintain effective technical safeguards while supporting business continuity. The role is expected to independently manage routine and moderately complex work, make sound decisions within established practices, and escalate highly complex or unfamiliar matters to senior engineers or security leadership as appropriate.

The ideal candidate brings strong enterprise IT experience, hands-on exposure to security technologies, and the ability to take ownership of assigned work from identification through resolution. This individual is also expected to identify recurring issues, recommend process or automation improvements, and continue building technical depth across security tooling, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Independently manage endpoint security and compliance activities across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments, including security baselines, EDR and antivirus agents, disk encryption, MDM, and operating system hardening.
  • Administer and troubleshoot identity and access controls, including account provisioning and deprovisioning, SSO, MFA, conditional access, and authentication issues.
  • Monitor and analyze alerts and logs within SIEM, EDR, and related platforms, perform initial triage, take appropriate action within established procedures, and escalate complex findings when necessary.
  • Conduct initial technical investigations by gathering and analyzing evidence, documenting findings, and recommending appropriate next steps.
  • Manage assigned vulnerability-management activities, including reviewing scan results, evaluating severity and exploitability, coordinating remediation with system owners, and tracking work through completion.
  • Perform periodic access reviews, recertification activities, privileged-access reviews, and third-party access validation to support least-privilege practices.
  • Own defined workstreams within security technology implementations, including planning, testing, configuration, pilot deployments, documentation, and rollout support.
  • Maintain assigned technical controls and support evidence collection and control activities associated with SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and other applicable frameworks.
  • Develop and maintain scripts or automation using tools such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python to reduce manual effort and improve operational consistency.
  • Independently troubleshoot routine and moderately complex technical issues and coordinate with appropriate teams to drive issues through resolution.
  • Partner with IT, Engineering, DevOps, IAM, and Platform teams to validate technical findings, test configuration changes, and provide security guidance before broader deployment.
  • Identify recurring operational issues and recommend improvements to processes, tooling, configurations, automation, or documentation.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, workflows, and knowledge resources that enable consistent execution and effective knowledge sharing.
  • Use operational data and technical findings to identify trends and recommend improvements to security practices and processes.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of team workflows by identifying opportunities to simplify work, improve consistency, and reduce repetitive manual activities.
  • Maintain current knowledge of evolving security technologies, cloud platforms, industry practices, and emerging technical threats.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise IT, endpoint operations, identity and access management, security operations, systems administration, or a related technical field.
  • Hands-on experience maintaining and troubleshooting endpoint technologies across Windows, macOS, and Linux, including EDR or antivirus agents, MDM, disk encryption, and operating system configurations.
  • Working knowledge of identity and access management technologies and practices, including Active Directory, SSO, MFA, conditional access, and account lifecycle management.
  • Experience reviewing technical logs, troubleshooting alerts, conducting initial investigations, or supporting vulnerability-management activities.
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, or similar SaaS environments and understanding their identity and access models.
  • Experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar scripting and command-line tools for troubleshooting or automating routine tasks.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage assigned technical work, determine appropriate next steps, and escalate when issues exceed established scope or expertise.
  • Ability to identify recurring issues and recommend practical improvements to tools, workflows, documentation, or technical processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate technical information and make sound decisions.
  • Strong documentation skills, including experience creating and maintaining runbooks, workflows, technical procedures, or knowledge resources.
  • Ability to balance technical requirements with operational and business needs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience securing SaaS platforms in regulated, public-sector, or customer-trust-driven environments.
  • Experience supporting SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, GovRAMP, PCI DSS, NIST 800-53, or similar compliance frameworks.
  • Experience partnering directly with security, IAM, DevOps, CloudOps, or platform engineering teams in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM and EDR platforms, log analysis, alert triage, and vulnerability-management tools.
  • Familiarity with Azure, AWS, or GCP and cloud security concepts such as IAM roles, network controls, logging, and configuration management.
  • Experience implementing or supporting security technology deployments and technical configuration changes.
  • Experience participating in an on-call or security operations rotation.
  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, SSCP, Microsoft SC-200, AZ-500, or equivalent technical certifications.

ABOUT ACCELA
For nearly 20 years, Accela has been an industry leader in designing and delivering government software to improve efficiency, increase citizen engagement and enable the development of thriving communities. Today, citizens are savvy to how services should be delivered, and expect a consistently convenient, openly transparent view into their local government. While government agencies struggle to do more with less, our mission has never been more critical. Accela provides a robust, cloud-based platform of government software solutions that accelerate growth, efficiency, and transparency in communities of all sizes. From planning, to building, to service request management and more, Accela’s SaaS offerings level the playing field for small and medium governments and enable smaller agencies to leverage larger city technologies. Our open and flexible technology helps agencies address specific needs today, while ensuring they are well prepared for the emerging challenges of the future.

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION
Accela believes in developing and nurturing a workplace community where our differences are celebrated, and everyone feels a sense of psychological safety and belonging. Accela is committed to putting resources and attention towards evolving our practices, policies, and philosophies to enable diversity to thrive and to support equity in opportunity for everyone.

COMPENSATION AND WELL-BEING
The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $90,000-$110,000 (less applicable taxes). The actual annual base salary offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, location, education, skills, training, and experience. In addition to an annual base salary, this position is eligible for an annual bonus target. This is a discretionary bonus awarded based on company and individual goal achievement.

jobs.excerpt: Creative Strategist - DIY Art Club (SMT Group)Remote | $7,000–$8,000 gross per month + uncapped performance bonus DIY Art Club / SMT Group is hiring its first in-house Creative Strategist to take ownership of paid social creative across three international paint-by-numbers brands.
jobs.description:
Creative Strategist - DIY Art Club (SMT Group)

Remote | $7,000–$8,000 gross per month + uncapped performance bonus

DIY Art Club / SMT Group is hiring its first in-house Creative Strategist to take ownership of paid social creative across three international paint-by-numbers brands.

SMT Group is an international arts and crafts eCommerce group founded in 2016. It operates through local brands in each market rather than a single global storefront, allowing the team to build propositions, creative and customer experiences around individual markets.

Today, the group has:

  • More than five million customers across 20+ countries.

  • Over 150,000 new customers every month.

  • 6 figure profitable daily Meta spend.

  • More than 100 new product designs launched each week.

SMT’s ambition is to become the world’s leading eCommerce group for creative hobby products, making creativity accessible and encouraging people to spend more time creating rather than scrolling.

The business is flat, fast-moving and highly commercial. People are trusted to own their area, make decisions and remain accountable for the outcome.

You’ll be joining SMT Group, supporting across the below brands;

Schilder op Nummers - Netherlands

DIY Malen nach Zahlen - Germany

DIY Art Club - US, UK, Australia, Canada and France

The Role

The Creative Strategist will own the in-house creative running across SMT Group’s three paint-by-numbers brands.

This is a senior, commercially important appointment within a group approaching 9 figure revenue and spending 6 figures a day on Meta, profitably.

That level of spend has been managed without a dedicated internal Creative Strategist. The founders, internal team and external agencies have built a successful operation, but there is significant untapped potential in how creative concepts are identified, produced, tested and scaled.

The person joining will be given access to the data, customer research, budget and production resource required to make a material impact. They will not inherit a finished creative playbook. They will be expected to build it.

Meta represents approximately 85% of paid media spend and will be the primary focus of the role. At the current level of investment, creative quality is the main constraint on how far the business can increase spend while remaining profitable.

The central responsibility is finding the right creative bets.

You will go into the performance data, customer research and existing account history, identify meaningful opportunities and turn those insights into specific, testable concepts. You will then brief the production team, launch the work and use the results to determine what should be scaled, iterated or stopped.

This is not a role where somebody else provides the strategy or hands you a list of briefs. The closest description is an entrepreneur building and running their own creative department.

What you will own

  • The paid social creative strategy across all three paint-by-numbers brands.

  • Identifying new concepts, angles, personas and use cases from performance data and customer insight.

  • Building a scalable system that moves from analysis to hypothesis, briefing, production, testing and learning.

  • Establishing which angles and customer personas are commercially viable and where the business should expand.

  • Using evidence to disprove weak assumptions as well as identify opportunities. Stopping an angle with clear data is considered a valuable result.

  • Creating original concepts rather than relying exclusively on competitor research or recycled briefs.

  • Writing clear, commercially grounded briefs for editors and designers.

  • Directing a creative pod consisting of a video editor, AI video editor and designer.

  • Taking responsibility for the quality and commercial performance of the pod’s output.

  • Improving the volume, speed and consistency of creative testing.

  • Raising the ceiling on profitable Meta spend across the group.

  • Building the foundations for an internal creative strategy function as further Creative Strategists join the business.

What SMT Group is looking for

This is a senior appointment for somebody who has already built and scaled performance creative within a high-growth company.

You must be able to show that you have:

  • Built a creative system or function rather than simply inheriting an established one.

  • Worked at a meaningful level of paid media spend, where creative decisions had a measurable commercial impact.

  • Developed customer personas, creative angles and use cases from scratch for another brand.

  • Created original concepts and can explain which ideas were yours, how they were tested and what happened commercially.

  • Strong experience with Meta advertising and direct-response creative.

  • The ability to read performance data, understand what earned spend, identify why creative failed and form a testable hypothesis independently.

  • Directed video editors and designers, including within a remote working environment.

  • Worked professionally in English.

  • The confidence to enter a large, profitable account and determine where to focus without being shown.

Experience in the following areas would be particularly valuable:

  • DTC or direct-response eCommerce.

  • Weekly creative and performance accountability.

  • Ad copywriting and scriptwriting.

  • AI-assisted creative production.

  • Running creative across multiple international markets, particularly the Netherlands, Germany and English-speaking territories.

Team and reporting line

You will report directly to Sil , Co-founder and Co-CEO of SMT Group.

A supporting creative pod consisting of a video editor, AI video editor and designer is currently being hired. Further Creative Strategists are expected to join within months.

The intention is to create an open, performance-led environment in which strategists can see which work is moving the account and learn from one another. The first person joining will have a genuine opportunity to establish the standard for the function and, over time, lead it.

Package and working arrangements

  • Base: $7,000–$8,000 gross per month, full-time.

  • Bonus: 5% of the ad spend running on creative you originated, paid from the day you join.

  • Bonus potential: Uncapped and expected to exceed the base salary for somebody producing successful, scalable creative.

  • Contract: SMT Group can accommodate either an employee or contractor arrangement.

  • Location: Fully remote.

  • Working style: High trust and output-led. SMT does not clock-watch; you own your schedule while remaining reliable to the wider team.

  • Time off: Flexible and coordinated around the team and key commercial launch periods.

  • Team meetings: Quarterly in Utrecht, the Netherlands, with travel arranged and paid for by SMT Group.

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

Culture

SMT Group operates around four clear principles:

  • Ownership over hierarchy: You are trusted to run your domain, regardless of title.

  • Data over opinions: Ideas are tested, measured and improved.

  • Speed through clarity: Learning from execution is more valuable than prolonged debate.

  • High standards and accountability: This is a fast-paced environment with a significant amount still to be built.

This opportunity will suit somebody who wants genuine autonomy, substantial budgets and a direct connection between the quality of their thinking and the commercial result.

It will not suit somebody looking to inherit a finished playbook or wait for another person to define what should be tested.

If this sounds like you, hit apply or email Sam find out more!

WE ARE

Supply Chain & Operations — and we move fast, think fast, and work fast. Our Fortune 500 clients in life sciences, med-tech, and advanced manufacturing demand more than incremental improvement; they need partners who can redesign distribution center operations from the ground up, build the data infrastructure to sustain those gains, and lead the capital programs that make it real.

Our practitioners combine deep operational expertise with consulting discipline — translating complexity into clear value cases, running rigorous simulations, and staying accountable for outcomes long after design is complete.

YOU ARE

An operations and logistics engineer who has done the work — not just advised on it. You have redesigned live distribution centers under cGMP or regulated conditions, built the simulation models that justified the investment, and managed capital programs from concept through commissioning.

You speak the language of warehouse flow, automation systems, and regulatory compliance, and you know how to translate operational insight into a financial value case that wins executive sign-off. You are ready to bring that credibility into a consulting environment and accelerate impact across a portfolio of clients.

THE WORK

  • Lead operational assessment and redesign engagements for life sciences and regulated distribution centers — diagnosing inefficiencies in material flow, storage utilization, labor models, and automation maturity.

  • Design future-state DC layouts and material handling strategies (ASRS, AMR fleets, automated labeling, pick-and-place) and quantify ROI through structured value cases tied to throughput, cost, and compliance outcomes.

  • Build and run simulation models and process analyses to validate design decisions, stress-test capacity scenarios, and support client leadership in capital prioritization discussions.

  • Lead capital project workstreams — managing design milestones, commissioning activities (IQ/OQ/PQ), vendor coordination, and regulatory readiness across FDA/EMA environments.

  • Partner with client IT, Quality, Manufacturing, and Regulatory teams to ensure integrated solutions meet operational requirements and pass inspection without findings.

  • Develop operational readiness plans, staffing models, and KPI frameworks that sustain performance post go-live.

  • Apply data and analytics (dashboards, automated reporting, process metrics) to surface opportunity, monitor progress, and drive continuous improvement culture with client teams.

  • Contribute to business development by shaping points of view, developing proposal content, and bringing credible operational stories into client conversations.

Job Requirements:

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

HERE'S WHAT YOU NEED

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in warehouse, distribution, or logistics engineering roles — with direct accountability for operational outcomes, not just advisory support.

  • Demonstrated experience optimizing brownfield DC operations: redesigning flow, improving throughput, reducing cost, and implementing change in a live operating environment.

  • Experience designing new or expanded DC facilities, including floorplan development, material flow definition, and integration of automation systems.

  • Life sciences, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industry experience — particularly in cGMP environments with FDA, EMA, or comparable regulatory authority exposure.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate degree, must have a minimum of 6 years’ work experience)

BONUS POINTS IF

  • Proficiency in data-driven decision making — including process simulation, capacity modeling, time studies, and KPI dashboard development (Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx, or equivalent).

  • Experience developing value cases for capital investments — translating operational design into financial projections that support executive approval.

  • Track record managing capital projects or major operational programs, including milestone accountability, vendor management, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment.

  • Experience leading commissioning and qualification activities (IQ/OQ/PQ) for warehouse or manufacturing systems.

  • Familiarity with WMS or ERP systems (SAP EWM, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, or similar) and how system configuration intersects with operational design.

  • Lean or continuous improvement certification (Green Belt or higher) and demonstrated application of lean principles in an engineering context.

  • Experience building and leading small technical teams — developing junior engineers and establishing operational best practices.

  • Interest in growing consulting skills: structuring problems, developing client relationships, and contributing to a high-performance delivery team.

Tether is seeking a highly skilled and versatile Internal Audit Manager to support the execution of its global internal audit program. Operating in a fast paced digital asset environment, the ideal candidate will have a strong background in operational and financial audits from a leading consulting or audit firm.

  • Promote a strong risk and control culture across the organization through audit engagement and awareness.

  • Stay current on industry developments, emerging risks, and regulatory frameworks.

  • Apply IIA standards and contribute to the evolution of audit methodologies and quality processes.

Requirements

jobs.excerpt: We are a healthcare technology company that provides platforms and solutions to improve the management and access of cost-effective pharmacy benefits.
jobs.description:
We are a healthcare technology company that provides platforms and solutions to improve the management and access of cost-effective pharmacy benefits. Our technology helps enterprise and partnership clients simplify their businesses and helps consumers save on prescriptions.

As a leader in SaaS technology for healthcare, we offer innovative solutions with integrated intelligence on a single enterprise platform that connects the pharmacy ecosystem. With our expertise and modern, modular platform, our partners use real-time data to transform their business performance and optimize their innovative models in the marketplace.

About RxSense

RxSense is a privately held health technology company that is re-envisioning the platforms and data solutions used to manage pharmacy benefits in order to make prescription drugs more affordable for everyone. RxSense also provides prescription benefit solutions directly to millions of people through its consumer brand, SingleCare. We have saved our customers over $4B on prescription medications since 2015.

We are a team of forward thinking, experienced health and technology professionals working together to solve big problems and create value in an industry that is personal for everyone - healthcare.

About the role

RxSense sits at the intersection of pharmacy benefits and technology. We are building a new cloud platform that we own end to end, and it will carry the next generation of RxSense products, from established pharmacy benefit services to AI-native applications.

We are hiring a Principal Platform Engineer to lead the technical build. You will set the direction for how services across engineering are built, deployed, secured, observed, and paid for. This is a greenfield platform with real production stakes: the decisions you make in the first year become the defaults every engineer works inside of for years after.

This is a hands-on principal role, not an architecture-diagram role. You will write Terraform and Helm, shape CI/CD, harden clusters, and set the standards the rest of engineering codes against.You will be embedded with AI Engineering, the team pushing hardest on the platform today, and you will partner closely with data engineering so analytics and pipeline workloads are first-class from the start.

What you will do

  • Build the infrastructure as code foundation. Design and maintain a Terraform monorepo across dev, QA, staging, and production, covering Kubernetes clusters, networking, IAM, and per-application platform stacks. Keep state layout, module boundaries, and provider baselines clean and current.
  • Run Kubernetes at production quality. Operate EKS clusters end to end: node lifecycle, autoscaling, ingress, workload identity, secrets delivery, and cluster security. Keep clusters hardened and appropriately isolated.
  • Build and defend the deploy pipeline. Build push-based CI/CD on self-hosted GitHub Actions runners, with build-once, promote-everywhere artifact immutability across environments. Enforce a promotion flow so no environment is ever skipped and production always mirrors a released artifact.
  • Make the platform the fastest path to production. Maintain a shared Helm chart library and per-service charts (backend, frontend, scheduled jobs) that every service deploys through. Build golden paths so a new service reaches production on day one with logging, metrics, secrets, identity, and a pipeline already wired in. Push per-application behavior into configuration rather than chart branching.
  • Harden the security and compliance posture. Set least-privilege IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, image provenance, and production guardrails. Make controls automatic where you can and auditable where you cannot, so evidence for security reviews falls out of the platform instead of getting assembled by hand.
  • Keep cloud spend predictable. Treat cost as a platform property. Establish tagging and allocation that answer what each service and environment actually costs, right-size compute, and keep spend predictable as traffic, data, and model inference grow.
  • Build observability in, not on. Establish structured logging, metrics, tracing, and correlation across service hops as a default property of the platform. Treat telemetry contracts as published, versioned schemas rather than debug output.
  • Set standards. Define the platform conventions (tagging, naming, DNS, versioning, security posture) and document the reasoning behind them. Review infrastructure and deploy changes, mentor engineers, and make the platform something the team can extend.
  • Partner across engineering. Work with application, data, and AI teams so the platform fits how services actually run, including the contracts they deploy against and the environments they promote through.

Education/Experience/Competencies

  • 8 + years building and operating production platform infrastructure. Not a hard cutoff: strong candidates with less experience can still be considered.
  • Proven, hands-on experience operating production Kubernetes end to end, including cluster lifecycle, autoscaling, ingress, workload identity, secrets delivery, and hardening (EKS preferred).
  • Proven, hands-on experience owning infrastructure as code in Terraform at scale, including module design, state layout across multiple environments, and provider upgrades.
  • A track record of building or substantially rebuilding a CI/CD system yourself (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo, Jenkins), with clear positions on artifact immutability, build-once and promote-everywhere delivery, and keeping application pipelines thin.
  • Experience running self-hosted GitHub Actions runners at scale.
  • Hands-on depth in AWS: IAM, VPC networking and DNS, secrets management (e.g., Secrets Manager, External Secrets), container registries, and managed compute.
  • Hands-on experience with Helm at scale, including shared chart libraries, templating boundaries, and per environment configuration, alongside GitOps or push-based deployment workflows.
  • Proven experience building the developer-facing side of a platform: service templates, golden paths, self-service tooling, and documentation.
  • Hands-on experience implementing observability, including structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana, Datadog), with correlation that holds across service boundaries.
  • Practical security experience in a regulated or security-sensitive environment: least privilege IAM, secrets hygiene, network isolation, image provenance and scanning, and rigorous PHI/PII handling, built so audit evidence comes out of the platform rather than getting assembled by hand.
  • Experience supporting data workloads on Kubernetes (e.g., Spark, Kafka, or orchestration tools such as Airflow or Dagster).
  • Demonstrated cloud cost ownership, including tagging and allocation, right sizing, and measurable spend reduction that did not degrade reliability.
  • A track record of writing and shipping production code yourself, not just producing diagrams and design documents. Working fluency in at least one backend language (e.g., Python, Go, C# / .NET) and comfort in the shell.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. You translate infrastructure and deployment decisions into terms engineers, architects, and non-technical leadership can act on, and you write things down so decisions outlive the conversation.
  • Experience mentoring engineers on infrastructure, deployment, and platform thinking, and setting standards a team can extend safely without you in the room.
  • Comfort working in a small, fast moving team where you will wear multiple hats, and a bias toward directness over ceremony: minimal dependency sprawl, skepticism of abstractions that do not earn their cost, and a preference for clear, traceable systems over fashionable patterns.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, pharmacy benefits, or another regulated data environment.
  • Direct experience preparing infrastructure evidence for HIPAA, SOC 2, or comparable audits.
  • Experience standing up platforms from scratch (greenfield), not just extending or migrating existing systems.
  • Experience supporting latency-sensitive or high-throughput services, including workloads that call large language models, with attention to cost and latency.

Salary Range: 190,000 - 235,000
