MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
  • Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
  • Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
  • Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
  • Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
  • Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.

Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
  • Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
  • Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
  • Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.

Influence & Impact

  • Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
  • Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
  • Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries

Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact

  • Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
  • Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
  • Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
  • Identify recurring customer, access, and patient-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights

  • Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.
  • Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
  • Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
  • Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.

Entrepreneurial Drive, Resilience & Culture

  • Operate with a high degree of ownership, self-motivation, resourcefulness, and initiative in an unstructured, rapidly evolving rare disease environment.
  • Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
  • Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.
  • Model Mirum's values and the highest standards of ethical conduct, compliance, transparency, inclusion, and respect in every internal and external interaction.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive sales experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently delivering business results in a complex specialty, rare disease, orphan drug, or high-science market.
  • Rare disease experience is highly preferred; experience in hepatology, gastroenterology, pediatric specialty care, or another complex specialty market is highly desirable.
  • Strong clinical aptitude and demonstrated ability to learn, retain, and communicate complex disease-state, diagnostic, mechanism-of-action, clinical-data, and product information.
  • Experience with account-based selling across health systems, centers of excellence, multidisciplinary care teams, referral networks, and influential healthcare professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to use insight-led or challenger-style selling to constructively challenge the status quo, influence behavior, and advance customer decision-making.
  • Working knowledge of access and reimbursement dynamics, patient support pathways, and the role of patient services in rare disease markets.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to interpret performance data, identify insights, develop territory and account strategies, and translate plans into consistent field execution.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, communication, presentation, judgment, and ability to build trust with diverse and highly sophisticated customers.
  • Proven self-motivation, resourcefulness, resilience, organization, and ability to prioritize and perform independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
  • Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, and Analytics.
  • Commitment to ethical conduct, compliance, and approved promotional practices, with sound judgment in complex customer and patient-related situations.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 70%, including frequent overnight travel and occasional weekend commitments.

The Director leads a high-performing client engagement team, sets the tone for relationship excellence, cross-functional collaboration, and catalyzing impact through investing and grant making. Bringing deep expertise across philanthropy, impact investing, and developing systems that scale, this leader drives continuous improvement, elevates client satisfaction, and positions ImpactAssets to grow in step with the aspirations of the clients.
The Director of Client Engagement role is a full time, remote position and can work from anywhere in the US. As a remote, people-first culture, we care deeply about our team members’ connections to one another and as such, travel 2-3 times per year to company events will be required.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance
  • Lead the client engagement team with a performance-first mindset, setting clear expectations, modeling excellence, and holding a high bar for accountability at every level.
  • Establish the infrastructure and frameworks the team needs to operate and scale. This includes systems, operating rhythms, KPIs (response times, onboarding cycle time, NPS, retention and expansion indicators), and effective use of CRM and other tools.
  • Monitor performance against OKRs and KPIs; conduct regular business reviews and address performance gaps with consistency and follow-through.
  • Set standards for written and verbal client communication excellence; recognize strong performance and address coaching opportunities.
  • Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing client engagement team, building bench strength and clear growth paths across Client Engagement Officers and, as the team scales, specialist roles.
Client Engagement
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex client issues, nuanced service requests, and situations requiring judgment beyond standard operating procedures; resolve challenges proactively and coordinate with other senior leaders and executives as needed.
  • Ensure excellent onboarding experience for complex or strategic relationships, working cross-functionally to structure creative service solutions, ensure execution excellence, and drive timely resolution of issues.
  • Establish annual client engagement plans for top tier clients with Client Engagement officers, setting clear cross-selling, retention, and new contribution goals.
  • Lead through influence across the organization; coordinate cross-functionally to ensure seamless handoffs from prospect to onboarding to steady-state servicing; track expansion and improvement opportunities surfaced through client engagement.
  • Build and maintain a centralized, multi-quarter client experience improvement plan that prioritizes service and engagement upgrades, efficiencies, and cross-functional projects.
  • Identify patterns in client needs to inform product development, service design, and organizational priorities.
Cross functional Partnership
  • Represent the voice of the client in organizational strategy sessions, contributing perspectives that shape marketing, business development, and product decisions.
  • Act as a trusted internal resource and cross-functional partner across Business Development, Marketing, Legal/Compliance, Investments, and Operations, ensuring client engagement priorities are represented in shared initiatives.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives and client-facing special projects as needed, bringing the same standard of excellence to project work as to core responsibilities.
  • Perform additional responsibilities aligned with the scope of the role.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience
  • 12+ years of experience engaging with institutional, UHNW, or family‑office clients.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field; advanced degree preferred (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
  • Demonstrated experience hiring, developing, and managing client-facing teams, with a track record of building strong relationships and career pathing.
  • Strong working knowledge of public and private market investment terms and concepts, with the ability to speak credibly and translate them for clients at varying levels of sophistication.
  • Substantive experience in impact investing and/or values-aligned investment strategies, with the ability to communicate impact value propositions credibly and compellingly.
Knowledge and Skills
  • Demonstrated success managing sophisticated stakeholder relationships coordinating multi‑party deliverables and driving follow-through.
  • Proven ability to engage credibly with both investment professionals and clients on impact and investing topics.
  • A track record of building and sustaining stakeholder relationships across complex ecosystems from institutional and private investors, such as family offices, foundations, endowments, corporates, and/or UHNW.
  • Experience setting and driving team growth goals including cross-selling, retention, and expansion for high-value client relationships.
  • Experience designing and scaling operational infrastructure for a client-facing team, including KPI frameworks, CRM systems, and performance operating rhythms.
  • Ability to analyze client data and insights to inform client engagement strategy.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust quickly with sophisticated clients.
  • Able to create and deliver presentations tailored to the audience needs.
  • Able to develop sense of urgency around processing and response timelines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams required.
  • Proficiency with cloud-based collaboration tools, such as Box and Asana.
  • Experience working in a virtual working environment
  • Knowledge and passion for using investing as a means by which to engender social or environmental impact.

Benefits and Perks

  • Competitive total compensation, including discretionary bonus, 401(k) plan, and generous time off plan
  • Compensation ranges from $220,000 - $250,000 and is highly dependent on experience and location

eCOA Project Manage- Remote/North America (US, Canada, Mexico) & Argentina

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

eCOA Project Manager

Remote - North America (United States, Canada, Mexico, Argentina)

Are you an experienced project manager with a passion for clinical technology, digital health solutions, and improving the patient experience in clinical research? Do you thrive at the intersection of clinical operations, software implementation, vendor management, and stakeholder collaboration?

We are seeking an eCOA Project Manager to join our growing Clinical Surveillance & Training (CST) organization. In this highly visible role, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment (eCOA) solutions across global clinical trials, serving as the primary point of accountability for study-specific eCOA implementation and oversight.

This is an exciting opportunity for a project management professional who enjoys driving complex technology-enabled clinical programs, collaborating with global stakeholders, managing multiple vendors, and ensuring high-quality electronic data collection solutions that support study endpoints, patient engagement, and data integrity.

You will be joining a highly collaborative and supportive team known for its strong culture, long-tenured leadership, and commitment to helping one another succeed.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As an eCOA Project Manager, you will oversee the planning, implementation, delivery, and ongoing management of eCOA solutions throughout the clinical trial lifecycle. You will act as the primary liaison between internal stakeholders, sponsors, and eCOA vendors to ensure systems are configured accurately, tested thoroughly, and delivered on schedule.

eCOA Strategy & Study Delivery

  • Lead eCOA activities from study startup through closeout.

  • Manage study-specific eCOA project plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.

  • Serve as the primary eCOA subject matter expert for assigned clinical studies.

  • Ensure electronic assessments align with protocol requirements, study objectives, and regulatory expectations.

  • Support global studies involving patient-reported outcomes, clinician-reported outcomes, and other electronic assessments.

  • Drive implementation of lessons learned and continuous improvement best practices across programs.

eCOA System Build & Oversight

  • Oversee study-specific eCOA software design, configuration, and deployment.

  • Manage eCOA system builds, including:

  • Questionnaires and instruments

  • Scales and assessments

  • Visit schedules

  • Device configurations

  • Language requirements

  • Study workflows

  • Ensure systems are built, validated, and maintained with a high degree of accuracy.

  • Review and approve vendor deliverables throughout the build lifecycle.

  • Coordinate system updates, enhancements, and ongoing maintenance activities.

User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

  • Develop comprehensive User Acceptance Testing (UAT) strategies and test scripts.

  • Lead and execute UAT activities to validate study functionality.

  • Identify, document, and resolve testing issues in collaboration with vendors and stakeholders.

  • Ensure all eCOA solutions meet quality expectations before deployment.

  • Drive inspection-ready documentation and testing records.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary liaison between sponsors, internal teams, and eCOA vendors.

  • Manage vendor timelines, deliverables, risks, and issue resolution.

  • Build strong relationships with sponsors and cross-functional study teams.

  • Provide regular project status updates and communicate key milestones.

  • Participate in governance meetings and sponsor-facing discussions.

  • Escalate risks proactively and drive solutions to keep projects on track.

Clinical Operations Collaboration

  • Partner closely with:

  • Clinical Operations

  • Data Management

  • Biostatistics

  • Clinical Science

  • Assessment Science

  • Project Management

  • Technology Vendors

  • Sponsors

  • Ensure alignment across all stakeholders throughout study execution.

  • Contribute to broader project plans to support successful study delivery.

jobs.description:
- This position is open to candidates located in Colombia or Costa Rica only -

FinOps Data Engineer – AI Cost & Usage Analytics

Gorilla Logic is looking for a FinOps Data Engineer – AI Cost & Usage Analytics to help build scalable data solutions that provide visibility into AI usage, consumption, and costs across multiple platforms and providers.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of data engineering, cloud financial management, and AI operations, building reliable pipelines that ingest usage and billing data from platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and other emerging AI technologies.

You will be responsible for transforming disparate usage and cost data into a unified data model in Google BigQuery and enabling trusted, self-service analytics through Power BI. You will collaborate closely with FinOps, Finance, Engineering, and other stakeholders to turn complex usage data into actionable insights that support cost allocation, forecasting, optimization, and informed decision-making.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that ingest AI usage, billing, and consumption data from multiple providers and platforms.
  • Develop API integrations and scheduled data ingestion processes using Python, Cloud Functions, Cloud Composer/Airflow, or similar technologies.
  • Build reliable ingestion processes with appropriate error handling, retry mechanisms, monitoring, and data-quality validation.
  • Monitor vendor APIs and data schemas and adapt integrations as providers evolve.
  • Design and maintain a unified BigQuery data model that normalizes usage and billing data across AI providers, including token-based, consumption-based, and seat-based pricing models.
  • Build dimensional and analytical data models that support cost allocation and reporting across teams, business units, projects, providers, models, and cost centers.
  • Develop transformation workflows using SQL and tools such as dbt or Dataform to cleanse, deduplicate, normalize, and enrich data.
  • Integrate usage and cost data with organizational hierarchies, cost centers, and financial structures to support chargeback and showback reporting.
  • Optimize BigQuery datasets through effective partitioning, clustering, incremental processing, and query optimization.
  • Implement historical snapshots and slowly changing dimensions to support accurate trend and point-in-time analysis.
  • Apply appropriate data governance, security, access control, auditability, and PII-handling practices.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions that provide visibility into AI spend, consumption trends, cost allocation, budgets, forecasts, and utilization.
  • Optimize BigQuery-to-Power BI connectivity and data models to balance performance, scalability, cost, and data freshness.
  • Develop executive-ready dashboards while enabling detailed drill-down analysis for Engineering, Finance, FinOps, and other stakeholders.
  • Implement appropriate row-level security and access controls within Power BI.
  • Partner with FinOps and business stakeholders to define meaningful cost and usage metrics, KPIs, and anomaly-detection logic.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, and AI spend optimization initiatives with accurate and trusted data.
  • Maintain clear documentation for data lineage, pipeline architecture, transformation logic, and reporting definitions.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting processes and continuously improve the reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency of the data platform.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment, contributing to technical decisions, planning, and continuous improvement.

Technical Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related role.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience designing and maintaining analytical data models.
  • Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery or comparable cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake or Amazon Redshift.
  • Strong experience building data pipelines using Python.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow, Google Cloud Composer, Dagster, or similar tools.
  • Hands-on experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication, OAuth, pagination, rate limiting, and error handling.
  • Experience designing reliable data ingestion, transformation, validation, and monitoring processes.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI, including semantic/data modeling, DAX, dashboard development, and report optimization.
  • Understanding of cloud billing and cost data structures across platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience working with Git and version-controlled development workflows.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD practices for data pipelines and transformation code.
  • Understanding of dimensional modeling, incremental processing, historical data management, and data-quality practices.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with complex or ambiguous data requirements.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of FinOps principles, practices, and frameworks; FinOps Foundation certification is a plus.
  • Experience integrating with AI/LLM usage or billing APIs, such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Vertex AI/Gemini, Azure OpenAI, or GitHub Copilot.
  • Experience with dbt or Dataform for data transformation, testing, and documentation.
  • Experience with enterprise cost allocation, chargeback, or showback models.
  • Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code (IaC) technologies.
  • Familiarity with data governance, security, and compliance practices in enterprise environments.
  • Experience building cost analytics, anomaly detection, forecasting, or cloud optimization solutions.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Solid experience with workflows, lifecycle templates, and object initialization rules.

jobs.excerpt: Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way.
jobs.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

As Senior Subscription Manager, you will own a portfolio of customer subscriptions and coordinate the end-to-end commercial lifecycle. You will identify commercial drift, build and maintain a Commercial Roadmap by subscription, recommend the appropriate commercial play at the right time, forecast renewal and broader commercial outcomes, and drive quote-to-booking readiness.

You will move beyond executing renewals to orchestrating commercial outcomes. Working as a trusted commercial advisor, you will align the customer lifecycle state, account strategy, terms, conditions, pricing logic, renewal pathways, and policy-aligned options to balance value delivered to customers and value captured by PTC. Ownership is expressed through accountability, insight, influence, and disciplined follow-through.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage assigned subscription portfolio and drive the end-to-end renewal lifecycle to deliver customer value, retention, and sustainable commercial outcomes.

  • Develop and maintain a clear commercial roadmap for assigned accounts, including renewal strategy, customer state, risks, opportunities, dependencies, and next steps.

  • Provide commercial guidance to customers and account teams by connecting contract structure, pricing, product configuration, policy requirements, and account strategy.

  • Identify customer lifecycle state , renewal risk, downgrade signals, modernization opportunities, growth potential, and commercial drift early and recommend appropriate commercial actions.

  • Identify and address commercial drift across contract structure, pricing, discounting, product configuration, renewal pathways, and terms & conditions to maintain commercial alignment over time.

  • Forecast renewal and commercial outcomes accurately by maintaining complete, current, and decision-ready data, documentation, and pipeline hygiene.

  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Product, and other teams to progress the agreed commercial motion.

  • Drive quote-to-booking readiness, timely customer engagement, and disciplined follow-through to reduce late surprises and improve business predictability.

  • Support adoption of strategic initiatives, tools, processes, and programs.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing best practices, strengthening knowledge management, and helping scale consistent Subscription Management execution.

  • Demonstrate PTC values through customer focus, accountability, collaboration, integrity, and a commitment to professional, inclusive, and ethical business conduct.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Subscription Manager consistently delivers strong renewal performance, ARR retention, and sustainable commercial outcomes by owning the end-to-end commercial lifecycle for the assigned portfolio. Curiosity, a strong learning mindset, and the willingness to build deep expertise in PTC’s products, policies, systems, customer motions, and evolving strategic programs are essential.

In a fast-paced, changing environment, the role requires energy, confidence, organization, resilience, and an outcome-focused approach while managing ambiguity, competing priorities, and time-sensitive customer or business needs.

The successful candidate diagnoses customer state early, identifies churn risk and downgrade signals, maintains a high-quality Commercial Roadmap, and provides accurate, decision-ready forecasts that improve business predictability.

Strong performance also depends on robust, trust-based relationships with customers, partners, account teams, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Product, and other teams, using clear communication, sound judgment, and disciplined follow-through to progress the right commercial play.

What good looks like also means being a positive team player who shares knowledge, asks for and offers help, reinforces consistent ways of working, contributes to continuous improvement, and helps others succeed. The role exemplifies PTC values through customer focus, accountability, collaboration, integrity, inclusive behavior, openness to feedback, responsible decision-making, and a commitment to doing the right thing for customers, colleagues, and the business.

Required Qualifications

Preferred Background

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience required. Business, Management, Technology, Engineering, or related discipline preferred.

  • Experience in enterprise software, SaaS, PLM, CAD, or technology industries.

  • Experience coordinating stakeholders across international teams and complex regional business environments.

  • Familiarity with CRM and forecasting systems such as Salesforce.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in subscription management, renewals, customer success, commercial operations, sales, licensing, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex renewals and commercial negotiations.

  • Strong experience managing recurring revenue, customer retention, forecasting, and renewal-focused business motions.

  • Experience working independently in cross-functional and international business environments.

  • Experience with direct customer business models and strategic accounts preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Learning agility and intellectual curiosity, with a proactive approach to building expertise in PTC's business, technology, customers, policies, tools, and evolving commercial models.

  • Comfort and positive energy in a fast-paced, global environment, with the ability to stay effective, organized, and resilient as priorities shift.

  • Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, including the ability to work with incomplete information, evaluate trade-offs, and move topics forward responsibly.

  • Strong commercial mindset and negotiation presence, with the confidence to influence discussions, balance customer and business needs, and seek outcomes that create sustainable value.

  • Relationship-building capability across internal and external audiences, grounded in credibility, trust, active listening, clear communication, and reliable follow-through.

  • Collaborative team-player mindset, demonstrated by sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues, welcoming feedback, and contributing to a constructive, inclusive team environment.

  • Ability to influence without authority by aligning stakeholders, navigating different perspectives, and creating momentum through clarity and partnership.

  • Analytical and structured thinking, with the ability to connect data, business context, risk, customer signals, and commercial implications into practical recommendations.

  • Strong data-driven decision-making skills, including the ability to leverage analytics, automation, and AI-assisted insights to improve forecasting accuracy, risk identification, and commercial execution.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and adapt messaging for customers, partners, peers, and senior stakeholders.

  • Fluency in German and English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally across customer, partner, and internal stakeholder audiences.

  • High ownership, accountability, and integrity, with a commitment to ethical conduct, transparency, confidentiality, and responsible decision-making.

  • Customer-focused and value-oriented mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs while protecting PTC's long-term business interests.

  • Adaptability, inclusiveness, openness to feedback, and continuous-improvement orientation that exemplify PTC values and help strengthen how the team works together.

Your Profile

This role is a great fit for someone who brings commercial sharpness, customer focus, and positive energy into complex subscription conversations. A successful person is naturally curious, quick to learn, and happy to dive deep into PTC’s products, policies, customer motions, systems, and evolving programs. They do not just “manage renewals” — they connect the dots across customer state, account strategy, contract structure, pricing logic, risk signals, and renewal pathways to help shape the right commercial outcome.

They are organized without being rigid, resilient without being stubborn, and confident without losing the ability to listen. Ambiguity does not throw them off; it motivates them to clarify, structure, and move topics forward responsibly. They are comfortable balancing customer needs with PTC’s long-term business interests, spotting churn risk or downgrade signals early, and turning data, business context, and stakeholder input into practical recommendations.

Just as importantly, this person builds trust. They communicate clearly in German and English, simplify complex topics, and create momentum across Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Product, partners, and customers. They know how to influence without formal authority by being credible, prepared, transparent, and reliable in follow-through.

About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike.

We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

About the role

Come join an amazing and collaborative team! We are seeking a highly organized and customer-focused General Liability Adjuster to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for speaking to customers on the phone, educating and helping the customer work through their claim to the best possible outcome. Your role will also be responsible for handling an inventory of claims, triaging critical claims, and delivering service to all constituents of the claim. General Liability claims consist of Premise, Habitational, Risk Transfer, Construction, and more. You will be an expert in these areas and have experience with complex injuries. This role is 100% remote!

Who you are

  • You are motivated and growth-oriented. You're excited by the prospect of building a tech-driven claims org.
  • Passionate adjuster who cares about the customer and their experience.
  • You exercise empathy and patience towards everyone you interact with.
  • Sense of urgency - at all times. That does not mean working at all hours.
  • Creativity is in you! You can find the right exit ramp (pun intended) for the resolution of the claim that is in the insured’s best interest.
  • Conflict-enjoyer. Conflict does not have to be adversarial, but it HAS to be conversational.
  • Are you curious? You have to want to know the whole story so you can make the right decisions early and action them to a prompt resolution.
  • Anti-status quo. You don’t just wish things were done differently, you action on it.
  • Communicative. (we'd love to know what this means to you)
  • And did we mention, you have a sense of humor? Claims are hard enough as it is!
  • You are collaborative and a team player.
  • You have a strong understanding of premise, Habitational, Risk Transfer, and other general liability including policy interpretation.

What you'll do

  • You will handle all aspects of General Liability claims not limited to but including Slip and Falls, Habitational, Risk Transfer, Construction, and more. Provide prompt, courteous and high-quality customer service to all policyholders and claimants by answering customer calls, filing claims, and resolving customer requests.
  • Gather necessary information from customers to initiate the claim and explain policy, coverage, and appropriate course of action.
  • Manage an inventory of claims, analyze coverage and identify any potential coverage issues.
  • Establish initial reserves for all potential exposures, and adjust as appropriate throughout the claim.
  • Ensure compliance with specific state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures.
  • Communicate with involved parties and negotiate appropriate settlements with claimants, insureds, and attorneys within approved payment authority.
  • Provide input for continuous development of claims guidelines, best practices, and process improvements.
  • Oversee and direct outside investigative service providers, client counsel and investigative services to resolve the claim while closely with the client.
  • Engage in learning opportunities to build knowledge of personal lines claims, court decisions impacting the claims function, current guidelines in claims function, and policy changes and modifications.

Qualifications

  • Active adjuster license required: resident state license if available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience ideally with;
    • General Liability (Premise, Habitational, Auto, Garagekeepers, BOP’s, Dwelling)
    • Construction Liability.
    • Employers Liability.
    • Liquor Liability/Dram Shop.
    • Complex claims involving litigation.
    • Policy interpretation. Drafting Reservation of Rights letters, coverage declinations.
    • Third-party bodily injury.
    • Third-party litigated bodily injury/property damage.
  • Active insurance adjuster's license by way of a designated home state; home state license required if home state license is available
  • Willing to obtain all licenses within 60 days, including completing state required testing
  • Knowledge of state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures.
  • Ability to analyze and evaluate complex data and make sound decisions based on established guidelines, policies, and procedures.
  • Curious and motivated by problem solving and questioning the status quo.
  • Desire to engage in learning opportunities and continuous professional development.
  • Ability to collaborate with colleagues within and outside your department.
  • Willingness to travel for client and claims needs.
  • Bachelor's degree. JD, Professional insurance designations preferred.

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Additionally, we will

  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

Are you a curious builder who thrives in a fast-moving, data-driven execution role, curious about how AI can turn quality data into real, operational trust?

Veeam's business runs on data flowing from four source systems, v-Power for Sales, Marketo for Marketing, NetSuite for Finance, and Workday for HR, through a governed Databricks Lakehouse to certified outputs consumed by Tableau dashboards and AI agents. The Senior Director, AI-Ready Data Governance has authored the strategy for how this gets governed: a federated, pragmatic model, central standards, distributed ownership, sequenced by outcome so scope is committed on evidence rather than ambition. Continuous, agent-driven scoring keeps watching a certified object's quality on an ongoing basis, well past the moment of sign-off.

This is a builder and execution role for a deep subject matter expert, with full autonomy to move fast and deliver results. You will lead highly complex, high-visibility initiatives, shape the approach to problems that arrive ambiguous, and influence organizational direction through the standards you set. AI tooling is moving fast enough that the sequence of what gets built when will keep shifting. What does not shift is the outcome bar: certified data, a live trust score behind it, and a named owner for both.

This is a job for someone who is curious by default. Someone who would rather have an agent draft the first pass of a lineage map than wait for a meeting about it, who gets energy from ambiguity because the pace of AI tooling means the plan will keep changing, and who treats data quality as something they are personally accountable for at every level, source system to dashboard to agent output, ahead of whatever a report tells them after the fact.

Integration & Data Movement Engineer

(Enterprise Integrations & Data Flow Enablement)

Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Integration & Data Movement Engineer to design, implement, and operate reliable data flows between enterprise platforms. This role is responsible for ensuring that data moves accurately, securely, and efficiently across systems such as CRM, ERP, finance, HR, analytics, and external partner platforms.

In addition to strong integration expertise, this role requires deep experience with modern data engineering practices, including Snowflake, Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers), data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration. The engineer will work with structured and semi-structured data from APIs, databases, files, and third-party platforms, ensuring high-quality and scalable data movement solutions.

Key Responsibilities
• Design and implement integrations and ELT/ETL pipelines across APIs, databases, file-based sources, SaaS platforms, and enterprise applications.
• Build and maintain Snowflake-based data ingestion and transformation processes.
• Apply Medallion Architecture principles to organize data across raw, curated, and business-ready layers.• Develop data transformation logic using both SQL and Python, selecting the best tool based on business and technical requirements.
• Create scalable and reusable ingestion frameworks supporting batch and incremental loads.
• Implement data quality checks, validation rules, monitoring, and error handling.
• Partner with analytics and reporting teams to ensure data is trusted and optimized for downstream consumption.
• Document integration designs, lineage, dependencies, and operational procedures.

Required Qualifications
• 5–10+ years of experience designing and implementing system integrations and data pipelines.
• Strong SQL expertise including Stored Procedures.• Strong Python development skills for data ingestion, transformation, automation, and operational support.

• Hands-on experience with Snowflake.

  • Experience ingesting and transforming data from APIs, relational databases, flat files, and external systems.
    • Experience implementing ELT/ETL solutions and data quality controls.
    • Strong understanding of REST/SOAP APIs, authentication mechanisms, and integration patterns.

    Preferred Qualifications
    • Experience with DBT, including models, testing, lineage, documentation, and data quality frameworks.

    • Familiarity with Kafka, Service Bus, or other event streaming technologies.

jobs.description:
ROLE TITLE

Bookkeeper VA

You will own the day-to-day bookkeeping and financial recordkeeping for multiple LLCs/business entities, keeping QuickBooks Online, supporting documentation, and financial spreadsheets accurate and current.

This role is execution-heavy: you will enter and code transactions, reconcile bank and credit card accounts, maintain AP/AR records, match documentation to transactions, investigate discrepancies, and prepare books for weekly and month-end review.

You will work within established accounting procedures, the company chart of accounts, and coding standards. When something does not reconcile or a transaction is questionable, you are expected to investigate it within your authorized scope and clearly escalate what cannot be resolved.

This is not a role for someone who needs daily supervision or who is only familiar with basic data entry. Strong QuickBooks Online experience, reconciliation experience, and the ability to independently manage multiple sets of books are required.

Core Responsibilities

QuickBooks & Transaction Management

  • Maintain accurate, current QuickBooks Online records across multiple LLCs/business entities.
  • Enter and categorize transactions using the company's established chart of accounts and coding system rather than creating inconsistent classifications.
  • Record invoices, receipts, payments, deposits, intercompany transactions, and other financial activity with the appropriate supporting documentation.
  • Review entered transactions for missing information, incorrect coding, duplicates, or inconsistencies before they flow into reporting.

Bank & Credit Card Reconciliation

  • Reconcile assigned bank and credit card accounts against statements and verify that transactions and ending balances agree.
  • Investigate discrepancies when balances or transactions do not match, including checking transaction coding and supporting documentation.
  • Correct discrepancies and miscoded transactions when they fall within your authorized scope.
  • Escalate unresolved, questionable, or potentially incorrect transactions with enough context for management to make a decision rather than simply flagging the issue.

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable

  • Maintain AP and AR records by keeping vendor invoices, expenses, payments, deposits, and receivables current.
  • Add and maintain vendor records and keep the vendor list accurate, organized, and current.
  • Reconcile rental income and other expected payments against applicable records or reports.
  • Identify late, missing, or inconsistent payments and report them for management review.
  • Review AP/AR records for missing documentation or transactions that could prevent accurate financial reporting.

Financial Documentation & Recordkeeping

  • Monitor designated email accounts for incoming invoices, receipts, statements, and other bookkeeping documents.
  • Identify which QuickBooks transaction each supporting document belongs to and organize the documentation in the designated cloud storage.
  • Match supporting documents to applicable QuickBooks transactions so records can be located during review or tax preparation.
  • Maintain complete, organized financial records that are usable for bookkeeping and tax support.

Financial Spreadsheets & Reporting

  • Maintain Google Sheets and financial trackers and keep them aligned with QuickBooks records.
  • Update cash flow, deal-related, and other bookkeeping spreadsheets as required.
  • Compare spreadsheet information against QuickBooks and investigate inconsistencies instead of allowing conflicting records to remain.
  • Assist with weekly and month-end Profit & Loss reporting and other financial reports by ensuring the underlying bookkeeping records are complete and accurate.

Month-End Bookkeeping

  • Complete required transaction entries, reconciliations, AP/AR updates, and documentation before the month-end review.
  • Review the books before submission for missing information, discrepancies, duplicate entries, and coding errors.
  • Resolve issues that are within your authorized scope before month-end review.
  • Escalate remaining issues with clear documentation and context.
  • Prepare accurate and complete books for management's final review and close.

Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

  • Strong QuickBooks Online experience — hard requirement.
  • Solid hands-on bookkeeping experience covering transaction entry, bank reconciliation, credit card reconciliation, AP, and AR.
  • Demonstrated experience maintaining books for multiple LLCs/business entities.
  • Experience handling intercompany transactions.
  • Proficiency with Google Sheets and financial spreadsheets.
  • Ability to identify, investigate, and communicate financial discrepancies rather than simply entering data.
  • Ability to consistently follow established accounting procedures, chart-of-accounts structures, and coding standards.
  • Ability to independently manage assigned bookkeeping work without requiring daily reminders or step-by-step direction.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, particularly when managing records across multiple entities.
  • Clear written and verbal English communication.
  • High level of honesty, integrity, reliability, and confidentiality when handling financial information.
  • Real estate bookkeeping experience is preferred but not required.
  • Familiarity with HUD/settlement statements and real estate transactions is preferred.

Filtering signal: Candidates whose experience is limited to basic accounting data entry, invoicing, payroll support, or administrative bookkeeping without hands-on reconciliation and AP/AR ownership will not meet the minimum bar.

Tools

The role may require regular use of:

  • QuickBooks Online
  • Google Sheets
  • Outlook
  • Dropbox / Google Drive
  • Online Banking Portals
  • Credit Card Portals
  • Asana
  • Canopy

What We Actually Care About

  • You catch problems before they become reporting problems. You notice when a reconciliation does not balance, a transaction is miscoded, documentation is missing, or expected income does not match the records.
  • You can work across multiple sets of books without losing control of the details. Each entity needs to remain properly separated and accurately maintained.
  • You follow the established system instead of creating your own. Consistent coding, documentation, and accounting procedures matter.
  • You investigate before escalating. When something is wrong, you determine what you can verify or correct within your authority and provide useful context when escalation is necessary.
  • You close loops independently. Assigned bookkeeping work should move from transaction entry through reconciliation, documentation, review, and escalation without requiring constant follow-up.
  • You treat financial information as sensitive. Accuracy, confidentiality, honesty, and reliability are operational requirements, not optional personality traits.

What This Role Is NOT

  • Not a basic data-entry position. You are expected to reconcile, review, investigate discrepancies, and maintain accurate books.
  • Not a role for someone who needs daily direction. You will receive established procedures and standards, but you are expected to execute assigned bookkeeping work independently.
  • Not a single-entity bookkeeping role. The position requires maintaining records across multiple LLCs/business entities and handling intercompany transactions.
  • Not a purely administrative accounting role. AP, AR, reconciliations, transaction coding, documentation, and month-end preparation are core responsibilities.
  • Not a role where unresolved issues can simply be left flagged. You must investigate what you can, correct what is within your authority, and escalate unresolved issues with clear context.

Position Details

Work Arrangement: Fully remote

Work Hours: US-aligned work hours

Work Structure: Contractor / Virtual Professional
Environment: Performance-driven, asynchronous, and execution-focused

You will be expected to manage assigned work within agreed deadlines, communicate blockers clearly, and maintain accurate records without relying on constant real-time supervision.

Application Instructions

To apply, submit your resume highlighting your QuickBooks Online, reconciliation, AP/AR, and multi-entity bookkeeping experience.

Your application must also answer the following:

Practical Question:

You reconcile a bank account and find that QuickBooks is $3,250 higher than the bank statement. You discover three transactions with unclear coding, one duplicate payment, and one deposit that appears in the bank but has no matching QuickBooks entry. In 5–8 sentences, explain the order in which you would investigate the issue, what you would correct yourself, and what you would escalate.

Applications that do not demonstrate hands-on QuickBooks Online and reconciliation experience will not move forward.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off
  • HMO
  • Fully Remote Work

Central Risk Manager (Risk based Central Monitoring)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
    • We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
    • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Job responsibilities
• Provides advice and subject matter expertise for the development of the monitoring strategy required for the project and where required, advises the project team on any updates to the monitoring strategy during the study based on risks.
• Works with cross-functional leads to understand complex indications and risks and seeks input on risk mitigations. Provides guidance to cross-functional leads to ensure consistency within programs, therapeutic areas and/or sponsors.
• Drafts initial risk assessment, supports the project team in ensuring cross-functional involvement in the finalization of the RACT.
• Ensures PL transfers risks identified to the correct tracking system and supports ongoing cross-functional review of risks throughout the project.
• Provides advice on the development of functional plans to ensure identified risks are mitigated.
• Assess tools where available to conduct remote data review and centralized statistical monitoring, identifying risks to data quality and integrity.
• Facilitates review of findings with the internal cross- functional team and sponsor. Requires support from cross-functional leads on complex risks and mitigations.
• With support and where required, collaborates with other team members and Sponsor to identify Quality Tolerance Limits.
• As required, provides development and delivery of initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding the risk assessment, centralized monitoring and the wider risk-based monitoring strategy.
• Coaches and mentors peers regarding functional delivery, evaluation of project risks, and action implementation.
• Collaborates with other functional areas to ensure risks identified in compliance and delivery according to protocol, ICH/GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices (GPP) and country regulations, including medical monitoring, Safety, Quality Assurance (QA). Ensures Inspection Readiness for risk assessment and centralized monitoring scope.
• Understands the study scope of work, budget and protocol content for their assigned study.
• Escalates to the PM any risk assessment and centralized monitoring deliverables (timeline, quality, and budget) at risk, and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.
• May participate in business development activities including monitoring strategy and budget input, defines meetings and proposal development.

Qualifications - External

What we’re looking for
• Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
• Master's degree or health data sciences degree preferred.
• Expert in Good Clinical Practice/ICH E6 (R2) Guidelines and/or other applicable regulatory requirements.
• Expert in Risk-Based Monitoring Strategies processes and tools preferred.
• Expert in Integrated Quality Risk Management (IQRM) theories.
• Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies.
• Mastery of MS Excel (sorting, filtering, calculating, pivoting).
• Mastery of Analytical Data Visualization Tools (adjusting visualizations, selecting subsets of data to analyze, identification of trends and outliers).
• Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques, visualizations and tools (Cluepoints, Medidata-CSA, Hy's Law, Funnel Plots, Box and Whiskers).
• Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma, RACT tools.
• Strong analytical skills and well-developed understanding of statistical concepts.
• Well-developed therapeutic expertise.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Strong negotiation skills, organizational skills and problem-solving skills.
• Demonstrated strong leadership, tactical and strategic thinking skills.
• Ability to anticipate and address critical issues; and develop contingency plans in a proactive manner.
• Knowledge of financial concepts as related to forecasting, budgeting, and proposal generation.
• Demonstrate understanding of the workflow process, roles and responsibilities of multiple functional areas, and ability to work across those functional areas.
• Ability to understand, explain and communicate project concepts and put into detailed plans.
• Ability to teach, train and mentor employees of all levels to achieve project, departmental, personal and organizational goals.
• Requires above average attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational, interpersonal, and team-oriented skills. This includes excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform, influence, convince, and persuade.
• <30% travel (departmental meetings, investigator meetings, training, client meetings and bid defenses).

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

jobs.description:
Sobre a

Conheça nossa visão nas palavras doRonaldo, fundador e líder da empresa:

[Clique para acessar o vídeo]

AGIRO.TECHé uma fintech que atua como uma plataforma de originação e distribuição de crédito para correspondentes bancários, combinando tecnologia de ponta e inteligência de mercado. Somos resolvedores de problemas complexos e o nosso combustível são os desafios trazidos por nossos parceiros. Nossas soluções são integradas e invisíveis: por meio de APIs robustas, nossos parceiros acoplam nossa tecnologia de intermediação diretamente nos serviços que já prestam. É aí que reside um dos nossos maiores desafios: cada parceiro possui um ambiente de sistemas diferente, com cenários técnicos particulares. Cada desafio é único, e temos enorme satisfação em arquitetar e desenvolver a solução de integração ideal.

Como pensamos (Nosso DNA)

Valorizamos quem temBRIO!

Somos uma empresa formada por NERDS apaixonados por resolver problemas complexos do mercado financeiro. Atuamos com umamentalidade de jogo infinito: não focamos em ganhar uma partida isolada, mas em permanecer no jogo, buscando desafios cada vez maiores e manter um aprendizado contínuo para ser cada dia melhor.

Na GIRO.TECH temos um ambiente realmente meritocrático, quem entrega e colabora mais, será sempre recompensado. Nosso time sênior e lideranças é majoritariamente formado por pessoas que entraram na empresa em cargos Júnior e até mesmo como estagiários. Aqui, novas vagas importantes são prioritariamente preenchidas com pessoas da casa.

Nossos processos seletivos são uma busca de futuros sócios da empresa. Para ir rápido, melhor ir sozinho. Se queremos construir algo grande, precisamos nos juntar a mais gente boa que pense como a gente. Dedicamos muito tempo nos processos seletivos para achar essas pessoas e entregamos desafios constantes para promover crescimento. Temos hoje comosócios da empresa, muitas pessoas que começaram em posições de base e mostraram que têm vontade de ser mais.

Fundadores - nossa base

Uma empresa é a extensão dos valores e sonhos de seus sócios fundadores. A GIRO.TECH foi fundada por quatro sócios, que têm como primeira formação a tecnologia, e são apaixonados por servir os outros usando seu conhecimento e por resolver problemas complexos.


Isso é GIRO.TECH

  • Liderança e Mentoria:aqui não temos "chefes", mas líderes que caminham lado a lado, incentivam e ensinam.
  • Voz Ativa:a melhor ideia prevalece, não o maior cargo. Oferecemos espaço para testar, errar e aprender.
  • Liberdade e Responsabilidade:valorizamos o trabalho remoto e a autonomia. Você tem liberdade para trabalhar de onde preferir e vestir o que for mais confortável; em troca, esperamos responsabilidade total com as entregas.
  • Crescimento Interno:priorizamos nosso time para ocupar novas vagas e posições mais desafiadoras. Temos muitas pessoas que iniciaram como estagiários e hoje evoluíram para o nível sênior, alguns, inclusive, passaram a ser sócios da empresa.
  • Excelência Técnica:nossa principal estratégia comercial é possuir a melhor tecnologia e um produto de alta performance. O resultado é a satisfação dos nossos clientes, que nos avaliam constantemente com notas acima de 9.

Isso NÃO é GIRO.TECH

  • Não somos uma instituição financeira tradicional de "terno e colete puffer".
  • Não valorizamos hierarquias rígidas ou burocracias excessivas para tomada de decisão.
  • Não somos os donos da verdade; somosinquietos, curiosos e abertos a mudanças.

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos pessoas capazes de se adaptar a cenários dinâmicos e com sede de conhecimento. Valorizamos ainquietude: a busca constante por evoluir processos e construir resultados melhores a cada dia.

Se você é apaixonado por solucionar problemas com excelência, busca desafios que te tirem da zona de conforto e nunca está satisfeito com o mediano, seu lugar é aqui.

Vem construir o futuro da tecnologia de crédito com a gente!



Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a)estagiário(a) contábil-financeiro. NaGIRO.TECH, a contabilidade não é apenas burocracia; é a base de dados que sustenta nossas operações complexas de crédito.

﻿Se você é um "nerd dos números", apaixonado por entender como demonstrações contábeis refletem a saúde de uma operação financeira e possui umamentalidade de jogo infinito, queremos você no nosso time para nos ajudar a manter a fluidez e a precisão da nossa infraestrutura.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesta cadeira, você será responsável por garantir que a engrenagem financeira gire sem atritos. Suas principais missões serão:

  • Oferecer um excelente atendimento aos nossos clientes;
  • Oferecer um atendimento consultivo e resolutivo aos nossos clientes, sanando dúvidas e mediando conflitos com parceiros e fornecedores.
  • Realizar a importação de operações de crédito no sistema e gerir a venda desses ativos para os fundos vinculados;

  • Como estamos em constante mudança e crescimento, esperamos que você se adapte rapidamente a novos cenários e ajude a evoluir nossos processos internos, propondo melhorias para ganhar eficiência.

O que buscamos (requisitos):

  • Organização e Adaptabilidade:A essência da nossa operação é o processo. Procuramos um perfil que valorize a rotina e a estabilidade das tarefas diárias, executando-as com excelência. É fundamental ter sede de conhecimento para entender o "porquê" de cada etapa e poder identificar oportunidades de melhoria, mantendo a flexibilidade para se adaptar a mudanças de cenário quando necessário.

About Us

Are you ready to build the future of the supply chain? At Gather AI, we’re not just creating software; we’re pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We’ve developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining “on-time, in full” delivery.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We’re leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.

About the Team

This role work closely with a Senior Machine Learning Scientist and our Lead Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer, alongside cross-functional partners in Cloud Engineering, Product, and Operations. The role spans both deep technical work and collaboration with teams closest to the customer. As a Principal-level IC, you'll have real input into technical direction — not just executing on decisions, but helping make them.

About the Role

We are looking for a Principal Machine Learning Scientist to advance the state of our computer vision systems for warehouse inventory scanning. You will work across the full ML lifecycle — from research and model architecture through training, deployment, and production monitoring — with a focus on delivering measurable improvements to detection, segmentation, and OCR accuracy across our drone and MHE Vision products.

This role is ideal for a senior ML practitioner who wants principal-level impact on a core product, a variety of deployment targets (cloud, on-prem, embedded), and real-world data with tangible business outcomes.

  • Advance core computer vision model performance (object detection, segmentation, OCR) for warehouse inventory scanning across drone and MHE Vision platforms
  • Own the full ML lifecycle from research and experiment design through production deployment and monitoring — applying rigorous ablation studies and SOTA methodology
  • Collaborate with the ML infrastructure team on model optimization and deployment across cloud and edge inference targets (ONNX, TensorRT, quantization)
  • Work with Operations and Product to understand customer needs and translate them into ML improvements with measurable business impact
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the ML team, raising standards for experiment design, model evaluation, and production readiness
  • Explore next-generation perception capabilities, including embedded and on-prem inference optimization for new deployment targets

What You’ll Need

  • 10+ years of experience in machine learning or computer vision
  • Deep expertise in CNNs, object detection, image segmentation, and OCR using PyTorch (preferred) or TensorFlow
  • Strong Python proficiency and software engineering fundamentals; hands-on experience with OpenCV and GPU computing
  • Track record of delivering production ML systems at scale, including model training, evaluation, and deployment
  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field

Nice to Have

  • Experience with drone, robotics, or autonomous systems perception
  • Publications in top vision or robotics conferences (CVPR, ICCV, ICRA, NeurIPS, CoRL)
  • Experience designing and deploying models for real-time inference on constrained compute platforms
  • Warehouse, logistics, or supply chain domain experience
