BayNova is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Database Administrator to join our team in support of a mission-critical federal government client in a remote / work from home role.

This opportunity is for DBA technical lead in a hands‑on, day‑to‑day operations and maintenance role. The position will support the organization’s migration from SAP ASE to PostgreSQL, requiring strong expertise in PostgreSQL administration along with working knowledge of legacy SAP ASE / Sybase environments. Responsibilities include database monitoring, maintenance, replication, scripting, backup/recovery strategies, capacity planning, security, and performance tuning.

This role requires an excellent leader and team player who is central to daily project operations, maintenance, and oversight activities in a dynamic 24x7 customer‑facing environment.

Responsiblities

  • Provide technical expertise in administering and maintaining production and non‑production PostgreSQL environments running on Linux.
  • Lead efforts in database physical design, query optimization, indexing strategies, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
  • Implement PostgreSQL replication, backup and recovery strategies, monitoring, and disaster‑recovery capabilities.
  • Support schema conversions, data migrations, performance validation, and cutover activities as part of the ASE‑to‑Postgres migration.
  • Evaluate PostgreSQL configuration parameters; recommend improvements and best practices for stability and performance.
  • Maintain capacity planning, security controls, patching/upgrade strategy, and proactive database health assessments
  • Provide working expertise for the existing ASE environment during the migration lifecycle.
  • Troubleshoot ASE performance issues, analyze error logs, validate configuration parameters, support replication server processes, and assist with patching/upgrade activities as needed.
  • Document ASE environment characteristics to support migration planning and knowledge transfer.
  • Participate in decommissioning and transitioning ASE instances following successful migration milestones.
  • Oversee daily ticket queue triage and assign work to other DBAs, providing mentorship and technical leadership to a small team.
  • Coordinate activities with customer project management and contract project managers.
  • Participate in complex customer/project meetings, needs assessments, technical design reviews, and solution feasibility discussions.
  • Provide database architectural guidance and evangelize modern concepts and best practices across the team.

Required Skills

  • Expertise in core database architecture: objects, file structures, tables, views, procedures, functions, triggers, sequences, indexes, constraints.
  • Strong hands‑on experience with PostgreSQL administration, including installation, configuration, performance tuning, backup/recovery, replication, security, and monitoring.
  • Demonstrated experience with the SAP ASE technology stack (ASE, Replication Server, etc.), including performance tuning, patching, replication, and upgrade planning.
  • Experience with database architecture design concepts and the ability to clearly communicate these concepts to the team.
  • Experience leading or managing a small DBA team.
  • Strong SQL skills (SQL, PL/pgSQL, T‑SQL) and proficiency with one or more shell scripting languages (Bash, Korn, etc.).
  • Ability to install and perform application/database upgrades.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret database performance data, both PostgreSQL and ASE.
  • Strong working knowledge of programming tools and data migration techniques used in schema conversion and ETL workflows.
  • Ability to work independently, manage your own schedule, and handle multiple priorities across multiple projects.
  • Strong organizational and time‑management skills.
  • Excellent performance tuning capabilities across queries, memory, process scheduling, I/O, and system resource utilization.
  • Understanding of database design and modeling concepts for varying workload types.
  • Experience working with vendors for troubleshooting, escalations, licensing, and procurement.
  • Strong understanding of Linux OS features and how they affect both PostgreSQL and ASE.

Education / Experience

  • 10+ years of database administration experience, including ASE and PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL in enterprise environments (preferred).
  • 4‑year degree in an IT‑related field or equivalent professional experience.
  • 10+ years of scripting experience (preferred)

jobs.title: Integration Solutions Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry.
jobs.description:
Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

We’re looking for an Integration Solutions Engineer who can bridge the gap between solution architecture and integration engineering. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how a customer’s business and accounting processes work, translating those requirements into scalable technical solutions, and then being hands-on in bringing those integrations to life.

Integrations are a core part of the Vividly customer experience. You’ll play a critical role in helping us onboard customers faster while also helping us evolve from highly customized integrations toward more standardized, reusable integration patterns.

What You'll Achieve

As an Integration Solutions Engineer, you’ll become an expert in Vividly, CPG accounting workflows, ERP systems, APIs, and our integration platform.

You’ll partner with customers, Solution Architecture, Implementation, and Engineering to translate business requirements into technical integration designs. You’ll then be hands-on in designing, building, testing, deploying, and troubleshooting integrations between Vividly and customer ERPs, banks, and other systems.

You’ll develop expertise in workflows such as Cash Application, Deduction Reconciliation, revenue, master data, and other financial processes. You’ll also bring technical and ERP expertise into solution design conversations when system capabilities or constraints influence the recommended approach.

Beyond individual customer implementations, you’ll help identify recurring patterns, integration gaps, and opportunities to improve our APIs and integration framework so that what we build becomes increasingly repeatable and scalable.

In This Role, You'll Help The Team:

  • Design and build integrations between Vividly and customer ERPs, banks, APIs, and other systems using Workato and other integration technologies.
  • Partner with Solution Architecture to translate approved business and accounting workflows into scalable technical integration designs.
  • Lead technical discovery around ERP capabilities, APIs, authentication, data availability, system constraints, and integration feasibility.
  • Consult directly with customers on technical architecture, data flows, system capabilities, and integration best practices.
  • Define data mappings, transformations, integration logic, and synchronization cadence required to support approved workflows.
  • Own the technical integration workstream from design and connection through internal testing, customer UAT, deployment, and technical handoff.
  • Build clear technical documentation and solution blueprints so requirements, mappings, dependencies, and integration behavior are understood across teams.
  • Develop deep expertise across ERP platforms such as NetSuite, SAP, QuickBooks, Microsoft and other systems within our customer ecosystem.
  • Support live integrations, troubleshoot transaction failures, respond to ERP/API changes, and help identify root causes and scalable fixes.
  • Partner with the Integrations Lead on architecture standards, reusable integration patterns, internal automation, and improvements to how we onboard integrations.
  • Identify recurring product and API gaps and partner with Product and Engineering to improve Vividly’s APIs and integration capabilities.
  • Help standardize integration patterns to reduce custom development, improve reliability, and accelerate implementation timelines.
  • Provide technical guidance on complex edge cases where ERP or integration constraints affect the customer solution.

You May Be A Good Fit For The Role If You:

  • Have 3+ years experience of designing or developing technical solutions for client adoption
  • Have hands-on experience working with REST APIs, including authentication, requests/responses, pagination, error handling, and troubleshooting.
  • Understand relational databases, data models, and data transformation.
  • Are comfortable working with JSON, API payloads, field mappings, and transformation logic.
  • Understand integration concepts such as scheduled polling, webhooks, retry/error handling, data integrity, and monitoring.
  • Are comfortable leveraging AI tools such as Claude to boost efficiency for development and documentation
  • Have experience integrating ERPs such as Dynamics 365, NetSuite, SAP, and QuickBooks
  • Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and translate between business requirements and technical solutions.
  • Are comfortable working directly with customers to understand technical requirements, challenge assumptions, and recommend solutions.
  • Have experience with an iPaaS platform such as Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Celigo, Tray.io, or have built software integrations directly.
  • Are not afraid of working in a scrappy startup environment, being resourceful to find solutions to problems, or improving systems without direction.
  • Enjoy documenting what you learn and turning one-off solutions into repeatable patterns and scalable frameworks.
  • Have excellent communication skills, able to clearly prioritize needs and risks
  • Want to have a foundational impact at a Series B startup
  • Have experience with accounting or financial workflows; familiarity with Cash Application, Deduction Management, Trade Promotion Management, or CPG accounting is a plus.

How You’ll Work

You’ll report to the Integrations Lead and work closely with Solution Architecture, Implementation, Product, and Engineering.

Our operating model is built around a simple principle: Solution Architecture defines what the business workflow needs to accomplish. Integrations determine how our systems make it happen.

In practice, there will be overlap. We expect our Integration Solutions Engineers to understand the business context behind what they’re building and to contribute technical and ERP expertise during solution design. At the same time, you won’t be expected to independently own every aspect of a customer’s accounting process, project management, or broader implementation.

The goal is to give you the context and ownership needed to design great technical solutions while preserving the focus required to actually engineer them.

Why Choose Vividly?

A modern, remote-first workplace

We are committed to succeeding as a fully remote team, empowering you with the flexibility to thrive, no commute required. Every Vividly team member receives a stipend upon hire to help create a comfortable, productive home office.

Vividly days off & flexible PTO

For most USA holidays that fall on a Monday or Friday, we turn it into a 4 day weekend! Vividly also offers Flexible Time Off (and we really mean it) to help prevent burn out and fuel creativity.

Competitive Benefits

  • Healthcare, Dental and Vision - We cover 100% of your monthly premiums and 50% of all dependents
  • 401(k) - With a 3% employer contribution
  • Weekly $20 Sharebite Meal Stipend - For every meal you purchase, they donate a meal through Feeding America!
  • Monthly $50 Wellness Reimbursement
  • Monthly $200 Remote Work Stipend

Commitment to our values - The Vividly Code

  • Kind Ambition -We push boundaries with empathy and integrity
  • Keep It Real - We are transparent, honest, and authentic
  • Customer Love - We act as trusted advisors to our customers
  • Own It - We take responsibility and drive outcomes
  • Urgency Wins - We move quickly and focus on impact
  • Pull Together - We collaborate to win as a team

If an applicant is extended an offer of employment, such sensitive information will be requested at that time during the onboarding process. Vividly will never ask you to receive and ship packages or goods as part of the interview. Other practices to be on alert for:

  • Contact initiated via unsolicited text message or cold call. Vividly does not follow up with candidates through instant messaging applications.

THE POSITION IN A NUTSHELL

As Our Senior Data Analyst (MedTech), You Will:

Team Leadership & Development

  • Operate as a player-coach — stay hands-on with the data as needed while delegating operational execution across the team

Existing Product Ownership & Quality

  • Own overall data quality and accuracy across MedTech research products and analyses – including Research reports, company-level QA, coverage updates, and ad-hoc investigations
  • Review and guide methodology decisions across the team, ensure rigor and consistency in how we process, validate, and deliver data
  • Motivate and organize the team to continually improve data workflows, processing efficiency, and output quality
  • Partner closely with the MedTech Research team as the data team counterpart, ensuring data products align with research priorities and client needs, and launching new coverage where applicable

New Dataset Evaluation & Product Development

  • Identify, scope, and lead evaluations of new data sources — including claims data, prescription data, and adjacent healthcare datasets — assessing commercial viability, data quality, coverage, and fit with our existing product suite
  • Lead Data team in development of methodology and validation frameworks for new data domains, ensuring accuracy and reliability meet institutional investor standards
  • Work with Sector Head to stay current on the healthcare data landscape — new data vendors, evolving regulatory environments, competitive product launches — to identify opportunities before they become obvious

Strategic Contribution

  • Translate sector priorities into team execution — ensure the team is focused on the highest-impact work at any given time
  • Contribute to MedTech roadmap discussions and prioritization, bring a data-informed perspective on what to build next and where the biggest opportunities lie
  • Identify opportunities to improve team workflows and processes, standardize best practices and drive efficiency gains
  • Communicate priorities, timelines, and risks clearly to the Sector Head and cross-functional partners

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • 4-8+ years of experience in data analytics, data science, or data product development, with a track record of building data assets in complex, data-intensive domains
  • Strong technical skills mirroring a senior individual contributor (IC) profile:
  • Experience working with large-scale, messy, real-world datasets — you know how to find signal in noise and build robust methodology around imperfect data
  • Healthcare data experience — you've worked with healthcare, life sciences, pharma, biotech, or medical device data in a professional context. Deep MedTech expertise is preferred but not required; we value the ability to ramp quickly in a specialized domain.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical judgment — you can make high-quality decisions in ambiguous situations, prioritize effectively, and know when to go deep vs. when to move fast
  • Clear, direct communication style — you can explain complex data concepts to non-technical stakeholders and advocate for your team's priorities

Preferred:

  • Prior people management experience — you've managed a small team of analysts or data professionals, or you've operated as a team lead / senior IC with significant mentorship and project leadership responsibilities
  • Experience in alternative data, financial data products, or investor-facing analytics — you understand what institutional investors need from data and how to build products that meet that bar
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate and scope new data sources end-to-end — from identifying a potential dataset through assessing quality, coverage, cost, and commercial viability
  • Track record of building new data assets from zero to one — not just maintaining existing systems, but conceiving, validating, and shipping something new
  • Experience with AI/ML tools and workflows — not necessarily building models, but leveraging AI for data processing, quality assurance, or analytical acceleration

Please note that for this position, we are not able to consider candidates who currently or in the future will require visa sponsorship.

jobs.description:
Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire a Director, Engineering - Artificial Intelligence to join our engineering team. This leader will report to the Senior Vice President, Engineering. The key focus of this role is to help build and execute our platform-wide AI strategy. As a member of Sprout’s Engineering leadership team, this leader will also facilitate strong collaboration across the engineering, product management and product design organizations.

Why join Sprout’s Engineering team?

Sprout empowers businesses worldwide to harness the immense power and opportunity of social media in today’s digital-first world. Processing over one billion social messages daily, our platform serves up essential insights and actionable information to over 30,000 brands, informing strategic decisions that drive business growth and innovation, and fostering deeper, authentic connections to their end customers. Our full suite of social media management solutions includes comprehensive publishing and engagement functionality, customer care solutions, influencer marketing, connected workflows, and business intelligence. We're actively working to intuitively weave AI throughout our products, enabling organizations to work smarter, unleash their creativity, and maximize the business impact of social media–that’s where you come in!

With collaborative, cross-functional teams spanning front-end, back-end, applied science, and ML Ops, our team is a place to sharpen your craft and solve hard problems alongside some of the smartest people in the industry. As a Director of Engineering, you’ll operate at “tech-giant” scale, leading engineers and technical leaders while partnering closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and other teams to shape strategy and deliver against a shared roadmap. You’ll provide leadership across architecture, system design, engineering execution, and talent development, while helping define how our products, platforms, and services interconnect and scale. You’ll also join an empathetic Engineering Leadership team committed to helping each other grow, raising the bar for engineering excellence, and supporting our teams in delivering world-class products.

What you’ll do

  • As a Director, you will be a key member of the AI leadership team and be responsible for building high-functioning teams of applied AI/ML scientists and engineers and steering them to iteratively deliver quality results.
  • You’ll lead the engineering team building foundational AI/ML products that will be used across our entire product suite and customer base.
  • You will partner closely with the VP, Engineering and your leaders to chart the strategic growth of the current team, defining and building new teams and helping to steer architecture and product direction.
  • Relying on your experience in building and maintaining highly scalable, reliable, distributed AI products and leading applied science teams, you'll lead teams to iteratively deliver quality software.
  • You will guide the team through complicated product and technical roadmaps, and partner with product management and design to align on the strategy for your teams and support its execution.
  • You’ll grow your team of engineers and applied scientists by example with effective feedback, coaching, and career development.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a collaborative, pragmatic, highly motivating Engineering leader to help our AI team succeed and invest in the right capabilities to improve our customer experience and impact through AI and machine learning. If you confidently lead teams to solve hard problems, push them to learn from and teach each other, and work across functions and teams to get your teams to deliver, we'd love to talk with you!

The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • 7+ years of experience building and supporting products in a production environment
  • 7+ years in software development, including several years leading teams and managing through leaders, with a track record of building sustainable, high-performing team structure.
  • Experience leading engineering teams building AI/ML or agentic products, including partnering with or leading applied scientists and AI/ML engineers.
  • Recent, direct experience (typically the last 2-3 years) leading or closely driving the development of modern AI products, agentic or LLM-based systems, evaluation and quality, built on foundation models. We care more about the depth and recency of your AI-product experience than the number of years.

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • Direct experience leading a mixed team of applied scientists and AI/ML engineers, and an understanding of how to lead research-inflected work, evaluation, model judgment, and quality, alongside product engineering.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and scaling high-performance teams through hiring and coaching of engineering leaders, applied scientists, and AI/ML engineers
  • Experience at a SaaS or product company that made a meaningful AI pivot or shift in product direction.
  • Experience aligning a team's focus and vision towards the most impactful work across a complex product suite to meet the needs of a diverse, global customer base
  • Track record of influencing and aligning stakeholders across different points of view or functions, to drive successful outcomes
  • Experience developing enterprise-level distributed applications using Python, Java, distributed queuing systems, etc.
  • Experience developing systems to deploy, manage, evaluate, and serve machine learning models and agentic products at scale
  • Experience with generative AI, including open source and third party solutions (e.g., OpenAI)

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Experiencing Sprout’s in-depth onboarding, covering everything from our company mission and values, hearing directly from executives and founders, to deep training on our products and the value that Sprout delivers to our customers
  • Learning the current state of AI and machine learning at Sprout and future product and technical roadmaps
  • Meeting your team in 1:1s to understand what’s working, what’s not, and gathering learnings to implement into your role
  • Establishing relationships with other engineering, product and design leaders and identify areas of opportunity

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Participating in architectural discussions and decisions, bringing an informed industry perspective to ask the right questions and guide your team toward successful outcomes
  • Assuming management of the AI team's engineering leaders. Meeting with them regularly and providing them with direct, constructive feedback on their work, as well as formulating career growth plans
  • Participating in quarterly planning and roadmap processes and helping your team shape the technical roadmap for long-term success
  • Getting acclimated to the hiring process and partner with your leaders to establish a staffing plan and process for the teams
  • Helping your team and leaders improve processes and team rituals
  • Building relationships with our infrastructure, product, go to market, legal, and support teams and identify ways your teams can be more proactive and effective.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Guiding and proactively evaluating your team’s execution on a major feature launch.
  • Understanding the business goals and helping the team proactively focus on the right problems while balancing technical debt, bugs, and product features with measurable results
  • Leading the performance review and career band calibration process for your team and coach your leaders through performance conversations with their direct reports
  • Partnering with the VP, Engineering, product and design teams to evangelize our AI and ML technical and product vision with internal and external stakeholders
  • Becoming an expert in our approach to AI and to confidently speak to ever-changing trends, new product features and platform enhancements to internal and external stakeholders

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Continue to develop your team, both personally and professionally, and having development plans in place for your team to hold them accountable
  • Serving as Sprout's bridge to the broader AI/ML industry by staying current on emerging trends and technologies and proactively bringing that outside perspective into the team's strategy and roadmap
  • Being recognized as a subject matter expert and leader in artificial intelligence and machine learning at Sprout
  • Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change our AI capabilities in Sprout in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits ProgramWe’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • 100% Employer-Paid Health Benefits: We cover 100% of the premiums for you and your eligible dependents, including comprehensive medical, dental (basic & major), vision, life insurance, and disability.
  • Generous Paid Time Off:25 days of vacation annually, plus 5 paid sick days, all public holidays, and additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $950 CAD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Remote Work Support: A one-time $550 USD (equivalent) stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD (equivalent) stipend for internet.
  • Personalized Financial Wellness: No-cost, confidential access to financial experts through Your Money Line to support your personal financial goals.
  • Family & Care Support: Access to subsidized child and eldercare options through Care.com.
  • Charitable Giving: A company match for your donations to eligible organizations.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Vice President, Engineering, Reliability & Automation

Job Type

Full-Time, Exempt

Department

Engineering, Reliability & Automation (ERA)

Global Supply Chain and Procurement (GPSN)

POSITION SUMMARY

The Director, Global Reliability leads Newell Brands' enterprise reliability program and global technical training function within ERA, spanning a global network of more than 40 manufacturing sites, 60 distribution centers, and operations serving markets in 140 countries. This role serves as the operational owner and program steward of the Newell Brands Strategic Equipment Management Policy (SEMP) — the company's governing framework for how assets are planned, acquired, operated, maintained, and retired across the global supply chain network. The SEMP is the foundational policy underpinning the reliability strategy, and this role is responsible for translating that policy into executable programs, measurable outcomes, and organizational capability across the network. This role carries dual accountability: first, managing approximately 29,000 assets across the full network — manufacturing and DC alike — through fleet management strategy, reliability engineering programs, and condition monitoring deployment; and second, owning ERA's global technical training programs that build reliability, maintenance, and engineering capability across the manufacturing and distribution workforce. The Director owns the full lifecycle of reliability strategy — asset criticality ranking, fleet-based PM standardization, condition monitoring, and RCM deployment — applied across both plant and DC environments, integrated with CMMS and OT platforms, and leads Atlantis and ARES programs. The Director builds and leads a global team of reliability professionals and training specialists, with dotted-line coordination into site-level maintenance and engineering leadership across manufacturing and distribution operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Global Reliability Program Leadership

  • Own and execute the ERA Global Reliability Program roadmap (Q3 2026 through Q1 2029), including ARES, Atlantis, and condition monitoring stage gates across 40+ manufacturing sites and 60 DCs.
  • Define and deploy the global reliability standard: asset registry and criticality ranking, PM interval optimization (RCM/condition-based), condition monitoring tiered by asset class, and layered digital architecture from edge to analytics — structured in alignment with ISO 55000 asset management principles to ensure the program operates as a governed, policy-driven system rather than a collection of site-level initiatives.
  • Drive network-wide improvement in planned maintenance rate (PMR) toward the 85%+ target; manage Pareto-based site prioritization and intervention strategy.
  • Lead OEE and TEEP improvement initiatives in coordination with Operations leadership; drive toward the ERA targets of OEE 80% and TEEP 60% across the ERA manufacturing footprint.
  • Own the global standards for the PEAK EFO (Equipment and Facility Optimization) PAC, serving as the enterprise steward for the AM (Autonomous Maintenance) and PM (Planned Maintenance) pillars; define pillar standards, audit criteria, maturity progression models, and deployment sequencing across the manufacturing and DC network in alignment with the PEAK operating system.
  • Partner with PEAK governance and site operations leadership to integrate EFO AM and PM pillar execution into the reliability program roadmap; ensure PEAK pillar maturity advances in lockstep with CMMS data quality, condition monitoring deployment, and reliability KPI improvement.

Fleet Management Strategy

  • Lead the development and execution of fleet management strategies for the 29,000-asset global portfolio, treating equipment populations (motors, drives, compressors, conveyors, injection molds, robots, automation equipment, etc.) as managed fleets with standardized lifecycle policies.
  • Define asset classification taxonomy and fleet segmentation criteria; establish fleet-level criticality ratings that drive PM frequency, inspection standards, and capital replacement triggers.

jobs.description:
Say hello to Hagerty

Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us! 

As a Scrum Master you will be a delivery leader responsible for enabling effective execution, collaboration, and continuous improvement within a value stream or domain-aligned team. This role partners closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, and IT Portfolio Management to help teams deliver value predictably and sustainably.

Reporting to the Manager of IT Portfolio Operations, the Scrum Master focuses on how work gets done — facilitating team effectiveness, improving flow, surfacing impediments, and fostering a culture of accountability, learning, and transparency. This role goes beyond facilitating ceremonies to actively coach teams and stakeholders in agile and lean practices that fit the complexity of our environment.

What you’ll do

Team Delivery Enablement

  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies and team-level planning activities in a way that drives clarity, alignment, and outcomes.
  • Help teams plan, sequence, and execute work effectively while balancing quality, predictability, and flow.
  • Coach teams on backlog readiness, estimation, and commitment practices.
  • Support teams in managing dependencies, risks, and impediments, escalating as needed through appropriate channels.
  • Encourage ownership, accountability, and collaboration within the team.

Flow, Visibility & Metrics

  • Promote transparency into delivery progress, risks, and dependencies using agreed tooling and practices (e.g., Azure DevOps).
  • Help teams understand and use delivery metrics (e.g., flow, predictability, throughput) to inform continuous improvement.
  • Ensure work items are well-maintained and accurately represented to support portfolio-level visibility.
  • Partner with IT Portfolio Managers to provide reliable insights into team delivery status and capacity.

Coaching & Continuous Improvement

  • Coach team members and stakeholders on Agile and Lean principles and practices.
  • Facilitate retrospectives that lead to actionable improvement experiments.
  • Help teams evolve from reactive execution to proactive problem-solving and systems thinking.
  • Foster a psychologically safe environment that supports learning, experimentation, and honest feedback.

Cross-Team & Ecosystem Collaboration

  • Collaborate with other Scrum Masters to align practices and manage cross-team dependencies.
  • Partner with Technical Product Managers, Engineering Leaders, and Architects to improve engagement, planning, and delivery outcomes.
  • Participate in Communities of Practice to share learnings and promote consistent delivery practices.
  • Support organizational initiatives related to delivery maturity and operational excellence.

Standards, Tools & Ways of Working

  • Apply and reinforce agreed delivery standards, readiness expectations, and tooling practices.
  • Use frameworks pragmatically (Scrum, Kanban, Scrumban) based on team context and maturity.
  • Contribute feedback to resources, templates, and guidance to improve their effectiveness and relevance.

Reporting & Role Context

  • Reports to the Manager of IT Portfolio Operations
  • Supports one or more teams aligned to a value stream or domain
  • Partners closely with IT Portfolio Managers, Engineering, Product, and Architecture
  • Leverages tools including Azure DevOps (ADO) and collaboration platforms (e.g., Lucid or equivalents)

How This Role Fits in the Ecosystem

  • IT Portfolio Managers focus on what is delivered and how value flows across the portfolio.
  • Managers of IT Portfolio Operations enable delivery by developing and supporting Scrum Masters.
  • Scrum Masters focus on how teams work to deliver, acting as facilitators, coaches, and delivery leaders within value streams.

This might describe you

  • Hands-on experience as a Scrum Master in a software delivery environment
  • Strong facilitation and coaching skills
  • Systems thinker who understands dependencies and flow beyond a single team
  • Comfortable influencing without authority
  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences
  • Pragmatic and outcomes-focused, not dogmatic about frameworks
  • Curious, empathetic, and committed to continuous improvement
  • Experience working in complex or enterprise environments preferred
  • Financial Technology Industry Experience.
  • Experience working with Data Engineering Scrum Teams.

Other things to note

  • This position is open to U.S. remote work. However, team members who reside within 20 miles of the Traverse City headquarters will follow a hybrid schedule, working from the office three days per week.
  • May require travel for quarterly events.
  • Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. Including attestation to the completeness, accuracy, and compliance of all financial reporting data, where applicable.

jobs.title: Senior Functional Safety Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Company IntroductionAt Bot Auto, we are revolutionizing the transportation of goods with our cutting-edge autonomous trucks, enhancing the quality of life for communities around the globe.
jobs.description:
Company Introduction

At Bot Auto, we are revolutionizing the transportation of goods with our cutting-edge autonomous trucks, enhancing the quality of life for communities around the globe. With the agility of a start-up and the wisdom of seasoned experts, Bot Auto boasts a team that has achieved numerous world-firsts and unparalleled innovations. United by a shared vision, we create miracles and propel the future of transportation. Join us and transform your dreams into reality.

About the Role

Bot Auto is seeking a Senior Functional Safety Engineer to help define, analyze, validate, and continuously improve the safety of our autonomous trucking platform. In this role, you will work across autonomy, vehicle platform, hardware, software, operations, validation, and fleet teams to ensure our autonomous driving system is designed, tested, and operated with rigorous safety principles. This role will focus heavily on the functional safety and redundancy designs of our next generation platform working with our hardware and infrastructure software systems team.

You will own and contribute to hazard analysis, safety requirements, safety case development, operational risk assessments, verification and validation evidence, and launch readiness reviews for Level 4 autonomous trucking operations. This is a high-impact role for an engineer who can bridge deep technical analysis with practical deployment needs in real-world freight operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead system safety analysis for Bot Auto’s autonomous trucking platform, including autonomy software, vehicle controls, perception, planning, prediction, localization, compute, sensors, communications, fallback behavior, and operational processes
  • Develop and maintain safety artifacts such as hazard analyses, functional safety concepts, technical safety requirements, safety cases, risk assessments, fault trees, FMEAs, STPA analyses, ODD assessments, and validation evidence
  • Translate hazards and operational risks into clear, testable safety requirements for engineering, validation, operations, and fleet teams
  • Partner internally with autonomy, software, hardware, vehicle integration, infrastructure, security, operations, and test teams to ensure safety requirements are implemented and verified
  • Implement the Functional Safety Manager type of role for our autonomous vehicle platform working externally with suppliers, the distributed safety development/DIA, and tracking of functional safety case work products across tiered suppliers and integrators
  • Support definition and refinement of the Operational Design Domain, including operating routes, environmental constraints, traffic conditions, vehicle behavior boundaries, fallback strategies, and minimum-risk maneuvers
  • Evaluate safety impacts of new autonomy features, software releases, hardware changes, sensor configurations, operational procedures, and route expansions
  • Drive safety reviews for on-road testing, driverless readiness, commercial operations, incident response, and post-event analysis
  • Analyze logs, simulations, test results, disengagements, safety-driver interventions, fleet events, and edge cases to identify safety trends and improvement opportunities
  • Define verification and validation strategies for safety-critical requirements across simulation, closed-course testing, structured road testing, shadow mode, and operational deployment
  • Work with cross-functional teams to ensure traceability from hazards to requirements, implementation, test coverage, and safety-case evidence
  • Contribute to safety governance, launch readiness criteria, change management, release approval processes, and operational safety metrics
  • Support regulatory, customer, partner, insurer, and internal safety reviews as needed
  • Promote a strong safety culture while enabling fast, disciplined engineering execution

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 7+ years of experience in systems safety, functional safety, autonomous vehicles, robotics, aerospace, automotive, heavy vehicles, safety-critical software, or complex cyber-physical systems
  • Strong experience performing safety analyses such as HARA, FMEA, FTA, STPA, failure mode analysis, requirements decomposition, and risk assessment
  • Experience developing or contributing to safety cases for safety-critical systems
  • Strong understanding of autonomous vehicle system architecture, including perception, prediction, planning, control, localization, mapping, vehicle actuation, compute, sensing, and fleet operations
  • Understanding of highly redundant, fault tolerant architectures and fail operational ADS and vehicle health management
  • Familiarity with safety standards and frameworks such as ISO 26262, ISO 21448/SOTIF, UL 4600 Safety Case, SAE J3016/J3018, MIL-STD-882, IEC 61508, or similar safety-critical system standards
  • Demonstrated experience with distributed development of safety systems and coordination of safety work products and safety case at automotive OEM and Tier 1 or similar OEM/integration level across system of systems and key elements
  • Familiarity with emerging standards and best practices for road vehicles using physical AI and driven by ADS, such as AVSC Best Practices, SAE standards, and ISO PAS 8800
  • Ability to convert ambiguous technical and operational risks into structured engineering requirements and actionable mitigations, arrive as a leader in your field ready to drive our AV safety readiness
  • Experience working with verification and validation teams to define evidence needed to support safety claims
  • Strong technical communication skills, including the ability to present risk decisions, tradeoffs, and safety arguments to engineering leaders and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving startup environment where safety rigor, execution speed, and practical deployment constraints must be balanced

Nice to Have

  • Experience with autonomous trucks, commercial vehicles, robotics, AV operations, fleet operations, or on-road testing
  • Experience with ISO26262 or similar safety audit and assessment process
  • Experience supporting driverless launch readiness, route readiness, ODD expansion, or commercial autonomous vehicle deployment
  • Experience analyzing vehicle logs, simulation results, scenario databases, disengagements, incidents, or safety-driver interventions
  • Familiarity with trucking operations, FMCSA/DOT regulations, commercial vehicle safety, or heavy-duty vehicle systems
  • Experience with requirements management and traceability tools such as JAMA, Polarion, DOORS, Confluence/JIRA, or similar
  • Experience with Python, SQL, data analysis, log analysis, or scripting for safety metrics and validation evidence
  • Experience with cybersecurity risk assessment, operational safety, incident response, or emergency response planning and automotive standard ISO21434 and UN ECE R155
  • Advanced degree in engineering, robotics, safety engineering, or a related discipline

Key Success Measures

  • Safety requirements are clear, testable, traceable, and aligned with system hazards
  • Safety analyses are current, technically rigorous, and integrated into engineering and release decisions
  • Safety-case evidence supports operational readiness decisions for new features, routes, and deployment milestones
  • Cross-functional teams understand key hazards, mitigations, fallback expectations, and validation requirements
  • Safety risks are identified early, communicated clearly, and resolved through practical engineering and operational controls
  • AV vehicle architectures and risk assessment organized per ISO26262 and relevant safety standards with strong leadership across safety critical suppliers and delivered components and safety analyses

Who You Are

You are a systems thinker who can understand the full autonomous trucking stack—from sensors and autonomy software to vehicle actuation, operations, and real-world deployment. You are rigorous but pragmatic, comfortable challenging assumptions, and able to partner with fast-moving engineering teams without becoming a bottleneck. You care deeply about safety, but you also understand that safety engineering must produce actionable decisions, not just documentation. You can explain–even teach–complex topics in autonomy safety with clarity and to build support across multiple stakeholders and partners.

jobs.description:
Physical Therapist / PTA – Telehealth Patient Intake & Education (Remote / Work from Home)

Location: Remote (Must reside in CA or hold an active California PT/PTA license)

Job Type: Part-Time / Per Diem (W-2) (~10+ hours/week)

Compensation: $30.00 / hour (Base) + Uncapped Performance Incentives (Target Total: $45.00 – $60.00 / hour)

About the Role

Are you a licensed California Physical Therapist (PT) or Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) who excels at pelvic floor rehabilitation, patient education, empathetic listening, and connection, but wants a break from heavy hands-on patient treatment?

Pelvic Path Physical Therapy is seeking an articulate, warm, and professional Remote PT or PTA to conduct virtual Discovery & Intake Calls for prospective patients. Serving as the trusted first point of contact, you will provide clinical education, explain our specialized care model, address patient hesitations, and guide prospective patients to schedule their comprehensive 1-on-1 evaluations with our in-person clinical team.

Why Join Our Remote Team?

  • 100% Work from Home: Work remotely with flexible scheduling (~10+ hours/week).

  • Warm Inbound Leads: Zero cold calling—discovery consultations are pre-booked directly onto your calendar.

  • Autonomy & Training: Complete onboarding and call frameworks provided, with total freedom to bring your authentic clinical voice to every conversation (no robotic scripts).

  • Competitive Earning Potential: $30.00/hr base rate + uncapped performance commission ($45.00 – $60.00/hr total target earnings).

  • Career Advancement: Potential to expand your role as our boutique practice continues to grow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct Virtual Discovery Calls: Host pre-scheduled, non-diagnostic consultations with prospective patients to discuss how pelvic health physical therapy can address their concerns.

  • Patient Education & Triage: Provide high-level clinical education on pelvic floor health (pregnancy, postpartum, bowel/bladder, pelvic pain, post-surgical care) while maintaining scope-of-practice boundaries.

  • Lead Engagement & Re-engagement: Reconnect with past inquiries and warm leads via phone, email, and text to help them commit to starting care.

  • Documentation & Coordination: Log accurate call notes, patient goals, and intake details in our EMR/CRM platforms to ensure a seamless handoff to evaluating clinicians.

Scope of Practice & Clinical Boundaries

  • Non-Diagnostic Focus: This role is dedicated strictly to patient education, intake navigation, and care access. Intake staff do not perform clinical diagnostics or prescribe treatment plans. All diagnostic evaluations are conducted by our evaluating in-clinic Physical Therapists.

  • Licensure Supervision: PTAs operating in this role work under the direction and supervision of a licensed California Physical Therapist in full compliance with Physical Therapy Board of California guidelines.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Licensure: Active, unrestricted Physical Therapist (PT) or Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in the state of California (Required).

  • Clinical Comfort: Must have experience in treating patients with pelvic floor dysfunction (bowel/bladder, pelvic pain, pregnancy/postpartum, sexual wellness) with empathy and professional discretion.

  • Consultative Communication: Strong interpersonal and active listening skills with the ability to build immediate trust and help hesitant callers take the next step in their care.

  • Tech-Savvy: Proficient with EMR systems, CRM platforms, online scheduling software, and Google Workspace.

  • Availability: ~10+ hours/week with room for growth and flexible block scheduling (occasional evening availability preferred based on booking trends).

How to Apply

Ready to transition your clinical skills into a rewarding, work-from-home telehealth intake role? Submit your resume today for immediate consideration!

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

As part of the Customized Client Care team of MusiCares, the Client Manager will play a crucial role in providing comprehensive support to clients including assessments, grant request support, and referrals for individuals who meet MusiCares’ program guidelines. You will contribute to MusiCares’ overall continuum of care ensuring high quality, compassionate, and client-centered care, and collaborate across the Health & Human Services department to support program delivery.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Deliver equitable and coordinated client-centered care that recognizes the importance of the interconnected impact of financial hardship, physical health and mental health on overall wellbeing;
    • Utilize trauma-informed and strength-based approaches to provide informal counseling and guidance within the scope of the Client Manager role.
    • Apply clinical acumen to review and recommend grant assistance for health, mental health, addiction recovery, and basic living needs. Balance grant administration with holistic support and community referrals.

    • Maintain accurate and timely confidential case records and review documentation based on organizational policy.
  • Collaborate with Operations and Finance teams to implement best practices around fraud mitigation and documentation standards and engage in opportunities to ensure uniform team approaches to client assessment.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development related to MusiCares’ data, trauma-informed care, motivational interviewing, client engagement, industry trends, and HHS compliance guidelines.
  • Share client-focused trends and maintain strong understanding of MusiCares’ stewardship.
  • Collaborate across organization departments as needed.
  • Represent MusiCares at on-site events, support opportunities across industry engagement, and promote MusiCares programs and services for the Recording Academy and its affiliates.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Master’s degree in mental health, behavioral health, social services, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in mental health, behavioral health, or social services.
  • Adaptability to assess areas across mental health, addiction recovery, health-related issues and general financial hardship/basic living needs.
  • Commitment to maintain confidentiality and issues of privacy.

  • Demonstrated leadership skills with excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication and strategic thinking.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative and entrepreneurial business environment.
  • An entrepreneurial spirit with enthusiasm for the opportunities that accompany a premier icon brand and mission-based organization.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS FOR CERTAIN ROLES

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for long periods of time, and work at a computer for long periods of time.

The employee will be required to lift and/or move up to 60 pounds.

SALARY AND BENEFITS

The starting salary for this position is $83,800 to $93,000 per year, benchmarked against industry standards. Salaries for positions required to be in specific geographic locations reflect the corresponding labor market.

The actual offer extended will depend on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and the role's requirements and will include our comprehensive benefits package (with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401k match, generous paid time off, and more).Click here for an overview of our company benefits.

Explore our career opportunities to join a team that values creativity, innovation, and diversity.

ABOUT THE RECORDING ACADEMY AND ITS AFFILIATES

RECORDING ACADEMY

The Recording Academy represents the voices of performers, songwriters, producers, engineers, and all music professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the recording arts remain a thriving part of our shared cultural heritage, the Academy honors music's history while investing in its future through the GRAMMY Museum, advocates on behalf of music creators, supports music people in times of need through MusiCares, and celebrates artistic excellence through the GRAMMY Awards—music's only peer-recognized accolade and highest achievement. As the world's leading society of music professionals, we work year-round to foster a more inspiring world for creators.

LATIN RECORDING ACADEMY

The Latin Recording Academy is an international, membership-based organization comprised of Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking recording artists, musicians, songwriters, producers and other creative and technical recording professionals. The organization is dedicated to improving the quality of life and cultural condition for Latin music and its makers. In addition to producing the Latin GRAMMY Awards to honor excellence in the recorded arts and sciences, The Latin Recording Academy provides educational and outreach programs for the Latin music community either directly or through its Latin GRAMMY Cultural Foundation.

LATIN GRAMMY CULTURAL FOUNDATION

The Latin GRAMMY Cultural Foundation is a charitable organization established by the Latin Recording Academy in 2014. The organization is dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of Latin music creators through scholarships, educational programs, grants, and access to creators and industry executives.

MUSICARES

A friend and ally of the music community, MusiCares was established by the Recording Academy to safeguard the health and well-being of all music people. A four-star charity and safety net in times of need, MusiCares offers confidential preventative, recovery, and emergency programs to address financial, medical, and personal health issues. Through the generosity of our donors and volunteer professionals, our dedicated team works across the country to ensure the music community has the resources and support it needs.

GRAMMY MUSEUM

The GRAMMY Museum is a nonprofit organization dedicated to celebrating and exploring music from yesterday and today to inspire the music of tomorrow through music preservation, education, exhibitions, and public programming and aims to create a world in which shared love of music sparks curiosity, creativity, and community. Programs include GRAMMY in the Schools education programs that are offered year-round for students, teachers, and schools throughout the United States.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

The Recording Academy, its affiliates, and the music industry have a strong culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. The Recording Academy makes intentional, courageous, and principled decisions for stronger business outcomes and ensures that all creators and professionals live and work in a fair and safe environment. It is the Recording Academy's policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees. The Recording Academy does not discriminate on the basis of race (nor traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion (including religious dress and grooming), creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law. The Recording Academy will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship to the Recording Academy. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, promotion, discipline, termination, access to benefits and training, recruitment, hiring, transfer, and social and recreational programs.

jobs.description:
As a Customer Success Manager at Lone Wolf, you will own the ongoing success of a portfolio of customers and help them achieve meaningful business outcomes through our solutions. You will serve as a trusted advisor, customer advocate, and internal orchestrator across the post-sale journey. Your role is to understand what success means for each customer, translate those goals into a clear plan, drive adoption and value realization, identify risk early, and coordinate the right resources to keep the customer moving forward. This is not simply a relationship-management or issue-escalation role. Our Customer Success Managers are expected to take accountability for the customer experience, lead with insight, maintain strong operational discipline, and ensure customers and internal teams have a clear understanding of goals, progress, risks, and next steps.

What You’ll Do:

    • Own Customer Outcomes: Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business, priorities, workflows, stakeholders, and desired outcomes. Translate those objectives into clear success criteria, milestones, and an actionable customer Success Plan.
    • Drive Adoption and Value: Use product knowledge, customer conversations, usage data, and business context to identify adoption gaps and opportunities. Guide customers toward the workflows and behaviors that will help them realize greater value from Lone Wolf solutions.
    • Lead Proactive Engagement: Conduct regular, proactive virtual meetings (1:1 or group) based on customer needs, segment, risk, and opportunity. Lead purposeful conversations to share updates & insights, provide best practices, address obstacles, and ensure clients are deriving ongoing value from their investment.
    • Manage Customer Health and Risk: Continuously assess customer health indicators and usage data to proactively identify potential risks early, diagnose root causes, and lead documented recovery plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, and communication.
    • Orchestrate the Customer Experience: Coordinate effectively across Support, implementation, Product, Sales, and other teams to deliver a connected customer experience. While you may not personally perform every action, you will maintain ownership of customer communication, internal alignment, and follow-through.
    • Build Renewal Readiness: Ensure customers are positioned for renewal by helping them achieve measurable value, maintaining strong stakeholder alignment, and surfacing risks well before the renewal date. Partner closely with Sales or the appropriate commercial owner to provide an accurate, evidence-based view of account health, outcomes, and renewal risk.
    • Contribute to Team Excellence: Share knowledge, contribute ideas, strengthen playbooks and best practices, and help build a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Customer-first mindset with a passion for driving customer outcomes and delivering value through every interaction
  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing Success role (Customer Success, Account Management, or similar) in a SaaS environment
  • Demonstrated ability to understand customer business needs and connect software adoption to measurable outcomes
  • Strong consultative skills, including discovery, active listening, problem diagnosis, and the ability to guide or challenge customers constructively
  • Experience managing a portfolio of customers with competing priorities, risks, and deadlines
  • A vocal team player and emerging leader — you speak up, contribute ideas, and help lift the team through positivity, initiative, and knowledge-sharing
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — you know how to simplify complex topics and tailor your message to your audience
  • Solid problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to managing customer needs and resolving issues
  • Collaborative and resourceful — you know when to own it and when to loop in teammates or other departments
  • A keen interest in technology and helping customers adopt software to improve their business
  • Bonus: Experience in real estate is an asset but not required

We’re now looking for an experienced Brand Manager to join us remotely and shape how VOID and our titles are positioned in the market. You’ll lead brand strategy and campaigns across announcements, content updates, DLC, platform launches and seasonal moments. Build brand foundations for new IP from zero alongside an established tactical FPS franchise.

This role reports directly to the Marketing and Publishing Director, partnering on brand strategy across the portfolio with full ownership of defined projects. Working closely with our development, publishing, creative and community teams, you’ll make sure every campaign has a clear purpose, a strong idea and a measurable commercial goal. You’ll understand what makes each game distinctive and protect that identity across every player touchpoint.

What You’ll Do

Positioning and brand strategy

  • Build positioning, messaging frameworks and brand guidelines per title, and for VOID as a label.
  • Keep tone, voice and visual identity coherent across store pages, trailers, social, community and PR.
  • Know what each game stands for, and hold that line when scope, feedback or deadlines push against it.

Campaigns and go-to-market

  • Plan and run campaign beats end to end: announcements, content updates, DLC, platform launches and seasonal moments.
  • Write briefs with one clear idea per beat, then give creative, capture and community teams the room to execute it well.
  • Own the marketing calendar across titles so beats reinforce each other instead of colliding.

Commercial outcomes

  • Tie every campaign to a target: wish lists, conversion, reactivation or platform acquisition.
  • Read Steam and first-party data, community sentiment and creator coverage, then adjust the plan rather than the report.
  • Flag gaps between ambition and resources early, and bring options when you do.

Partners and orchestration

  • Act as the day-to-day alignment point between development, publishing, creative, community and external partners.
  • Support platform conversations with Valve, PlayStation and Xbox, including co-marketing and featuring beats.
  • Direct agencies and contractors when a campaign needs more hands than we have

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience in brand management, product marketing or publishing within the games industry.
  • Games industry experience is essential, ideally on premium PC or console titles.
  • A portfolio of campaigns you can walk us through clearly, explaining the strategy, individual campaign beats, execution and results.
  • Confidence working with data and connecting brand activity to commercial outcomes.
  • Experience working across development teams, leadership, platform partners, agencies and media.
  • The ability to manage several titles and major campaign moments at the same time without losing focus or quality.
  • We ask for regular overlap with EU and NA working hours to collaborate with our global team.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • A strong understanding of tactical shooters, milsim or other hardcore gaming communities.
  • A clear understanding of the difference between authenticity within a genre and simply adopting its aesthetic.
  • Go-to-market experience across console or mobile platforms alongside PC.
  • Experience working on both the developer and publisher sides of the industry.

Please Note:

If you’re based in Ireland and have the right to work here, this role will be offered as a full-time employee position.

If you’re based outside Ireland, how we employ or engage you will depend on your location and the relevant local employment and tax requirements. Depending on these requirements, the role may be offered as a contractor position.

We’re a remote-first company and welcome applications from candidates worldwide. Compensation will be based on your location, experience and local market rates.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Senior Manager, Escalations!

About the job

As the leader of our North American Global Escalation Management team, you will play a pivotal role in driving Twilio’s mission to deliver an unparalleled customer experience. This is a high-impact opportunity to scale our operations and ensure that both internal stakeholders and our global customer base receive world-class support.

We are seeking a visionary leader who is deeply committed to mentoring and developing talent while championing continuous process improvement. The Senior Manager of Escalation Management is an Influential Operations Leader responsible for the reduction of recurrent escalations by driving systemic change to transform the customer experience at scale. Beyond immediate crisis mitigation, you will act as a structural engineer for the department, utilizing data-driven insights to refine escalation strategies, evolve organizational processes, and influence product stability. As a dedicated people leader, you will mentor your team to elevate their strategic maturity, shifting their focus from tactical troubleshooting to proactive risk assessment and executive-level analytical reporting. You are responsible for transforming a proactive culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

Executive Communication & Product Influence

  • High-Stakes Liaison and Direct Customer Advocacy: Your primary responsibility is to act as the direct, primary interface for customers during high-visibility incidents. You will serve as the "single source of truth" for both the customer and the Senior Director/VP level. This is not a behind-the-scenes role; you are expected to be front-and-center, translating complex technical hurdles into clear, actionable business communications.
  • Product Betterment: Turn escalation volume into "Business Intelligence." Partner with Customer Experience teams with data-backed evidence to prioritize process and product enhancements.

Strategic Planning & Governance

  • Strategic Roadmap: Participate in the development and execute a multi-quarter strategy to transition the escalation function from a reactive cost center to a proactive value-driver.
  • MOR & QBR Leadership: Lead Monthly Operating Reviews (MORs) to track departmental health and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with senior leadership to report on trends, Return of Investment (ROI) of mitigation efforts, and long-term risk forecasts.
  • Resource Forecasting: Plan headcount and tool requirements based on projected product launches and customer growth.

Project Management Responsibilities and Skills

  • Lead end-to-end project lifecycle for cross-functional escalation initiatives, from definition to execution and post-launch analysis.
  • Manage project timelines, dependencies, and deliverables, ensuring adherence to high-quality standards and strategic objectives.
  • Proficiency in project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Waterfall) and tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Airtable) to track progress and report on project status to stakeholders.
  • Ability to facilitate stakeholder alignment and resolve conflicts to drive project milestones to completion.

Process Creation & Refinement

  • Framework Design: Build, document, and deploy the "Escalation Runbook", defining the triggers, communication cadences, and resolution paths across the company.
  • Continuous Improvement: Constantly audit existing workflows to identify friction. You will be responsible for the creation of new SOPs that bridge gaps between Sales, Support, Customer Experience and Engineering.
  • Operational Rigor: Establish clear Operating Level Agreements (OLAs) with cross-functional partners to ensure accountability and predictable response times.

People Betterment & Cultural Leadership

  • Mentorship & Strategic Maturity: Mentor your team on advanced strategic thinking. Move them beyond tactical troubleshooting toward long-term negotiation strategies, proactive risk assessment, and analytical reporting tailored for an executive audience.
  • Cross-Functional Coaching: Lead a company-wide initiative to uplevel the de-escalation skill set of the broader Support and Operations organizations. Implement training programs focused on "Betterment Identification," empowering front-line teams to pre-emptively manage issues before they require executive-level intervention.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Ability to put yourself in the customer’s shoes and demonstrate your dedication to the customer experience through people management, coaching and performance management for supporting employee experience
  • Experience being inclusive, while working with team members in different geographic locations and time zones
  • Learning mindset, ability to learn new things, be curious and build internal and external relevant knowledge
  • Demonstrated ability to identify process and team improvements, innovation and “Drawing the Owl” to creatively solve problems and allow your team to operate at scale
  • Have proven documentation ability to “write it down” to create and curate internal and external documentation
  • Have Strong English written and verbal communication skills

Desired:

  • Experience: 10+ years in high-growth tech, with 7+ years in a leadership role reporting to Director-level or above.
  • Business Acumen: Experience leading MORs/QBRs and presenting to executive audiences.
  • Systemic Thinker: Proven ability to look at a problem and build a process to fix it, not just for one customer, but for the entire ecosystem.
  • Data Literacy: Expert at using CRM (Salesforce/Zendesk) and BI tools (Tableau/Looker) to tell a story with data.
  • Strategy & Execution: A unique ability to think at a 30,000-foot level (Strategic Planning) while remaining willing to "dive into the weeds" when a Tier 0 crisis hits.

Location

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $141,520.00 - $176,900.00.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until September 21, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.
