  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Build, deliver and facilitate cohort-based one:many programs for customers, guiding groups through structured learning journeys from onboarding through advanced product adoption
  • Design new, innovative experiences tying together physical and digital assets to live sessions and/or Community experiences
  • Produce new and leverage existing training materials in accordance with team standards and brand guidelines; adapt existing materials to reflect product changes and audience needs
  • Proactively leverage in-house and external tools and platforms to optimize the training you deliver (e.g., Samsara Community, in-house AI tools; Slido)
  • Demonstrate expertise across the Samsara platform and show confidence in fielding a wide range of customer questions during live sessions
  • Manage all live session logistics, including training registration, session delivery, Q&A facilitation, polling, and post-session follow-up resources
  • Collaborate closely with the CS Scale as well as the rest of the Education team to shape content for live training and share customer feedback from training events
  • Identify common knowledge gaps across the Scale customer base and partner with Customer Success and Product teams to address them through programming
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills. You make complex platform concepts clear and compelling for large, diverse audiences, both in your verbal delivery and in the materials you produce.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering at-scale programs and live webinars or vILT to external audiences.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills. You're dynamic and enthusiastic, and you connect well with people at any level of an organization.
  • Ability to build digital learning assets when needed, e.g., video tutorials, job aids, and presentation decks, using AI models, authoring and editing tools.
  • A working grasp of instructional design: you structure content around clear learning objectives and can help shape a program, not just deliver it.
  • Self-directed and analytical. You can teach yourself new products and tools quickly and assess what customers most need to know.
  • Ability to analyze engagement and impact data, then iterate on your content to improve what's working and fix what isn't.
  • Strong prioritization skills. You handle multiple programs and sessions concurrently while staying organized, methodical, and detail-oriented.
  • An eye for detail and polish in everything you produce.
  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
  • 3–4 years of experience teaching or delivering training, with at least 1 year in a one-to-many or scaled delivery model.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Familiarity with webinar and virtual classroom platforms and tools
  • Experience with LMS and Community platforms, and customer education content development tools
  • Background in SaaS product training

Position Summary

The Document Controller is responsible for managing, organizing, tracking, and maintaining all project documentation throughout the construction project lifecycle. This role ensures that drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, contracts, correspondence, reports, and other project records are properly controlled, distributed, stored, and readily accessible to authorized project stakeholders.

The Document Controller works closely with project managers, engineers, superintendents, subcontractors, consultants, architects, and clients to ensure that project information is accurate, current, and distributed in accordance with established document-control procedures.

Key Responsibilities

Document Management

  • Establish and maintain an organized document-control system for construction projects.
  • Receive, register, review, distribute, and archive project documents.
  • Maintain accurate document registers, logs, and tracking systems.
  • Ensure documents are correctly named, numbered, dated, and assigned the appropriate revision/status.
  • Maintain electronic and, when required, hard-copy project files.
  • Ensure obsolete or superseded documents are identified and removed from active use.

Drawings & Technical Documents

  • Control the distribution and revision of construction drawings, specifications, schedules, and technical documents.
  • Maintain current drawing registers and revision histories.
  • Distribute approved and revised drawings to relevant project teams, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.
  • Track the status of shop drawings, material submittals, samples, and other technical submissions.
  • Coordinate with engineering and project teams to ensure the latest approved information is available on site.

RFIs, Submittals & Correspondence

  • Log and track Requests for Information (RFIs), submittals, transmittals, approvals, and technical queries.
  • Monitor document workflows and follow up on outstanding items.
  • Prepare and issue transmittals and document distribution records.
  • Maintain records of project correspondence, meeting minutes, notices, and formal communications.
  • Ensure responses and approvals are properly recorded and linked to the relevant project documentation.

Project Closeout

  • Maintain complete and accurate project records throughout construction.
  • Assist with the preparation of project handover and closeout documentation.
  • Compile and organize as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, warranties, certificates, inspection records, and other turnover documents.
  • Verify that required closeout documentation has been received and properly filed.
  • Support the project team in meeting contractual document-submission requirements.

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure document-control activities comply with company policies, project procedures, contractual requirements, and applicable quality standards.
  • Maintain confidentiality and security of sensitive project information.
  • Conduct periodic checks to identify missing, duplicate, incorrectly filed, or outdated documents.
  • Support project audits by providing accurate and traceable documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in construction management, business administration, engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • 2–5 years of experience in document control, project administration, construction administration, or a related construction/project environment.
  • Experience working with construction drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, and project correspondence.
  • Strong knowledge of document-control principles and document numbering/revision systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and PDF/document management tools.
  • Experience with construction management/document-control platforms such as Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Aconex, Bluebeam, or similar systems is preferred.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage large volumes of documentation and competing priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with project managers, field personnel, subcontractors, consultants, and clients.
  • Ability to identify document discrepancies and follow up on missing information.
  • Strong computer and data-entry skills.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive project information.
  • Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a project team.
  • Understanding of construction terminology and project workflows.

Working Conditions

  • Primarily office/project-site based, depending on project requirements.
  • May require occasional travel between project offices and construction sites.
  • May require working extended hours to support project deadlines or critical submissions.

Performance Measures

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • Accuracy and completeness of project documentation.
  • Timely distribution and processing of project documents.
  • Effective tracking of revisions, approvals, RFIs, and submittals.
  • Accessibility and organization of project records.

jobs.excerpt: About UsBoundless Life is a family-focused living, working and academy operator building a new model for how families live, their children learn, and parents work around the world.
jobs.description:
About Us

Boundless Life is a family-focused living, working and academy operator building a new model for how families live, their children learn, and parents work around the world. Across eight global destinations — Sintra (Portugal), Syros (Greece), Tuscany (Italy), Andalusia (Spain), Kotor (Montenegro), Bali (Indonesia), Kamakura (Japan), and La Barra (Uruguay) — we offer families the infrastructure to spend one, three, or 6+ months living in a new country: fully furnished homes, dedicated coworking hubs, and our own academy project based learning programs for children ages 1.5 -14.9 years old.

Our members are professionals, entrepreneurs, remote workers, and their families who want their children to grow up as global citizens without pausing their careers or their kids' education. We are asset-light where we can be, hybrid where it makes sense, and long-term partners with our landlords and local communities in every market we enter.

The future of family life and work is global, seamless, and community-driven — and we are building it. Join us as we scale toward our next wave of destinations across Europe, Asia, and the Americas.

About The Opportunity

Boundless Life is seeking a highly capable Real Estate Legal Transaction Manager to join our Real Estate & Expansion team and support the growth of our global portfolio across eight active markets today, an active expansion pipeline.

The ideal candidate will bring solid, hands-on experience in commercial real estate legal practice — with a particular focus on complex, multi-jurisdictional lease negotiations and hybrid deal structures (leases with management, operating, or revenue-share components).

This role will serve as a dedicated legal transaction partner to the Real Estate & Expansion team, reporting directly to the General Legal Counsel and working shoulder-to-shoulder with our Global Head of Real Estate, in-house counsel, external local counsel, and business stakeholders across each market. A core focus of the role is the negotiation, drafting, and interpretation of commercial and residential leases, together with all associated ancillary documents — LOIs, addenda, side letters, management agreements, SNDAs, estoppels, guarantees, and building/regulatory authorizations.

Beyond transactional execution, the successful candidate will help build the legal-operational backbone of a fast-growing global platform: standardizing playbooks, coordinating local counsel across jurisdictions, and translating legal risk into commercially usable guidance for the business.

Boundless Life operates across eight very different legal environments — from Portuguese and Spanish commercial lease frameworks to Indonesian Hak Pakai regimes, Italian, Greek, and Montenegrin civil law traditions, and Japanese and Uruguayan market practice — with active expansion pipeline (France, Costa Rica) adding further complexity. Candidates must be comfortable quickly grasping the intricacies of new jurisdictions, working through unfamiliar frameworks with local counsel, and holding the commercial line while doing so.

This position reports to the General Counsel, with a strong working line into the Head of Real Estate & Expansion. Location is flexible (remote-friendly, EMEA time zone preferred), with regular travel expected to active and prospective markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Transactional Execution: Lead the drafting and negotiation of a diverse deal flow, including commercial leases (education centers, coworking hubs, family lounges), residential portfolio leases and management agreements, LOIs, MOUs, lease amendments, SNDAs, estoppels, guarantees, and hybrid lease-plus-management structures. Ensure every document protects Boundless Life's commercial and operational interests while unblocking the growth pipeline.
  • Multi-Jurisdictional Coordination: Manage and quality-control external local counsel across our active markets (currently Portugal, Greece, Italy, Spain, Montenegro, Indonesia, Japan, and Uruguay), our active expansion markets (France, Costa Rica), and any new jurisdiction we enter. Own the relationship, the scope, and the output — including translating local legal advice into clear, actionable direction for the business.
  • Asset Management & Operational Support: Provide legal interpretation of the existing lease portfolio and day-to-day support to Operations, Finance, Local Hosts, and Community teams on lease questions, escalations, disputes, permits, and landlord communications.
  • Real Estate Due Diligence: Lead legal due diligence on new locations and strategic initiatives — identifying and pricing regulatory, title, zoning, ERP/permitting, tax withholding, and structural risks — and translating findings into go/no-go recommendations.
  • Playbook & Process Optimization: Help build the RE Legal function from the inside out: templates, redline playbooks by jurisdiction, approval workflows, contract repository standards, and lease management processes. Turn one-off work into repeatable systems.
  • Strategic and Practical Legal Advice: Deliver timely, commercially oriented legal advice to internal stakeholders across all levels — from Development Managers and Project Managers up to the CEO and Board — translating complex legal concepts into clear, risk-based recommendations the business can act on.
  • Dispute Management: Support the resolution of landlord, tenant, and vendor disputes across markets, working with local counsel where litigation, arbitration, or termination scenarios arise.

jobs.description:
About Hightouch

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

The Role

We're hiring our first dedicated Pricing & Packaging Lead. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who wants to own how Hightouch monetizes, not administer a rate card someone else set.

Hightouch has grown from 10 to 100 account executives in under two years, and the product has diversified well beyond its Reverse ETL origins: Customer Studio, Identity Resolution, Journeys, Event Collection and Real-Time Audiences, Match Booster, and a fast-expanding set of AI products with a base + consumption pricing profile. Each launched with its own pricing logic, and the frameworks that got us here won't get us to the next stage. We need a central lead who owns the whole picture, from strategy through the systems that make it real, and who is in the room with our Co-CEOs, CRO, CFO, and product leaders as new pricing gets designed.

This role reports to our Head of Revenue Operations and sits alongside the Deal Desk Lead. Deal Desk owns the transaction: structuring, approvals, and quote accuracy on individual deals. You own the frameworks Deal Desk enforces, and you'll partner with Deal Desk and our front-line sales managers (AEMs) on the largest deals. You'll be hands-on-keyboard from day one and are expected to be a builder and scaler.

What You'll Do

Co-create pricing and packaging with executive and product leadership. Own the pricing and packaging agenda. Partner directly with our Co-CEOs, CRO, CFO, and Product leaders on how new products get packaged, metered, and priced: value metrics, tiers, platform fee structure, commit and drawdown mechanics, overage and true-up rules, floors, and how it all lands on an order form. Run the pricing workstream for every material launch so pricing is decided before the product ships. Build the analysis behind each decision (willingness-to-pay, win/loss and discount data, competitive benchmarking, margin and rev-rec implications) and bring a recommendation, not a menu. Own the decision through rollout, then pressure-test it against real deals and revise where it breaks.

Rationalize and own the current pricing frameworks. Inventory everything we sell and how we price it today, across Platform, Customer Studio, AI products, Event Collection and RTA, Match Booster, and adjacent SKUs. Consolidate overlapping or contradictory frameworks into one coherent price book with clear list prices, unit definitions, bundling rules, and discount guidance by segment and deal size. Define what is standard, what is an exception, and what we no longer offer. Set uplift and repricing standards for renewals and expansions, including how legacy contracts migrate onto current packaging. Report discount depth, price realization, and packaging mix to leadership on a regular cadence.

Build the pricing enablement and calculation tooling for the field. Make it easy for 100+ AEs and their managers to quote correctly and defend the price. Own the Pricing Enablement Hub and the reference documentation reps actually use. Build calculators and scoping tools (usage scoping, consumption estimators, bundle and multi-year configurators, approval-threshold lookups) that produce a defensible quote in minutes. Partner with Revenue Enablement to train reps on pricing, packaging, value positioning, and negotiation guardrails.

Partner with Deal Desk and AEMs on large and complex deals. Where a deal exposes a hole in the framework, you close it so the next deal doesn't need an exception.

Own business requirements for product price books in CPQ. Be the business owner of how our product catalog, price books, pricing rules, bundles, consumption and overage logic, and approval thresholds are represented in CPQ. Write and prioritize requirements, define acceptance criteria, and work with GTM Systems on implementation and testing. Hold the line on data model decisions that determine whether billing, ARR reporting, product-level compensation, and margin analysis are trustworthy downstream. Own price book governance once live.

Advise GTM Compensation on commission by product. Utilize analysis of margins and pricing dynamics to suggest differential commission rates or incentive structures for sellers.

Who You Are

  • You've owned pricing and packaging at a high-growth B2B SaaS company, ideally through product diversification or a pricing-model transition, selling into enterprise at multi-$100K and $1M+ price points. You've built price books, not just analyzed them.
  • You've priced consumption and hybrid models, not just seats. You understand value metrics, commits, drawdown, overage, minimums, and true-ups, and the revenue-recognition and forecasting headaches hybrid models create. Launching pricing for AI or usage-metered products is a strong plus.
  • You've worked directly with founders and executives on pricing decisions. You build the analysis, form a recommendation, defend it in a room with strong opinions, and execute the decision even when it wasn't your first choice. Leaders trust you because you tell them what you actually think.
  • You build pricing models approved by Finance. You drive analysis including margin and revenue impact scenarios, understand how to translate P&L prerogatives into customer action, and respect cost levers when setting pricing and discount structures.
  • You've been close to deals. You've sat with sellers and deal desk on large, complex opportunities and know how pricing strategy meets negotiation reality. You understand that confusing pricing costs real revenue and rep time, and you're energized by making it simple.
  • You've written pricing requirements for CPQ or quote-to-cash systems. You understand product catalogs, price book structures, and pricing rules, and how those choices propagate into billing, ARR reporting, and compensation. You don't need to configure Salesforce yourself, but you speak the language and own the outcome.
  • You build tools people use. Your calculators, scoping models, and reference guides get adopted because they're faster than the alternative. You're fluent in spreadsheets, BI tools, SQL, and increasingly in AI tooling.
  • You think from first principles and ship iteratively. You ask why, build a hypothesis, test it, and update fast. You'd rather fix the top three price book problems this quarter than spend six months on a redesign that lands too late, and you're eager to learn how Hightouch actually runs rather than apply what worked at your last company.

Compensation & Benefits

The salary range for this position is $200,000 to $260,000 per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation in the form of ISO options, and offer early exercise and a 10 year post-termination exercise window.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
QuickBooks Financial Controller
Location: Remote — Canada, Central America, South America, or Europe
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
Industry: Interior Design / Professional Services
Compensation:$2,000 – $4,000 USD/month
English Proficiency:C1/C2 English Required
Schedule: Full-Time | Required overlap with U.S. business hours
Reports To: CFO


About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based luxury interior design firm specializing in bespoke, high-end environments that combine exceptional design, craftsmanship, functionality, and personalized client service.
The company is strengthening its internal finance operations and is looking for an experienced accounting professional who can bring the same level of precision and attention to detail to its financial function.
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished QuickBooks Financial Controller with deep, hands-on QuickBooks expertise to take ownership of the company's accounting operations.
Reporting directly to the CFO, you will have full responsibility for the General Ledger, lead the transition from an outside accounting firm to a fully in-house accounting function, manage monthly close and reconciliations, prepare financial reporting, and oversee the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable team.
QuickBooks expertise is essential for this position. This role requires more than day-to-day usage. You must be comfortable configuring and optimizing QuickBooks and have experience with QuickBooks implementations.
This is a hands-on position for someone who is highly accurate, independent, comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment, and willing to support operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting when needed.
Why This Opportunity?
  • Take full ownership of the company's accounting operations and General Ledger.
  • Become the internal QuickBooks expert for the organization.
  • Work directly with the CFO and play a key role in strengthening the finance function.
  • Lead the transition from outsourced accounting to a fully in-house operation.
  • Manage and improve accounting processes, controls, and reporting.
  • Work remotely with significant autonomy and responsibility.
What You'll Do
QuickBooks & General Ledger
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks to support the company's accounting structure and reporting requirements.
  • Lead or support QuickBooks configuration and implementation initiatives.
  • Lead the transition of the General Ledger from an outside accounting firm to an in-house function.
  • Maintain, reconcile, and close the books monthly.
  • Establish and maintain the Chart of Accounts and appropriate classification standards.
Financial Reporting & Cash Management
  • Prepare accurate financial statements across the company's business divisions.
  • Prepare and review Profit & Loss (P&L) statements.
  • Oversee bank reconciliations.
  • Monitor the company's cash position.
  • Maintain accurate and reliable financial information for CFO review.
Team Leadership & Client Support
  • Supervise Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable specialists.
  • Review and approve invoices, hours reports, and client statements before distribution.
  • Review and approve payroll, vendor payments, and expense submissions.
  • Interface with clients regarding accounting-related requests when required.
  • Ensure accounting work completed by the team meets established standards.
  • Support operational and non-accounting matters that may arise within a small-team environment.
Tax & Accounting Controls
  • Coordinate payroll tax, sales tax, and 1099-related matters.
  • Execute accounting policies established by the CFO accurately and consistently.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a high standard of accuracy.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Prior experience as a Financial Controller, Senior Accountant, or similar senior accounting professional with full ownership of the General Ledger.
  • Advanced, hands-on QuickBooks expertise.
  • Professional experience with QuickBooks Online and/or QuickBooks Desktop.
  • Experience configuring QuickBooks and/or leading a QuickBooks implementation.
  • Strong experience managing the General Ledger, reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Experience preparing financial statements and P&L reports.
  • Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts structures and accounting classifications.
  • Experience overseeing or working closely with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistently low error rates.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to execute accounting policies and procedures with precision.
  • Comfortable supporting operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting.
  • C1/C2 English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work with required overlap during U.S. business hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience transitioning an accounting function from an external accounting firm to an in-house team.
  • Experience with BigTime or similar project accounting software.
  • Previous experience in professional services, interior design, architecture, construction, or project-based businesses.
  • Experience supervising accounting or bookkeeping professionals.
How Success Is Measured
Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:
  • Maintain an accurate and reliable General Ledger.
  • Independently execute reconciliations and month-end close.
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks according to business requirements.
  • Successfully support the transition to an in-house accounting function.
  • Deliver accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a consistently low error rate.
  • Effectively oversee AP and AR activities.
  • Work independently while executing CFO policies accurately.
  • Communicate professionally with U.S.-based colleagues and clients.
Video Presentation Required
As part of your application, please submit a short video in English introducing yourself and briefly summarizing your accounting background, followed by a 30-second to 1-minute overview of your QuickBooks experience, including how many years you have used it professionally, whether you have worked with QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop, your main responsibilities in the system, and any experience configuring QuickBooks or leading an implementation.
Why Join Us?
  • $2,000 – $4,000 USD/month, based on experience and location.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Direct exposure to the CFO and company leadership.
  • Significant ownership of the accounting function.
  • Opportunity to lead an important financial operations transition.
  • Long-term, full-time contractor opportunity.
  • Short initial trial period to ensure mutual fit.
Important Notes
Advanced QuickBooks expertise is a core requirement for this position. Basic familiarity, occasional use, or self-taught exposure without substantial professional experience will not be sufficient.
Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain their years of QuickBooks experience, versions used, responsibilities within the system, experience running monthly close, and any QuickBooks configuration or implementation experience.
C1/C2 English is mandatory. The role operates entirely in English with a U.S.-based team and, at times, directly with clients.
This is a permanent, full-time contractor opportunity with a short initial trial period.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

  • Serve as Oklo’s senior point of contact for utility RFP processes, integrated resource planning (IRP) engagements, and state regulatory dockets where Aurora powerhouse supply is relevant
  • Negotiate and execute utility-scale PPAs and long-term supply agreements, coordinating with Legal and Oklo’s Finance team on regulatory approvals, FERC jurisdictional matters, and rate-base or cost-of-service considerations
  • Track utility load forecasts, resource adequacy filings, and clean energy procurement targets to identify and prioritize the highest-probability utility offtake opportunities across the Aurora powerhouse pipeline

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in power origination, energy commercial development, or structured energy sales — with a direct track record closing long-term PPAs
  • Demonstrated experience selling to at least two of: AI datacenters / hyperscalers, C&I industrials, IOUs, or federal agencies
  • Deep familiarity with PPA structures, energy contract terms, and bankability requirements for project-financed generation assets
  • Strong negotiation skills; experience leading commercial discussions at C-suite and VP level
  • Ability to translate complex nuclear technology into clear commercial value propositions

Competencies

We are looking for a Senior Director of Power Origination that is:

  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $225,000-$275,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

Sommaire du poste

Le ou la rédacteur(trice) technique bilingue est responsable de la rédaction, de la traduction, de la révision et de la mise à jour de la documentation liée au logiciel ERP, en français et en anglais. La personne participe à la production de guides utilisateurs, procédures, notes de mise à jour, de certains contenus de formation et libellés applicatifs, tout en veillant à la qualité linguistique, à la cohérence terminologique et à l’exactitude fonctionnelle des contenus.

Elle collabore étroitement avec l’équipe de développement, d’assurance qualité et d’implantation afin d’assurer la livraison d’une documentation claire, structurée et à jour.

Responsabilités principales

  • Rédiger, réviser, traduire, mettre à jour et structurer la documentation en français et en anglais.

  • Adapter la documentation existante, les procédures, les guides utilisateurs et les notes de mise à jour.

  • Traduire et réviser les libellés, les messages système et certains contenus de formation.

  • Assurer la cohérence terminologique au sein de l’application et de la documentation.

  • Collaborer avec les analystes, développeurs, équipe AQ et équipe d’implantation afin de valider l’exactitude du contenu des documents produits.

  • Effectuer des vérifications dans l’application pour s’assurer de la qualité, de la clarté et de la conformité des textes affichés à l’écran.

  • Identifier, documenter et signaler les anomalies de traduction, de libellés ou de documentation.

  • Effectuer les révisions linguistiques et intégrer les corrections reçues.

  • Préparer, organiser et publier les documents dans les répertoires ou plateformes internes appropriés.

  • Maintenir à jour les fichiers de suivi, les glossaires, les bases terminologiques et les documents d’avancement.

  • Participer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques, gabarits, outils et processus de rédaction et de traduction.

  • Fournir un soutien transversal en révision, traduction et validation linguistique à différentes équipes ou lignes de produits de l’organisation, selon les priorités d’affaires.

  • Apprendre à naviguer dans l’ERP et à en comprendre les principales fonctionnalités afin de produire une documentation claire, exacte et adaptée aux utilisateurs.

Poste à 100% Télétravail,

Tâches spécifiques pouvant être confiées

Produire, traduire et mettre à jour :

o guides utilisateurs;

o procédures internes;

o documentation de formation;

o notes de mise à jour;

o aide en ligne;

Effectuer le suivi de l’avancement des travaux de rédaction et de traduction.

Modifier la mise à jour d’images, de captures d’écran et de visuels liés à la documentation.

Participer aux échanges de validation avant publication.

Profil recherché

  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’écrit.

  • Capacité à vulgariser de l’information technique et fonctionnelle.

  • Très bonne aptitude à rédiger de façon claire, structurée et rigoureuse.

  • Souci du détail, de la qualité linguistique et de la cohérence.

  • Bonne capacité d’analyse, d’organisation et de gestion des priorités.

  • Autonomie, sens de l’initiative et esprit de collaboration.

  • Capacité à travailler avec plusieurs intervenants et à gérer plusieurs livrables simultanément.

  • Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement en développement continu, avec une approche pragmatique orientée vers les priorités et l’amélioration progressive.

  • Capacité à apprendre rapidement un environnement applicatif complexe et à en comprendre les processus afin de produire une documentation pertinente.

Exigences

  • Formation en rédaction, traduction, communication, langues, documentation technique ou domaine connexe.

  • Expérience en rédaction technique, traduction et gestion documentaire en environnement logiciel, dans un contexte bilingue français anglais.

jobs.description:
MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
  • Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
  • Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
  • Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
  • Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
  • Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.

Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
  • Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
  • Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
  • Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.

Influence & Impact

  • Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
  • Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
  • Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries

Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact

  • Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
  • Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
  • Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
  • Identify recurring customer, access, and patient-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights

  • Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.

jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

We are hiring for our first dedicated international quality hire at Grüns. You'll own the quality system for every market outside the US: product release, specifications, complaints and adverse events, incident management, contract manufacturer oversight, stability, and transit qualification. For products sold in the EU, you'll build and run the Quality Management System processes that keep us compliant with EU and local market requirements across the product lifecycle.

Today these responsibilities sit informally with the US QA team. The job is to figure out where they should live, build the processes, and then run them. You'll work across Regulatory, Supply Chain, Operations, and our external manufacturing and 3PL partners, and you'll be the escalation point when something goes wrong in an international market.

Location:

While this role is part of our global remote HQ, we feel a candidate based in or around Germany or the United Kingdom will be most successful in this role.

The team members you’ll be working with most are in multiple countries and time zones, so we ask that you are comfortable working a way that allows for some overlap in working hours to collaborate.

More generally, we operate in a fully remote, high trust environment with teammates across multiple countries and time zones. While we work async by default, we come together in person twice a year for offsites that help us connect, align, and build real relationships IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Release finished products only after verifying specs, COAs, manufacturing docs, deviations, and market-specific requirements
  • Own consumer complaint intake and triage across level 1, 2, and 3
  • Build and run traceability, recall/withdrawal, mock recall, complaint, adverse-event, and food safety incident processes for EU products
  • Own supplier and contract manufacturer qualification: Quality Agreements, audits, CAPAs/SCARs, deviations, change controls, investigations, ongoing performance monitoring
  • Run BMT testing and oversee microbiological, chemical, allergen, contaminant, nutritional, and stability testing, including OOS/OOT investigations and third-party labs
  • Assess quality and regulatory risk on any formulation, ingredient, supplier, process, spec, packaging, or labeling change before it ships. Even a packaging color update can get held at customs in markets like China without sign-off
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs to keep formulations, specs, labels, claims, and packaging compliant by market
  • Own quality oversight of international manufacturing, packaging, warehousing, and distribution partners, including 3PLs
  • Set and monitor international quality KPIs and keep us audit-ready

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has a minimum of 5 years of quality assurance experience in food, beverage, dietary supplement, or consumer health, with meaningful time spent on products sold outside the US
  • Has hands-on EU and international quality experience. You've managed quality processes for food, dietary supplement, or consumer health products sold in the EU and across multiple regulatory jurisdictions, and you understand how quality and regulatory requirements differ by market
  • Has working knowledge of EU food and food supplement quality requirements, including GMP and food safety requirements, HACCP, traceability and recall, allergen management, specifications, supplier and contract manufacturer controls, analytical testing, stability, change control, product release, and labeling and claims oversight. Experience across multiple EU member states is a strong plus
  • Has real depth in core quality systems: you've owned CAPAs, investigations, root cause analysis, specification creation, document control, and change control, not just participated in them
  • Has qualified, audited, and managed external manufacturers and co-packers, and held them to account
  • Has owned or contributed materially to a recall, withdrawal, or market action, and knows what good looks like under pressure
  • Is comfortable owning stability protocols and managing third-party labs
  • Can work across US, UK/EU, and Asia time zones with a distributed team and external partners

Approach to the role:

  • You treat documentation as protection, not paperwork
  • You catch the small stuff, like a packaging color change, before it turns into a blocked shipment
  • You build with scale in mind, since we're small today and growing internationally fast
  • You bring high ownership and don't need to be micromanaged to move fast

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we are committed to offering a competitive total compensation package grounded in market data and aligned to our size, stage, industry, and geographic location. Compensation for this role will be benchmarked to the local market and may vary based on experience and country of hire. In addition to base compensation roles include a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
QuickBooks Financial Controller
Location: Remote — Canada, Central America, South America, or Europe
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
Industry: Interior Design / Professional Services
Compensation:$2,000 – $4,000 USD/month
English Proficiency:C1/C2 English Required

Reports To: CFO


About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based luxury interior design firm specializing in bespoke, high-end environments that combine exceptional design, craftsmanship, functionality, and personalized client service.
The company is strengthening its internal finance operations and is looking for an experienced accounting professional who can bring the same level of precision and attention to detail to its financial function.
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished QuickBooks Financial Controller with deep, hands-on QuickBooks expertise to take ownership of the company's accounting operations.
Reporting directly to the CFO, you will have full responsibility for the General Ledger, lead the transition from an outside accounting firm to a fully in-house accounting function, manage monthly close and reconciliations, prepare financial reporting, and oversee the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable team.
QuickBooks expertise is essential for this position. This role requires more than day-to-day usage. You must be comfortable configuring and optimizing QuickBooks and have experience with QuickBooks implementations.
This is a hands-on position for someone who is highly accurate, independent, comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment, and willing to support operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting when needed.
Why This Opportunity?
  • Take full ownership of the company's accounting operations and General Ledger.
  • Become the internal QuickBooks expert for the organization.
  • Work directly with the CFO and play a key role in strengthening the finance function.
  • Lead the transition from outsourced accounting to a fully in-house operation.
  • Manage and improve accounting processes, controls, and reporting.
  • Work remotely with significant autonomy and responsibility.
What You'll Do
QuickBooks & General Ledger
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks to support the company's accounting structure and reporting requirements.
  • Lead or support QuickBooks configuration and implementation initiatives.
  • Lead the transition of the General Ledger from an outside accounting firm to an in-house function.
  • Maintain, reconcile, and close the books monthly.
  • Establish and maintain the Chart of Accounts and appropriate classification standards.
Financial Reporting & Cash Management
  • Prepare accurate financial statements across the company's business divisions.
  • Prepare and review Profit & Loss (P&L) statements.
  • Oversee bank reconciliations.
  • Monitor the company's cash position.
  • Maintain accurate and reliable financial information for CFO review.
Team Leadership & Client Support
  • Supervise Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable specialists.
  • Review and approve invoices, hours reports, and client statements before distribution.
  • Review and approve payroll, vendor payments, and expense submissions.
  • Interface with clients regarding accounting-related requests when required.
  • Ensure accounting work completed by the team meets established standards.
  • Support operational and non-accounting matters that may arise within a small-team environment.
Tax & Accounting Controls
  • Coordinate payroll tax, sales tax, and 1099-related matters.
  • Execute accounting policies established by the CFO accurately and consistently.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a high standard of accuracy.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Prior experience as a Financial Controller, Senior Accountant, or similar senior accounting professional with full ownership of the General Ledger.
  • Advanced, hands-on QuickBooks expertise.
  • Professional experience with QuickBooks Online and/or QuickBooks Desktop.
  • Experience configuring QuickBooks and/or leading a QuickBooks implementation.
  • Strong experience managing the General Ledger, reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Experience preparing financial statements and P&L reports.
  • Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts structures and accounting classifications.
  • Experience overseeing or working closely with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistently low error rates.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to execute accounting policies and procedures with precision.
  • Comfortable supporting operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting.
  • C1/C2 English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work with required overlap during U.S. business hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience transitioning an accounting function from an external accounting firm to an in-house team.
  • Experience with BigTime or similar project accounting software.
  • Previous experience in professional services, interior design, architecture, construction, or project-based businesses.
  • Experience supervising accounting or bookkeeping professionals.
How Success Is Measured
Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:
  • Maintain an accurate and reliable General Ledger.
  • Independently execute reconciliations and month-end close.
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks according to business requirements.
  • Successfully support the transition to an in-house accounting function.
  • Deliver accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a consistently low error rate.
  • Effectively oversee AP and AR activities.
  • Work independently while executing CFO policies accurately.
  • Communicate professionally with U.S.-based colleagues and clients.
Video Presentation Required
As part of your application, please submit a short video in English introducing yourself and briefly summarizing your accounting background, followed by a 30-second to 1-minute overview of your QuickBooks experience, including how many years you have used it professionally, whether you have worked with QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop, your main responsibilities in the system, and any experience configuring QuickBooks or leading an implementation.
Why Join Us?
  • $2,000 – $4,000 USD/month, based on experience and location.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Direct exposure to the CFO and company leadership.
  • Significant ownership of the accounting function.
  • Opportunity to lead an important financial operations transition.
  • Long-term, full-time contractor opportunity.
  • Short initial trial period to ensure mutual fit.
Important Notes
Advanced QuickBooks expertise is a core requirement for this position. Basic familiarity, occasional use, or self-taught exposure without substantial professional experience will not be sufficient.
Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain their years of QuickBooks experience, versions used, responsibilities within the system, experience running monthly close, and any QuickBooks configuration or implementation experience.
C1/C2 English is mandatory. The role operates entirely in English with a U.S.-based team and, at times, directly with clients.
This is a permanent, full-time contractor opportunity with a short initial trial period.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

About Engine

Engine is the all-in-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K+ businesses and groups representing 1.8M+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, the fastest-growing company in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

As a Sr. ARC Specialist, you will play a critical role in maintaining the accuracy, integrity, and efficiency of all airline ticketing and financial reporting processes. Sitting at the intersection of Flight Operations, Finance, and Member Support, you will be directly responsible for managing ARC (Airlines Reporting Corporation) processes, ensuring regulatory adherence, and driving excellence across all air travel transactions.

This high-impact role requires a deep understanding of airline ticketing — including exchanges, refunds, and voids — as well as expert-level knowledge of ARC procedures, GDS platforms, and reconciliation workflows. You will serve as the final authority on transaction accuracy and compliance, overseeing end-to-end settlement cycles, resolving discrepancies, and implementing scalable SOPs to support sustainable growth.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings meticulous attention to detail, and is passionate about upholding the highest standards.

Your Mission:

As part of the Engine team, you’ll play a vital role in an environment where innovation meets collaboration. Here’s what you’ll take charge of:

ARC Settlement and Financial Reconciliation

  • Own and manage the full ARC settlement process on a weekly basis, including submission, reconciliation, and payment via Back Office Systems, and IAR.
  • Process and reconcile all transactions—sales, exchanges, refunds, voids, commissions, TASFs—across Amadeus GDS, ARC, and financial platforms.
  • Work with Finance to authorize and process the weekly cash remit draft to ARC, ensuring regulatory compliance and timely payments.
  • Perform daily balancing of ARC transactions, resolving discrepancies in coordination with ticketing and accounting teams.

Ticketing Audit and Debit Memo Management

  • Review issued airline tickets, ensuring accuracy in complex transactions like refunds, exchanges, MCOs, and fare rule applications.
  • Lead the end-to-end Debit Memo (ADM) management process, including daily monitoring of ARC Memo Manager, dispute resolution, chargebacks, trend analysis, and financial reporting.
  • Identify root causes of debit memo violations and implement corrective actions in partnership with operations and finance.
  • Support internal and external audits with complete, audit-ready documentation related to ARC reporting and ticketing activities.

Compliance, Process Improvement, and Cross-Functional Support

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure compliance, accuracy, and efficiency in ticketing and settlement workflows and address any financial or system interface issues.
    Provide ongoing guidance and training on ARC policy updates, TRAMS/IAR usage, and best practices in ticketing compliance.

Industry Knowledge and Continuous Learning

  • Stay abreast of ARC regulations, airline policy updates, and travel industry developments, communicating relevant impacts to internal stakeholders.
  • Assist with the testing, implementation, and maintenance of back-office system updates and integrations.

What You’ll Bring to Engine:

We’re looking for someone who’s ready to make an impact and grow alongside us:

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in ARC reporting, reconciliation, and settlement in a high-volume TMC, OTA or travel agency environment.
  • Expert-level proficiency with Amadeus GDS and NDC technology.
  • Deep knowledge of ARC processes, IAR, and back-office systems.
  • ARC Specialist certification, or ability to obtain within 30 days of hire.
  • Possess expert-level knowledge of advanced fare rules, intricate fare construction, commission structures, exchanges, and refunds.
  • Proven ability to research, analyze, and resolve financial and transactional discrepancies.
  • High attention to detail with exceptional accuracy in data handling and reporting.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and other financial and reporting applications
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong negotiation and documentation abilities.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

$65,000—$90,000 USD

MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
  • Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
  • Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.

Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement

Influence & Impact

About us

Pet Media Group (PMG) is a scale-up that acquires, launches, and develops market-leading pet marketplaces globally, with over 1.5 million animals finding new homes through our platforms every year. The way pets find new loving homes has remained largely unchanged for centuries. We're on a mission to change that through innovative technology, and increasingly through the intelligent use of AI. We're a young and ambitious team who have built unicorns before (e.g. Avito), backed by some of Europe's leading investors (e.g. Verdane and Otiva, early backers of Klarna, CAIA, Apotea, and Easypark).

Who are we looking for?

We're growing our Monetisation team and looking for an Engineering Manager to lead it. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll grow and support a team of engineers, own delivery and technical direction for the Monetisation domain, and stay close enough to the code to make sound calls alongside your team.

The Monetisation team works on several key parts of the business. In the VAS (value-added services) domain they build and maintain everything from pricing, checkouts and payment processing, recurring subscriptions, product activations, and experimentation/CRO. They also build and maintain an escrow system that lets users safely run the entire transaction through the platform, touching topics like KYC/KYB/identity verification, payment processing and payouts.

You'll be accountable for how this team performs: the quality of what it ships, the growth of the people on it, and how the roadmap connects daily engineering work to revenue outcomes. You'll partner closely with product and the wider engineering leadership to set priorities and clear blockers.

We also want someone who treats AI as a core part of how a modern team works. You encourage your engineers to use LLMs and AI tooling in their daily workflow, and you have a view on where the technology takes our ways of working.

What you'll do

  • Lead, grow and support a team of full-stack engineers (1:1s, career development, hiring, feedback)

  • Own delivery for the Monetisation domain: predictable, high-quality shipping against a clear roadmap

  • Set technical direction with your team and stay hands-on enough to guide architecture and unblock hard problems

  • Partner with product to shape priorities across VAS, payments and escrow

  • Champion AI-assisted engineering as a standard part of how the team builds

Requirements

We're a fast-growing scale-up. We want teams that build fast, fail fast, and learn fast. You don't need to be a world-class expert in every tool we use, but you do need a critical, open mindset, a strong engineering background, and a genuine enthusiasm for AI-assisted development.

Core (required):

  • Experience managing and growing a team of software engineers, including people development and hiring

  • Experience in the payments or fintech space (Stripe, Adyen, Braintree), or with escrow / KYC / identity verification

  • A strong engineering background yourself, ideally full-stack with TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js and React

  • A track record of owning delivery for a team or domain: turning strategy into a roadmap and shipping it

  • Comfortable staying technical: reviewing designs, guiding architecture, and making trade-offs with your team

  • Understanding of GraphQL and its usage in large systems with multiple consumers

  • Experience with relational databases like PostgreSQL

  • Active use of AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, Codex) in engineering work, and a point of view on how teams should adopt them

  • Working proficiency in English is required

Bonus (helpful & appreciated):

  • Experience with monitoring & observability tools like Grafana

  • Experience with experimentation / CRO

  • Experience introducing or scaling AI coding workflows at team or company level

Our tech stack

Next.js, React, Node.js & React Native (TypeScript throughout) · GitLab CI/CD · Elasticsearch · Redis · GraphQL & PostgreSQL · Knex · Docker · Serverless with AWS Lambda · AWS · Grafana · Bitrise

What we offer

  • Join a rapidly growing, already-profitable business with a clear vision and genuine energy

  • Full ownership of a mission-critical domain and the team behind it

  • A diverse team across Sweden, Germany, Austria, UK, Poland, Portugal, Bosnia, Croatia, Ukraine and Egypt

  • A real opportunity to shape our tech department and help define how AI becomes part of how we build

  • Competitive compensation and great benefits (remote or in-person)
